text: cooked squeezed crush a good amount of cumin and a little rue, add parthican laser or vinegar, stock, condensed wine and oil heat moderately and serve.

title: Recipe 392
text: boiled, served dressed with oil, to which, if desired, you may add vinegar.

title: Recipe 393
text: pepper the radishes well or, equally well grate it with pepper and brine.

title: Recipe 394
text: the cabbage is cooked with pot herbs in soda water press chop it very fine crush pepper, lovage, dry satury with dry onions, add stock, oil and wine.

title: Recipe 395
text: cook celery in soda water, squeeze chop fine. in the mortar crush pepper, lovage, origany, onion wine and stock, adding some oil. cook this in the boiler and mix the celery with this preparation.

title: Recipe 396
text: cook the lettuce leaves with onion in soda water, squeeze chop very fine in the mortar crush pepper, lovage, celery seed, dry mint, onion add stock, oil and wine.

title: Recipe 397
text: it will be required above all to clean the vegetables well, to cut off all decayed parts and to cover with wormwood water.

title: Recipe 398
text: field and forest herbs are prepared with stock oil and vinegar or as a cooked dish by adding pepper, cumin and mastich berries.

title: Recipe 399
text: the female nettles, when the sun is in the position of the aries, is supposed to render valuable services against ailments of various kinds.

title: Recipe 400
text: endives with brine, a little oil and chopped onion, instead of the real lettuce in winter time the endives are taken out of the pickle with honey or vinegar.

title: Recipe 401
text: with vinegar dressing and a little brine stock which helps digestion and is taken to counteract inflation.

title: Recipe 402
text: 2 ounces of ginger, 1 ounce of green rue, 1 ounce of meaty dates, 12 scruples of ground pepper, 1 ounce of good honey, and 8 ounces of either æthiopian or syrian cumin. make an infusion of this in vinegar, the cumin crushed, and strain. of this liquor use a small spoonful mix it with stock and a little vinegar you may take a small spoonful after the meal.

title: Recipe 403
text: cardoons briny broth, oil, and chopped eggs.

title: Recipe 404
text: rue, mint, coriander, fennel all green finely crushed add pepper, lovage, and brine and oil.

title: Recipe 405
text: pepper, cumin, broth and oil.

title: Recipe 406
text: cow-parsnips are fried with a simple wine sauce.

title: Recipe 407
text: boil the parsnips in salt water with pure oil, chopped green coriander and whole pepper.

title: Recipe 408
text: prepare the boiled parsnips with the following sauce celery seed, rue, honey, ground pepper, mixed with raisin wine, stock and a little oil bind this with roux sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 409
text: mash the parsnips, cumin, rue, stock, a little condensed wine, oil, green coriander leeks and serve goes well with salt pork.

title: Recipe 410
text: boil the parsnips hard put them in a sauce pan and stew with oil, stock, pepper, raisin wine, strain and bind with roux.

title: Recipe 411
text: finish the parsnips in oil and broth, or fry them in oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and serve.

title: Recipe 412
text: bruise the boiled parsnips eliminate the hard strings add boiled spelt and chopped hard eggs, stock and pepper. make croquettes or sausage from this, adding pignolia nut and pepper, wrap in caul fry and serve them as an entrée dish in a wine sauce.

title: Recipe 413
text: carrots or parsnips are fried with a wine sauce.

title: Recipe 414
text: the carrots salted with pure oil and vinegar.

title: Recipe 415
text: the carrots boiled sliced, stewed with cumin and a little oil and are served. at the same time make a cumin sauce for those who have the colic.

title: Recipe 416
text: pepper, fresh mint, celery, dry pennyroyal, cheese, pignolia nuts, honey, vinegar, broth, yolks of egg, fresh water, soaked bread and the liquid pressed out, cow s cheese and cucumbers are arranged in a dish, alternately, with the nuts finely chopped capers, chicken livers cover completely with broth, place on ice serve up.

title: Recipe 417
text: put in the mortar celery seed, dry pennyroyal, dry mint, ginger, fresh coriander, seedless raisins, honey, vinegar, oil and wine crush it together. place 3 pieces of picentian bread in a mould, interlined with pieces of chicken, sweetbreads of calf or lamb, cheese, pignolia nuts, cucumbers finely chopped dry onions covering the whole with broth. bury the mould in snow up to the rim sprinkle and serve.

title: Recipe 418
text: hollow out an alexandrine loaf of bread, soak the crumbs with posca and make a paste of it. put in the mortar pepper, honey mint, garlic, fresh coriander, salted cow s cheese, water and oil. wine poured over before serving.

title: Recipe 419
text: make a paste of stewed brains season with pepper, cumin, laser, broth, thickened wine, milk and eggs poach it over a weak fire or in a hot water.

title: Recipe 420
text: the dish, called turn-over, is thus made crush very fine walnuts and hazelnuts toast them and crush with honey, mix in pepper, broth, milk and eggs and a little oil.

title: Recipe 421
text: another dish is made of the strunks of lettuce crushed with pepper, broth, thickened wine, water and oil, and cook this bind with eggs, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 422
text: take vegetables, clean and wash, shred and cook them cool them off and drain them. take 4 brains, remove strings and cook them in the mortar put 6 scruples of pepper, moisten with broth and crush fine then add the brains, rub again and meanwhile add the vegetables, rubbing all the while, and make a fine paste of it. thereupon break and add 8 eggs. now add a glassful of broth, a glassful of wine, a glassful of raisin wine, taste this preparation. oil the baking dish thoroughly and place it in the hot plate, and when it is done sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 423
text: cold asparagus pie is made in this manner take well cleaned asparagus, crush it in the mortar, dilute with water and presently strain it through the colander. now trim, prepare figpeckers. 3 scruples of pepper are crushed in the mortar, add broth, a glass of wine, put this in a saucepan with 3 ounces of oil, heat thoroughly. meanwhile oil your pie mould, and with 6 eggs, flavored with œnogarum, and the asparagus preparation as described above thicken the mixture on the hot ashes. thereupon arrange the figpeckers in the mould, cover them with this purée, bake the dish. sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 424
text: asparagus pie is made like this put in the mortar asparagus tips crush pepper, lovage, green coriander, savory and onions crush, dilute with wine, broth and oil. put this in a well-greased pan, and, if you like, add while on the fire some beaten eggs to it to thicken it, cook and sprinkle with very fine pepper.

title: Recipe 425
text: by following the above instructions you may make a pie of field vegetables, or of thyme or of green peppers or of cucumbers or of small tender sprouts same as above, or, if you like, make one underlaid with boneless pieces of fish or of chicken.

title: Recipe 426
text: a dish of elderberries, either hot or cold, is made in this manner take elderberries wash them cook in water, skim and strain. prepare a dish in which to cook the custard crush 6 scruples of pepper with a little broth add this to the elderberry pulp with another glass of broth, a glass of wine, a glass of raisin wine and as much as 4 ounces of oil. put the dish in the hot bath and stir the contents. as soon as it is getting warm, quickly break 6 eggs and whipping them, incorporate them, in order to thicken the fluid. when thick enough sprinkle with pepper and serve up.

title: Recipe 427
text: take roses fresh from the flower bed, strip off the leaves, remove the white put them in the mortar pour over some broth rub fine. add a glass of broth and strain the juice through the colander. take 4 brains, skin them and remove the nerves crush 8 scruples of pepper moistened with the juice and rub thereupon break 8 eggs, add 1 glass of wine, 1 glass of raisin wine and a little oil. meanwhile grease a pan, place it on the hot ashes in which pour the above described material when the mixture is cooked in the bain maris sprinkle it with pulverized pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 428
text: and pumpkin pie is made thus stewed and mashed pumpkin is placed in the pan seasoned with a little cumin essence. add a little oil heat and serve.

title: Recipe 429
text: clean the smelts marinate in oil, place in a shallow pan, add oil, broth and wine. bunch rue and marjoram and cook with the fish. when done remove the herbs, season the fish with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 430
text: boneless pieces of anchovies or fish, either roast boiled, chop very fine. fill a casserole generously with the same crushed pepper and a little rue, add sufficient broth and some oil, and mix in, also add enough raw eggs so that the whole forms one solid mass. now carefully add some sea-nettles but take pain that they are not mixed with the eggs. now put the dish into the steam so that it may congeal. when done sprinkle with ground pepper and carry into the dining room. nobody will be able to tell what he is enjoying.

title: Recipe 431
text: soak nuts, dry them, and also have fresh sea-urchins ready. take a deep dish in which arrange the following things medium-sized mallows and beets, mature leeks, celery, stewed tender green cabbage, and other boiled green vegetables, a disjointed chicken stewed in its own gravy, cooked brains, lucanian sausage, hard boiled eggs cut into halves, big tarentinian sausage sliced and broiled in the ashes, chicken giblets or pieces of chicken meat. bits of fried fish, sea nettles, pieces of oysters and fresh cheese are alternately put together sprinkle in between the nuts and whole pepper, and the juice as is cooked from pepper, lovage, celery seed and silphium. this essence, when done, mix with milk to which raw eggs have been added this over the pieces of food in the dish so that the whole is thoroughly combined, stiffen it and when done fresh mussels sprinkle pepper over and serve.

title: Recipe 432
text: the apician dish is made thus take small pieces of cooked sow s belly pieces of fish, pieces of chicken, the breasts of figpeckers or of thrushes cooked, whichever is best. mince all this very carefully, particularly the figpeckers. dissolve in oil strictly fresh eggs crush pepper and lovage, pour over some broth and raisin wine, put it in a saucepan to heat and bind with roux. after you have cut all in regular pieces, let it come to the boiling point. when done, retire with its juice of which you put some in another deep pan with whole pepper and pignolia nuts. spread out in single layers with thin pancakes in between put in as many pancakes and layers of meat as is required to fill the dish put a final cover of pancake on top and sprinkle with pepper after those eggs have been added to tie the dish. now put this in a boiler and dish it out. an expensive silver platter would enhance the appearance of this dish materially.

title: Recipe 433
text: pieces of cooked sow s udder, pieces of cooked fish, chicken meat and similar bits, mince uniformly, season well and carefully. take a metal dish. break eggs and beat them. in a mortar put pepper, lovage and origany, which crush moisten with broth, wine, raisin wine and a little oil empty it into the bowl and heat it. thereupon when thickened mix it with the pieces of meat. now prepare layers of stew and pancakes, interspersed with oil until full, cover with one real good pancake, cut into it a vent hole for chimney on the surface turn out upside down into another dish. sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 434
text: pignolia nuts, chopped or broken nuts are cleaned and roasted and crushed with honey. mix in pepper, broth, milk, eggs, a little honey and oil..

title: Recipe 435
text: take any kind of salt fish cook in oil, take the bones out, shred it pieces of cooked brains, pieces of fish, minced chicken livers and hot soft cheese. heat all this in a dish grind pepper, lovage, origany, seeds of rue with wine, honey wine and oil cook all on a slow fire bind with raw eggs arrange. properly sprinkle with crushed cumin and serve.

title: Recipe 436
text: dry pieces of salt tursio are boned, cleaned shredded fine and seasoned with ground pepper, lovage, origany, parsley, coriander, cumin, rue seeds and dry mint. make fish balls out of this material and poach the same in wine, broth and oil and when cooked, arrange them in a dish. then make a sauce season with pepper, lovage, satury, onions and wine and vinegar, also add broth and oil as needed, bind with roux sprinkle with thyme and ground pepper.

title: Recipe 437
text: blanched off in water with soda squeeze arrange in a saucepan. grind pepper, lovage, coriander, satury, onion with wine, broth, vinegar and oil add to the vegetables, stew and tie with roux. sprinkle with thyme, finely ground pepper and serve. any kind of vegetable may be prepared in the above manner, if you wish.

title: Recipe 438
text: sardine loaf is made in this manner clean the sardines break eggs and mix with fish add to this some stock, wine and oil, and finish by heating it. when done to a point, add sardines to it, let it stand a while carefully turn over mask with a warm wine sauce, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 439
text: the dish of bacon and brains is made in this manner strain hard boiled eggs with parboiled brains the skin and nerves of which have been removed also cook chicken giblets, all in proportion to the fish put this aforesaid mixture in a saucepan, place the cooked bacon in the center, grind pepper and lovage and to sweeten add a dash of mead, heat, when hot stir briskly with a rue whip and bind with roux.

title: Recipe 440
text: a dish of mullet consists of scaled salt mullet placed in a clean pan with enough oil as is necessary for cooking when done add wine or raisin wine, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 441
text: another fish dish is thus made fry any kind of cured fish, carefully treated place in a pan, cover with sufficient oil, lay cooked salt over the center, keep it hot, when real hot, add a dash of honey wine to the gravy and stir it up.

title: Recipe 442
text: another fish dish make as follows clean any kind of fish and place it properly in a saucepan with shredded dry ascalonian onions or with any other kind of onions, the fish on top. add stock and oil and cook. when done, put broiled bacon in the center, give it a dash of vinegar, sprinkle with savory and garnish with onions.

title: Recipe 443
text: clean young onions, rejecting the green tops, and place them in a saucepan with a little broth, some oil and water, and, to be cooked place salt pork in the midst. when nearly done, add a spoon of honey a little vinegar and reduced must, taste it, if insipid add more brine if too salty, add more honey, and sprinkle with savory.

title: Recipe 444
text: clean and wash the fish break and beat eggs, mix them with the fish, add broth, wine and oil. place this on the fire, when cooked add simple fish wine sauce to it, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 445
text: the zomore fish dish is made as follows take raw ganonas and other whichever you like, place them in a sauce pan, adding oil, broth, reduced wine, a bunch of leeks and coriander while this cooks, crush pepper, lovage and a bunch of origany which crush by itself and dilute with the juice of the fish. now dissolve prepare and taste the dish, binding sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 446
text: a dish of sole is thus made beat the sole prepare and place them in a sauce pan, add oil, broth and wine, and poach them thus now crush pepper, lovage, origany and add of the fish juice then bind the sauce with raw eggs to make a good creamy sauce of it strain this over the sole, heat all on a slow fire sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 447
text: take raisins, pepper, lovage, origany, onions, wine, broth and oil, place this in a pan after this has cooked add to it the cooked small fish, bind with roux and serve.

title: Recipe 448
text: take the fish, prepare and half broil or fry them thereupon shred them pieces next prepare oysters put in a mortar 6 scruples of pepper, moisten with broth and crush. add a small glass of broth, one of wine to it put in a sauce pan 3 ounces of oil and the oysters and let them poach with wine sauce. when they are done, oil a dish on which place the above mentioned fish pieces and stewed oysters, heat again, and when hot, break 40 eggs and pour them over the oysters, so that they congeal. sprinkle with pepper and serve..

title: Recipe 449
text: grind pepper, cumin, parsley, rue, onions, honey, broth, raisin wine and drops of oil.

title: Recipe 450
text: take medlars, clean them crush them in the mortar and strain through colander. 4 cooked brains, skinned and freed from stringy parts, put in the mortar with 8 scruples of pepper, dilute with stock and crush, adding the medlar pulp and combine all now break 8 eggs and add a small glass of broth. oil a clean pan and place it in the hot bath or in the hot ashes after you have filled it with the preparation, make sure that the pan gets enough heat from below let it congeal, and when done sprinkle with a little fine pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 451
text: clean hard-skinned peaches and slice, stew them arrange in a dish, sprinkle with a little oil and serve with cumin-flavored wine.

title: Recipe 452
text: a dish of pears is made this way stew the pears, clean out the center crush them with pepper, cumin, honey, raisin wine, broth and a little oil mix with eggs, make a pie of this, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 453
text: a dish of sea-nettles, either hot or cold, is made thus take sea-nettles, wash and drain them on the colander, dry on the table and chop fine. crush 10 scruples of pepper, moisten with broth, add 2 small glasses of broth and 6 ounces of oil. heat this in a sauce pan and when cooked take it out and allow to cool off. next oil a clean pan, break 8 eggs and beat them combine these with the above preparations, place the pan on hot ashes to give it heat from below, when done sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 454
text: a dish of quinces is made as follows quinces are cooked with leeks, honey and broth, using hot oil, or they are stewed in honey.

title: Recipe 455
text: place the fish in sauce pan, add broth oil and wine. also finely chop leek heads and coriander. form it into small cakes adding capers and sea-nettles well cleaned. these fish cakes cook in a liquor of pepper, lovage and origany, crushed, diluted with broth and the above fish liquor which skim well, bind stir over the cakes, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 456
text: finely chop the white part of leeks and place in a sauce pan add oil and broth next add small sausage to be cooked likewise. to have a good tarentine dish, they must be tender. the making of these sausage will be found among the isicia. also make a sauce in the following manner crush pepper, lovage and origany, moisten with broth, add of the above gravy, wine, raisin wine put in a sauce pan to be heated, when boiling, skim carefully, bind, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 457
text: the apician minutal is made as follows oil, broth wine, leek heads, mint, small fish, small tidbits cock s fries or capon s kidneys and pork sweetbreads all of these are cooked together now crush pepper, lovage, green coriander, or seeds, moistened with broth add a little honey, and of the own liquor of the above morsels, wine and honey to taste bring this to a boiling point skim, bind, stir well sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 458
text: put in a sauce pan oil, broth finely chopped leeks, coriander, small tid-bits, cooked pork shoulder, cut into long strips including the skin, have everything equally half done. add matian apples cleaned, the core removed, sliced lengthwise and cook them together meanwhile crush pepper, cumin, green coriander, or seeds, mint, laser root, moistened with vinegar, honey and broth and a little reduced must, add to this the broth of the above morsels, vinegar to taste, boil, skim, bind sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 459
text: in a sauce pan put together oil, broth, coctura finely cut leek heads and green coriander, cooked pork shoulder, small tid-bits. while this is being cooked, crush pepper, cumin, coriander or seeds, green rue, laser root, moistened with vinegar, reduced must and the gravy of the above morsels add vinegar to taste when this is cooked, hollow out citron squash cut in dice, boil and place them together with the rest in the dish, skim, bind the sauce sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 460
text: in a sauce pan put oil, broth and wine, finely cut shallots, diced cooked pork shoulder. when this is cooked, crush pepper, cumin, dry mint, dill, moisten with honey, broth, raisin wine a little vinegar, some of the gravy of the above morsels, add fruits the seeds of which have been taken out, let boil, when thoroughly cooked, skim, bind, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 461
text: the way to make a minutal of hare s giblets may be found among the hare recipes. in a sauce pan put oil, broth and wine, finely cut shallots, diced cooked pork shoulder. when this is cooked, crush pepper, cumin, dry mint, dill, moisten with honey, broth, raisin wine a little vinegar, some of the gravy of the above morsels, add seedless fruits, let boil, when thoroughly cooked, skim, bind, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 462
text: make this the same way as described in the foregoing, only add more raisin wine.

title: Recipe 463
text: crush barley, soaked the day before, well washed, place on the fire to be cooked when hot add enough oil, a bunch of dill, dry onion, satury and colocasium to be cooked together because for the better juice, add green coriander and a little salt bring it to a boiling point. when done take out the bunch and transfer the barley into another kettle to avoid sticking to the bottom and burning, make it liquid strain into a pot, covering the tops of the colocasia. next crush pepper, lovage, a little dry flea-bane, cumin and sylphium stir it well and add vinegar, reduced must and broth put it back into the pot, the remaining colocasia finish on a gentle fire.

title: Recipe 464
text: the cereal is soaked chickpeas, lentils and peas are crushed and boiled with it when well cooked, add plenty of oil. now cut green herbs, leeks, coriander, dill, fennel, beets, mallows, cabbage strunks, all soft and green and finely cut, and put in a pot. the cabbage cook crush fennel seed, origany, sylphium and lovage, and when crushed, add broth to taste, pour this over the porridge, stir it together and use some finely chopped cabbage stems to sprinkle on top.

title: Recipe 465
text: the moveable appetizers are thus made small white beets, mature leeks, celery roots stewed cockles ginger chicken giblets, small fowl small morsels cooked in their own liquor. oil a pan, line it with mallow leaves and a composition of different vegetables, and, if you have room enough, bulbs, damascus plums, snails, tid-bits short lucanian sausage sliced add broth, oil, wine, vinegar put on the fire to heat and so cook them. meanwhile crush pepper, lovage, ginger, a little tarragon, moisten it and let it cook. break several eggs in a dish, use the remaining liquor in the mortar to mix it with the sauce in the dish and to bind it. when this is done, make a wine sauce for it as follows crush pepper, lovage, moistened with broth, raisin wine to taste in a small sauce pan put a little oil heat, and bind with roux when hot. now upset the dish on a platter, remove the mallow leaves, pour over the wine sauce, sprinkle with pepper and serve.
ingredients: tid bits lucanian sausage sliced broth

title: Recipe 466
text: for this vegetable dish boil bulbs broth, oil, and wine when done liver of suckling pig chicken livers and feet and small birds cut in halves, all to be cooked with the bulbs. when done, crush pepper, lovage, moistened with broth, wine, raisin wine to sweeten it. add of the own liquor of the morsels, retire the onions, when done bind with roux in the last moment and serve.

title: Recipe 467
text: a dish of stuffed pumpkin is made thus peel and cut the pumpkin lengthwise into oblong pieces which hollow out and put in a cool place. the dressing for the same make in this way crush pepper, lovage and origany, moistened with broth mince cooked brains and beat raw eggs and mix all together to form a paste add broth as taste requires. stuff the above prepared pieces of pumpkin that have not been fully cooked with the dressing fit two pieces together and close them tight. take the cooked ones out and fry them. wine sauce make thus crush pepper, lovage moistened with wine, raisin wine to taste, a little oil, place in pan to be cooked when done bind with roux. cover the fried pumpkin with this sauce, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 468
text: clean hard-skinned early fruits remove the seeds and keep them cold in a pan. crush pepper dry mint, moistened with broth, adding honey, raisin wine, wine and vinegar pour this over the fruit in the pan, adding a little oil. stew slowly on a weak fire, thicken with roux sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 469
text: julian pulses are cooked thus soak well-cleaned spelt, put it on the fire when cooked, add oil. if it threatens to become thick, carefully thin it down. take two cooked brains and half a pound of meat ground as for forcemeat, crush this with the brains and put in a pot. crush pepper, lovage and fennel seed, moistened with broth, a little wine and put it on top of the brain and meat. when this forcemeat is heated sufficiently, mix it with the spelt transfer into service dish, thinned. this must have the consistency of a heavy juice.

title: Recipe 470
text: porridge and wine is thus made flavor the pulse well with wine and immerse in the juice dainty morsels.

title: Recipe 471
text: or flavor cooked spelt with the liquor of dainty pieces of pork, or capon cooked in wine.

title: Recipe 472
text: put a pint of milk and some water on the fire in a new pot break round bread into it dry, stir well to prevent burning add water as necessary.

title: Recipe 473
text: honey and mead are treated similarly, mixed with milk, with the addition of salt and a little oil. pulse pultes

title: Recipe 474
text: put the lentils in a clean sauce pan. in the mortar crush pepper, cumin, coriander seed, mint, rue, and flea-bane, moistened with vinegar, add honey and broth and reduced must, vinegar to taste and put this in a sauce pan. the cooked cow-parsnips crush, heat when thoroughly cooked, tie, add green oil and serve in an appropriate dish.

title: Recipe 475
text: take a new sauce pan, place therein the chestnuts carefully cleaned add water and a little soda and place on the fire to be cooked. this done, crush in the mortar pepper, cumin, coriander seed, mint, rue, laser root and flea-bane moistened with vinegar, honey and broth add vinegar to taste and pour this over the cooked chestnuts, add oil and allow to boil. when done crush it in the mortar. taste to see if something is missing and if so, put it in, and at last add green oil.

title: Recipe 476
text: cook the peas, when skimmed, lay leeks, coriander and cumin on top. crush pepper, lovage, cumin, dill and green basilica, wine and broth to taste, make it boil when done stir well, put in what perchance should be missing and serve.

title: Recipe 477
text: cook the peas with oil and a piece of sow s belly put in a sauce pan broth, leek heads green coriander and put on the fire to be cooked. of tid-bits cut little dice. similarly cook thrushes or other small birds, or take sliced chicken and diced brain, properly cooked. further cook, in the available liquor or broth, lucanian sausage and bacon cook leeks in water crush a pint of toasted pignolia nuts also crush pepper, lovage, origany and ginger, dilute with the broth of pork, tie take a square baking dish suitable for turning over which oil well and line with caul sprinkle a layer of crushed nuts upon which put some peas, fully covering the bottom of the squash dish on top of this arrange slices of the bacon leeks and sliced lucanian sausage again cover with a layer of peas and alternate all the rest of the available edibles in the manner described until the dish is filled, concluding at last with a layer of peas, utilizing everything. bake this dish in the oven, or put it into a slow fire so that it may be baked thoroughly. put yolks of hard boiled eggs in the mortar with white pepper, nuts, honey, white wine and a little broth mix and put it into a sauce pan to be cooked when done, turn out the peas into a large and mask them with this sauce which is called white sauce.

title: Recipe 478
text: cook peas when skimmed, put in the sauce pan finely chopped leeks and coriander to be cooked. take small cuttle fish, most desirable because of the black liquor and cook them also. add oil, broth and wine, a bunch of leek and coriander and make it boil. when done, crush pepper, lovage, origany, a little wild cumin moisten with the juice add wine and raisin wine to taste mince the fish very fine, incorporate it with the peas, and sprinkle with pepper.

title: Recipe 479
text: cook the peas, work well place in the cold, stirring until they have cooled off. finely chop onions and the whites of hard boiled eggs, season with salt and a little vinegar the yolks press through a colander into an entrée dish, season with fresh oil and serve.

title: Recipe 480
text: peas or beans with yolks are made thus cook the peas, smoothen them crush pepper, lovage, ginger, and on the condiments put hard boiled yolks, 3 ounces of honey, also broth, wine and vinegar place all in a sauce pan the finely chopped condiments with oil added, put on the stove to be cooked with this flavor the peas which must be smooth and if they be too harsh add honey and serve.

title: Recipe 481
text: when skimmed mix broth, honey, must, cumin, rue, celery seed, oil and wine, stir. serve with crushed pepper and sausage.

title: Recipe 482
text: when skimmed flavor them with crushed persian laser, broth and must pour a little oil over and serve.

title: Recipe 483
text: this adroit, tempting dish of peas is prepared in this manner cook peas brains or small birds, or boned thrushes, lucanian sausage, chicken livers and giblets all of which are put in a sauce pan broth, oil and a bunch of leeks, green coriander finely chopped, cook with the brains crush pepper, lovage and broth.

title: Recipe 484
text: peas or beans in the style of vitellius prepare thus are cooked, when carefully skimmed, add leeks, coriander and mallow flowers when done, crush pepper, lovage, origany, and fennel seed moistened with broth into a sauce pan with wine, adding oil, heat thoroughly and when boiling stir well put green oil on top and serve.

title: Recipe 485
text: cook the beans meanwhile crush pepper, lovage, cumin, green coriander, moistened with broth and wine, and add broth to taste, put into the sauce pan adding oil heat on a slow fire and serve.

title: Recipe 486
text: for peas in the pod apician style take a clean earthen pot in which to cook the peas to the peas add finely cut lucanian sausage, little pork cakes, pieces of meat and pork shoulder. crush pepper, lovage, origany, dill, dry onions green coriander moistened with broth, wine, and add broth to taste unite this with the peas in the earthen pot to which add oil in sufficient quantity to be absorbed by the peas finish on a slow fire to give it live heat and serve.

title: Recipe 487
text: cook the peas when skimmed add a bunch of leeks and green coriander. while being cooked crush pepper, lovage, origany, and bunch moisten with its own juice, wine enough to suit your taste, then add oil and finish on a slow fire.

title: Recipe 488
text: make peas commodian style thus cook the peas, when skimmed, crush pepper, lovage, dill, shallots moistened with broth add wine and broth to taste stir in a sauce pan to combine for each sextarius of peas beat 4 eggs, and combine them with the peas, place on the fire to thicken and serve.

title: Recipe 489

title: Recipe 759
text: arrange different kinds of cooked vegetables in a casserole with chicken interspersed, if you like season with broth and oil, set to boil. next crush a little pepper and leaves, and mix an egg in with the dressing press.

title: Recipe 760
text: crush whatever quantity of leaves is required with chervil and one and a quarter part of laurel berries, a medium-sized boiled cabbage, coriander leaves, dissolve with its own juice, steam in the hot ashes, but first place in a mould decorate, pour under a well-seasoned sauce, and so serve.

title: Recipe 761
text: mallows, leeks, beets, or cooked cabbage sprouts thrushes and quenelles of chicken, tidbits of pork or squab chicken and other similar shreds of fine meats that may be available arrange everything alternately in layers. crush pepper and lovage with 2 parts of old wine, 1 part broth, 1 part honey and a little oil. taste it and when well mixed and in due proportions put in a sauce pan and allow to heat moderately when boiling add a pint of milk in which eggs have been dissolved pour over and when congealed serve.

title: Recipe 762
text: place the meat in a stew pan, add one pound of broth, a like quantity of oil, a trifle of honey, and thus braise.

title: Recipe 763
text: meatballs, carefully prepared, arrange in a shallow stew pan and braise them in wine sauce afterwards serve them in the same sauce or gravy, sprinkled with pepper.

title: Recipe 764
text: the meat pieces are braised in broth and are glazed with hot honey and thus served.

title: Recipe 765
text: laser, ginger, cardamom, and a dash of broth crush this all, mix well, and cook the meat ball therein.

title: Recipe 766
text: cook in broth and oil, retire when half done soak boiled turnips, chop very fine and squeeze them in your hands so that they have no more moisture in them then combine them with the fish and let them simmer with plenty of oil and while this cooks, crush cumin, half of that amount of laurel berries, and, because of the color, add saffron bind with rice flour to give it the right consistency. add a dash of vinegar and serve.

title: Recipe 767
text: crush pepper, coriander seed, laser root, origany, rue, figdates, moisten with vinegar, oil, broth, adding reduced must, all this prepare and mix carefully, place in small casserole to heat. when thoroughly heated, pour over the fried fish, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 768
text: crush pepper, lovage, laurel berries, coriander, and moisten with honey, broth, wine, raisin wine, or reduced spiced wine cook this on a slow fire, bind with rice flour and serve.

title: Recipe 769
text: crush pepper, lovage, satury, dry onions, moisten with vinegar, add figdates, dill, yolks of egg, honey, vinegar, broth, oil, reduced must all this mix thoroughly and underlay.

title: Recipe 770
text: fry the fish crush pepper, lovage, rue, green herbs, dry onions, add oil broth and serve.

title: Recipe 771
text: crush pepper, lovage seed, origany, dry onions, hard boiled yolks, vinegar, oil this must be combined into one and underlaid.

title: Recipe 772
text: raw fish any kind you prefer, wash arrange in a sauce pan add oil, broth, vinegar, a bunch of leeks and coriander, and cook crush pepper, origany, lovage with the bunches of leeks and coriander which you have cooked and pour into the sauce pan. bring the residue in the sauce pan to a boiling point, allow it to reduce slowly to the right consistency sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 773
text: prepare the fish and place in a sauce pan, adding oil, broth, wine, bunches of leeks, coriander, place on fire to cook. put pepper in the mortar, pound it, add oil, and one part of vinegar and raisin wine to taste. transfer into a sauce pan, place on the fire to heat, tie with roux, add to the fish in the sauce pan. sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 774
text: scrape, wash, place in a sauce pan, add oil, broth, wine and a bunch of leeks and coriander to the mess, set on the fire to cook. crush pepper, lovage, origany, moisten with some of the fish s own liquor add raisin wine to taste, put it into a pot and on the fire to heat tie with roux and presently add it to the contents in the sauce pan sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Recipe 775
text: clean the fish and carefully place in a sauce pan. in the mortar put pepper, lovage, origany, mint, dry onions, crush, moisten with a small glass of wine, half of that of broth, and of honey one third part, and a moderate amount of reduced must, say a spoonful. it is necessary that the fish be entirely covered by this liquor so that there may be sufficient juice during the cooking.

title: Recipe 776
text: crush pepper, lovage, celery seed, pour in vinegar, broth, yolks of eggs, mix well together and dress and serve.

title: Recipe 777
text: crush pepper, lovage, celery seed, origany which moisten with vinegar add pine nuts, figdates in sufficient quantity, honey, vinegar, broth, mustard, mix and combine properly and bring forth.

title: Recipe 778
text: scale clean, place in a sauce pan, add broth, oil wine, a bunch of leeks and coriander seed, place on fire to cook, grind a little pepper, origany, moisten with the fish liquor. take 10 raw eggs, beat them and mix with the remaining liquor put it all back over the fish, and on a slow fire allow to heat and thicken to the right consistency sprinkle with pepper.

title: Recipe 779
text: roast the pig carefully make thus a mortar mixture pound pepper, dill, origany, green coriander, moisten with honey, wine, broth, oil, vinegar, reduced must. all of this when hot pour over sprinkle raisins, pine nuts and chopped onions over and so serve.

title: Recipe 780
text: take the pig, garnish cook it with oil and broth. when done, put in the mortar pepper, rue, laurel berries, broth, raisin wine or reduced wine, old wine, crush all, mix and prepare to a point dress the pig on a showy service platter and serve.

title: Recipe 781
text: roast the pig in its own juice retire bind the gravy with roux put in a sauce boat and serve.

title: Recipe 782
text: milk-fed pig, killed on the previous day, boil with salt and dill transfer it into cold water, carefully keeping it submerged, to preserve its whiteness. thereupon green savory herbs, thyme, a little fleabane, hard boiled eggs, onions, chopped fine, sprinkle everything and season with a pint of broth, one measure of oil, one of raisin wine, and so present it.

title: Recipe 783
text: garnish the pig correctly and place it in a liquor prepared as follows put in the mortar 50 grains of pepper, as much honey as is required, 3 dry onions, a little green or dry coriander, a pint of broth, 1 sextarius of oil, 1 pint of water put in a stew pan place the pig in it when it commences to boil, stir the gravy quite frequently so as to thicken it. should the broth thus be reduced add another pint of water. in this manner cook the pig to perfection and serve it.

title: Recipe 784
text: in the mortar pound pepper, lovage, carraway, a little cumin, live laser, laser root, moisten with vinegar, add pine nuts, figdates, honey, vinegar, broth, prepared mustard, finish with oil to taste, and pour over.

title: Recipe 785
text: in the mortar put pepper, lovage, or anise, coriander, rue, a laurel berry, pound, moistening with broth, leeks, raisin wine, or a little honey, a little wine, and a like amount of oil. when this has been cooked tie with roux.

title: Recipe 786
text: of the skinned lamb make small cutlets which wash carefully and arrange in a sauce pan, add oil, broth, wine, leeks, coriander cut with the knife when it commences to boil, stir very frequently and serve.

title: Recipe 787
text: the well-cleaned guts of a kid fill with pepper, broth, laser, oil, and put them back into the carcass which sew tightly and thus cook the kid. when done put in the mortar rue, laurel berries, and then serve the kid which meanwhile has been retired from the pot with its own drippings or gravy.

title: Recipe 788
text: crush pepper, laser, laurel berry, mix in cumin garum and stuff the thrush through the throat, tying them with a string. thereupon make this preparation in which they are cooked consisting of oil, salt, water, dill and heads of leeks.

text: open them, prepare carefully crush pepper, laser, a little broth, immerse the doves in this preparation so that it will be absorbed by them, and thus roast them.

title: Brossat
text: boil the snails with a few drops of vinegar. while they are boiling, skim off the froth with a spatula or colander.

title: Brou de carn
text: place a pot over heat with the meats covered in cold water. when it comes to a boil, reduce the heat and skim off any scum. after about an hour, add the vegetables and let it simmer for another hour. strain it and let it cool.

title: Brou i escorregut de perdius
text: make the meatball and dust it with flour. boil the partridges in water and salt. after about 1 hour, add the meatball, potatoes, and cabbage. after a while, add the chickpeas and adjust the seasoning with salt. strain the broth and make a soup with rice and pasta. serve the soup first, followed by the meat and vegetables.

title: Brou fosc de carn
text: brown the bones in oil or lard. once they are lightly browned, add the vegetables and sauté everything together. deglaze with wine and let it reduce. add cold water and simmer over low heat for 2 hours, skimming the surface frequently until a very concentrated broth is obtained.

title: Brou de gallina
text: place the chicken and bones in a pot with cold water. bring to a boil and simmer for an hour, skimming off any fat as it rises. add the vegetables and continue to simmer for another hour. season with salt and strain.

title: Brou de peix
text: bring the fish to a boil in cold water. once boiling, skim off any foam and add the vegetables. simmer for about 30 minutes.

title: Brou de peix vermell
text: make a well-reduced sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomatoes. add the monkfish and fish head and sauté everything together. deglaze with wine and let it reduce, then add water and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Brou de verdures
text: place all the vegetables in a pot and cover with cold water. bring to a boil and cook for about half an hour.

title: Empordà
text: dissolve the yeast in lukewarm milk. place the flour on a marble surface, forming a mound, and gradually incorporate all the ingredients except the oil and 50g of sugar. knead well for a good while until the dough is elastic and smooth, so that when stretched it doesn t break. form the dough into a ball, place it in a bowl, cover it with a cloth, and let it rest in a warm place for about two hours, until it doubles in volume. take pieces of dough and, using your fingers oiled with oil, shape them into rounds, make a hole in the middle, and fry them in hot oil. when golden brown on one side, turn them over. drain the doughnuts and sprinkle them with sugar.

title: Bufats del Vendrell
text: in a bowl, mix the sugar, chopped hazelnuts, and egg whites. then, add the flour until you have a relatively loose dough. roll out the dough and cut into small squares. place them on a baking sheet, brush with beaten eggs, and bake at 180 c. let them cool.

title: Bull de tonyina amb cargols
text: soak the bull in the refrigerator overnight. scrub it thoroughly with a stiff brush, rinse it, and cut it into 2 x 1 cm pieces. blanch the oxtail in boiling water for about 5 minutes, drain it, and rub it vigorously under running water repeat this process until the blanching water runs clear. place a pot over heat with the oil, and when it s hot, add the finely chopped vegetables with a little more oil. sauté the sofrito for a couple of minutes, stirring to prevent burning. add water, and when it comes to a boil, add the oxtail pieces cover and cook until the oxtail is tender. add the potatoes, a little salt, the cherry pepper, and the snails. when the potatoes are almost cooked, add the beans and stir, shaking the pot. adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper. the sauce should be quite thick.

title: Bunyols
text: put 1 cup of oil in a jar with boiling water and stir. let it cool and add flour, stirring constantly with the same hand until you get a dough that you can work with. shape the dough into very thin, round forms and fry them in abundant hot oil. drizzle the fritters with honey when they come out of the heat.

title: Bunyols d'albergínia
text: whisk together the flour, egg yolk, water, a few drops of oil, and salt, and work the dough until it s smooth and slightly thick. gently fold in the whipped egg whites. dip each piece of eggplant in the batter and fry.

title: Bunyols de bacallà
text: poach the salt cod and drain it. heat ¼ litre of water with butter and a pinch of salt. once boiling, quickly add the flour, stirring constantly until the dough forms a ball that pulls away from the sides of the pot. remove from heat and add the eggs one at a time, stirring with a spoon, being careful not to add another until the first is fully incorporated into the dough, which should be light but not liquid. add the shredded salt cod along with plenty of finely chopped garlic and parsley. take portions of the batter and fry them in a deep frying pan with plenty of hot oil. once the fritters are golden brown, place them on absorbent paper.

title: Peixos i mariscs
text: in a bowl, mix the flour, yeast, milk, and egg yolks. make a paste in a mortar or food processor with the shredded salt cod, garlic, and parsley, and add it to the bowl. beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form and add them to the mixture. form the dough into rounded portions and fry them in abundant, hot oil. drain the doughnuts on absorbent paper.

title: Bunyols de carbassó
text: dice the courgette, unpeeled, into small cubes, salt it, and let it drain for a while. add the minced garlic and stir. mix the egg, sparkling water powder, flour, and salt until you have a relatively thick batter. add the drained courgette and mix well. form small fritters and fry them in hot oil.

title: Bunyols de cervell
text: soak the brains in cold water for a while to drain the blood. make the batter with flour, egg, and salt. cut the brains into pieces, dip them in the batter, and fry them.

title: Bunyols de cigrons
text: blend the cooked chickpeas, milk, egg, cinnamon, lemon zest, and sugar until smooth. stir in the baking powder and continue mixing until a homogeneous, thick batter forms. drop spoonfuls of the batter into hot, abundant oil and fry until golden brown. as you remove them from the pan, immediately roll them in a mixture of sugar and cinnamon.

title: Carutx
text: brown the ribs and garlic head in a pot with lard and oil. remove any excess fat. season with salt and pepper, then add cinnamon and nutmeg. cover and simmer over low heat until the ribs are tender.

title: Carxofes a la brasa
text: cut the artichoke stems and, holding them by the base, blanch them until they open. rinse them and drain upside down, then place them on the grill with the leaves facing downwards. after a while, turn them over, leaves facing upwards, and season the inside with salt, oil, and black pepper. cook for another 30 minutes, or until thoroughly cooked.

title: Cassola amb carbassa i bolets
text: season the pork ribs and brown them in a paella. meanwhile, sauté the mushrooms over high heat with a little oil. once the ribs are browned, transfer them to a pot. add the garlic, parsley, pumpkin, and a little water. cover the pot and bring to a boil. after a while, add the mushrooms and simmer until the pumpkin is tender.

title: Cassola de fideus amb anguila
text: make a sofrito with the oil, onion, bell pepper, garlic, bay leaf, and tomatoes. when it s well caramelized, add the white wine and let it reduce add water and, when it comes to a boil, add the noodles. about 5 minutes before it's done, stir in the finely chopped parsley and top with the previously salted eel slices.

title: Cassola de tros
text: fry the salted pork belly, ribs, and longanissa sausage in a large pot. once the meat is browned, add the garlic, onion, peppers, and eggplant, all chopped into pieces, along with thyme and chili pepper. after a few minutes, add the tomato and cook for another 5 minutes. next, add the peeled or roughly chopped potatoes and the spinach. simmer for about 15 minutes. when the potatoes are almost cooked, add the black pudding.

title: Ceba arrebossada
text: fried aubergines with onions it's made like fried aubergines, but with peeled and sliced onion, salted, after having rested for 20 minutes in a colander.

title: Ceba al cop de puny
text: roughly chop the onion with the flat of your knife. peel it and then finely chop it. season with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.

title: Cebes farcides
text: roast the onions wrapped in aluminum foil until tender. sauté the meat in a pot with oil, stirring to prevent it from clumping add the prunes, pine nuts, raisins, and chopped apple. deglaze with the stale wine and let it reduce. simmer until the meat is tender. scoop out the onions, stuff them with the meat, and bake.

title: Cervells de vedella arrebossats
text: blanch the cleaned brains, veins and all, in water with salt, onion, bay leaf, and marjoram. slice them, lightly flour them, and dip them in beaten egg. fry the slices in hot oil.

title: Cervells de xai arrebossats
text: clean the brains and slice them. flour them and dip them in beaten egg. fry the slices in hot oil.

title: Cigrons amb bacallà i espinacs
text: clean and wash the spinach in two or three waters, drain it, and chop it. sauté the garlic, bell pepper, and tomatoes in a pot with olive oil. add the chickpeas, spinach, and chickpea cooking broth. stir the pot and when it comes to a boil, add the salt cod and let everything finish cooking together.

title: Cap de cabrit al forn
text: halve the cabbage and season with salt and pepper. drizzle with oil and roast in the oven on a baking sheet. when golden brown, add the onion, bay leaf, and tomatoes, and let everything roast together, basting the cabbage occasionally with the cooking juices. towards the end of the cooking time, sprinkle with minced garlic and parsley mixed with breadcrumbs. drizzle with a little more oil and return to the oven until the cabbage is golden.

title: Carbassons arrebossats
text: slice the zucchini into rounds. soak them in salted water for a while. drain, pat dry, dip in flour and beaten egg, and fry in hot oil.

title: Cigrons amb bolets
text: soak the snails. sauté garlic and parsley in a pot with olive oil. add the snails and some of the strained soaking water, and let it cook until the snails are tender. add the chickpeas with a little of their cooking liquid and chopped parsley, and bring to a boil.

title: Cigrons bullits
text: soak the chickpeas in water with salt or baking soda for 12 hours. rinse them and place them in a pot to cook, covering them with mineral water. when they come to a boil, reduce the heat to a very low simmer. the chickpeas must not lose their simmer during cooking. if needed, add boiling water. season with salt at the end.

title: Cigrons amb espinacs
text: clean and wash the spinach in two or three waters. brown the salted pork belly in a paella with oil, then add the onion and garlic. when the onion is browned, add the chopped spinach, season with salt, and stir the sofrito. add the chickpeas with a little of the cooking broth and let it simmer together for a while.

title: Cigrons amb gambes
text: season and fry the prawns in a pan with oil set aside. in the same oil, make a sofrito with minced garlic, tomatoes, and chopped parsley. add the cooked and drained chickpeas, stirring them gently with the sofrito over low heat. top with the prawns and drizzle with alioli thinned with the cooking liquid from the chickpeas. add a little of the chickpea broth and let it simmer together until the flavors meld.

title: Cigrons amb pataca i calamar
text: fry the calamari rings in a pot with hot oil. once browned, add the onion and sauté until golden. add the red pepper, garlic head, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. when the garlic head is golden, add the tomatoes. when the sofrito is ready, add the wine and let it reduce pour in the fish broth and, when it comes to a boil, add the potatoes. let them boil for 15 minutes, remove the garlic head, and add the chickpeas cook for a couple more minutes. nutritional information this is a very energetic and nutritionally rich dish, as it is an important source of both vegetable and animal proteins, complex carbohydrates, fats, and a wide variety of vitamins and minerals. squid is particularly important nutritionally because it provides highly digestible proteins of high biological value, unsaturated omega 3 fatty acids, as well as many vitamins and minerals calcium,

title: Cigrons amb suc
text: make a sofrito with the onion and tomato in a saucepan. once softened, add the old wine and let it reduce. stir in the crushed garlic with a little water, the chickpeas, and a little of their broth, so they are lightly covered. finally, add the halved hard-boiled eggs.

title: Cim i tomba
text: make a sofrito with the oil, onion, garlic, and tomatoes in a pot. add water and potatoes, and let it cook. when the potatoes are halfway cooked, add the fish, previously salted. once the fish is cooked, remove the pot from the heat and cover with alioli. shake the pot so the bottom is on top and vice versa.

title: Civet de cabra Hispànica
text: cut the meat into roughly 20g dice, reserving any juices released. marinate it for 12 hours with the onions, carrots, apples, and tomatoes, all roughly chopped, along with the remaining ingredients. bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer until the meat is tender. stir in the finely chopped mixture just before serving and cook for another 5 minutes over low heat. serve in a shallow dish with the sauce spooned over the top.

title: Civet de cérvol
text: marinate the venison for 24 hours in red wine, vegetables, and herbs. remove the meat and drain it well, reserving the marinade. season the meat with salt and pepper, lightly flour it, and brown it in a paella with oil. place the meat in a heavy-bottomed pot. drain the vegetables and sauté them in the same oil used for the meat. add them to the pot with the meat along with the marinade liquid. simmer over low heat, covered, until the meat is tender. add hot water or meat broth if needed. towards the end of cooking, add the peeled pearl onions and let everything finish cooking together.

title: Civet d'isard
text: marinate the gurnard for 24 hours in red wine, vegetables, and herbs. remove the fish, drain it well, reserving the marinade liquid. season the fish with salt and pepper, lightly flour it, and fry it in a paella pan with oil. transfer the fish to a heavy-bottomed pot. drain the vegetables and sauté them in the same oil used for the fish. add them to the pot with the fish, along with the reserved marinade liquid. simmer gently, covered, until the fish is tender. add water or hot meat broth if needed. towards the end of cooking, add peeled baby onions and let everything cook together until done.

title: Civet de porc senglar
text: marinate the wild boar in red wine, vegetables, and herbs for 24 hours. remove the meat and drain it well, reserving the marinade. season the meat with salt and pepper, lightly flour it, and brown it in a paella pan with oil. transfer the meat to a heavy-bottomed pot. drain the vegetables and sauté them in the same oil used for the meat. add them to the pot with the meat, along with the marinade liquid. simmer over low heat, covered, until the meat is tender. add hot water or meat broth if needed. towards the end of cooking, add peeled shallots and let everything cook together until done.

title: Peixos i mariscs
text: simmer the clams in a little water, in a covered pot, and strain the broth. make a sofrito with the onion and tomato, add the wine and let it reduce, then stir in the flour and cook for a few minutes. moisten with the clam broth and let it cook for 10 minutes. add the clams and the chopped parsley, and cook for another 5 minutes.

title: Peixos i mariscs
text: soak the clams in water and salt for 2 hours to remove any sand. clean them. place them in a large pot with the bay leaf, peppercorns, and halved lemon. once the clams open, remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Closca de carbassa confitada
text: boil the pumpkin rind with water and sugar until the pumpkin pieces are well candied. stir frequently and add water as needed to prevent the sugar from caramelizing.

title: Clotxa
text: cut the bread in half and scoop out the insides, reserving them. meanwhile, grill the onions, garlic, and tomatoes. grill the anchovies. peel all the grilled vegetables, removing any skins, seeds, and bones, then stuff the bread with the mixture. dress with a generous drizzle of oil, ensuring it soaks into the bread, and top with the reserved breadcrumbs.

title: Cóc d'avellana
text: whisk the egg yolks with the sugar until pale and creamy. stir in the hazelnut flour and cornstarch, then gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. pour the mixture into a buttered baking tin and bake in a preheated oven at moderate temperature for about 20 minutes.

title: Cóc amb cireres
text: whisk the egg, 5 fl oz of oil, mistela wine, and the yeast dissolved in a little water. add the flour and work it until it forms a smooth dough. cover the dough and let it rise until doubled in size. roll it out very thinly into an oval shape, and pleat the edges all around. arrange the cherries closely over the dough, sprinkle with sugar, and drizzle with a generous amount of oil. bake until cooked through.

title: Cóc de maçana agredolça
text: beat the eggs, 150g of sugar, anise, and yeast dissolved in milk. add the flour and work it until you have a dough that isn't too firm. let it rest for a couple of hours to allow it to rise. roll the dough into an oval shape and arrange the unpeeled, quartered apples on top, very close together, with the skin facing outwards, covering the entire surface. drizzle with a little oil, sprinkle with the remaining sugar and a pinch of cinnamon. bake in a preheated oven at 170 c for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden and the apples begin to brown.

title: Cóc ràpid
text: beat the eggs and sugar in a bowl, then add the oil, milk, and flour, mixing well. stir in the grated lemon zest and yeast, and mix again. bake in a preheated oven at 175 for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Cóc de sagí
text: cream the lard with the sugar. add the egg yolks and gradually incorporate the flour until you have a smooth, pliable dough that is easy to work with. roll it out to a thickness of 1 cm. using cookie cutters, cut out shapes as desired hearts, stars, triangles, etc. brush the cookies with beaten egg white and sprinkle with sugar. place them on a baking sheet and bake in the oven until golden brown.

title: Coca de iogurt
text: make a dough with flour, eggs, sugar, yeast, yogurt, and oil. mix well, add lemon zest and aniseed, and continue working it until you achieve a smooth, homogenous dough. place it on a plate greased with oil in a preheated oven at 170 c until cooked through.

title: Coca de codony
text: mix 100g of oil, beer, flour and salt until you have a dough that doesn t stick to your fingers. roll out the dough and place thinly sliced raw quince on top. drizzle with a little oil and sugar, then bake in a preheated oven at 170 c for about 30 minutes.

title: Coca de recapte
text: dissolve the yeast in warm water and add the salt. make a well with the flour and mix in the yeast. knead until you have a smooth dough and let it rest, covered with a cloth, until doubled in size. sauté the onion and tomatoes. roll out the dough into an elongated shape, about 6-8 inches wide, and spread the sautéed vegetables evenly over it. season with salt, top with pickled herring, and drizzle with olive oil. bake the flatbread until the crust is cooked through.

title: Coca d'espinacs i pinyons
text: dissolve the yeast in warm water and add the salt. make a well with the flour and mix in the yeast. knead until you get a smooth dough and let it rest, covered with a cloth, until it doubles in size. blanch the spinach briefly. in a frying pan with olive oil, lightly toast the pine nuts, then add the spinach and raisins. season with salt and pepper. roll out the dough into an elongated shape, about 15 to 20 cm wide, and spread the spinach, raisins, and pine nuts evenly over it. season with salt and drizzle with a little olive oil. bake the flatbread until the dough is cooked through.

title: Coca fina
text: make an infusion with celery seed, lovage, and lemon peel. strain the herbs and mix them with the oil, flour, salt, and yeast dissolved in a little water. work it until you have a homogenous dough and let it rest until it doubles in volume. shape it into balls and let them rise for a while longer. flatten the balls with your hands and place them on a baking sheet. bake them and, when they come out, sprinkle them with sugar.

title: Coca de forner
text: to make the sourdough starter, combine the flour, salt, and yeast dissolved in lukewarm water. knead the dough well to incorporate air and let it rest, covered with a cloth, for 12 to 24 hours, depending on room temperature. make a circle with the flour and in the center, add the sugar, yeast dissolved in a little water, oil, salt, and the sourdough starter. work the ingredients in the center first, then gradually incorporate the flour, kneading vigorously until the dough no longer sticks to your fingers. divide it into two portions and let it rest for 2 hours in a dry, draft-free place. roll out the dough into oval shapes. brush with oil, sprinkle with pine nuts, and then sugar. bake in a preheated oven at 230º for about 20 minutes. when you take the ovals out of the oven, drizzle with anise.

title: Coca de llardons i pinyons
text: whisk together 3 eggs, oil, 100g of sugar, and the yeast dissolved in a little warm water. gradually add the flour until a smooth dough forms. stir in the crumbled bacon and anise. roll the dough out on an oiled baking sheet. brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with the remaining sugar and pine nuts. let it rest to rise and become spongy. bake in a preheated oven at 180 for about 25 minutes.

title: Coca d'oli
text: dissolve the yeast in the water, add the flour and knead well. add the salt, oil, and sourdough starter, and continue kneading until the dough comes away from the surface. divide the dough into two portions and let it rest for 2 hours until doubled in volume. roll out each portion of dough into a diamond shape, prick it all over with a fork, and bake in a hot oven for about 20 minutes.

title: Coca de pinyons
text: heat the milk with the cinnamon stick to infuse it with flavor. mix the flour with the yeast, sugar, eggs, butter, lemon zest, and milk. work it until you have a smooth dough. roll the dough into an oval shape, brush it with beaten egg, and sprinkle with pine nuts and sugar. let it rest for 15 minutes at room temperature and bake in a preheated oven until golden brown. nutritional information these desserts are very caloric and nutritious, providing carbohydrates, protein, and fat. despite their high content of saturated fat and cholesterol, pine nuts are a good source of monounsaturated fats, which help regulate blood cholesterol levels. they are also rich in phosphorus and b vitamins, especially b12, which are very important for the proper functioning of the nervous system and the formation of tissues and red blood cells in the body. nutritional composition per serving water 98.2 energy 75

title: Coca de Sant Joan
text: dissolve the yeast in a little warm milk. add 3 tablespoons of flour and knead until smooth let it rise until doubled in size. make a well on a marble surface with the flour and place the butter, eggs, sugar, salt, lemon zest, and anise in the center. work the ingredients in the center by hand or with a fork, add the fermented dough, and continue kneading with the flour until you have a smooth, compact dough. roll it out on a baking sheet greased with oil or butter. it should be about 1 cm thick and oval in shape. brush with egg and arrange the candied fruits, cut into pieces, on top, and let it rise until doubled in size. sprinkle with pine nuts and sugar, and bake in a preheated oven at 180 for about 20 minutes.

title: Cócs a la cassola
text: whisk together the eggs, milk, oil, anise, 100g of sugar, and lime zest vigorously. add the flour, baking powder, and soda water, and work until a compact dough forms. cut the dough into pieces, shape them into small churros, and join the ends to form small, ring-shaped discs with a hole in the middle. let them rest for a while, then fry in plenty of hot oil and sprinkle with the remaining sugar as you remove them from the heat.

title: Codonyar
text: peel the quinces, chop them finely in a food processor, place them in a cheesecloth and squeeze out the juice. if the juice isn't clear enough, you can filter it again. mix a quarter of a liter of quince juice with three-quarters of a liter of brandy. add a little cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg to taste, pour into bottles, seal them, and after 5 or 6 days it can be drunk. it's important to mix the liquids quickly, otherwise the juice will oxidize and turn very dark. if desired, after 4 or 5 days, you can remove the spices.

title: Codonyat
text: quarter the quince and boil in water for about 20 minutes. weigh the quince pulp and place it in a saucepan. for every kilogram of quince pulp, add 800g of sugar. cook over heat, stirring constantly, for about 40 minutes, until it turns reddish. pour into jars to cool.

title: Col confitada
text: clean the cabbage by removing the outer leaves, leaving the rest intact drain them. lay the cabbage leaves on a cloth to dry for 3 days. place them in a glass jar and add vinegar until they are covered. cover and store for at least 15 days. remove the amount of cabbage you need always making sure the liquid covers the remaining cabbage and soak it in water for a couple of hours to remove excess vinegar.

title: Col amb fesols
text: clean, chop, and wash the cabbage. boil it in salted water. fry the botifarra and cànsalada in a paella with oil until browned, and set aside. in the same oil, fry the garlic cloves. when they start to turn golden, add the drained cabbage and sauté for a moment. then add the meat and beans, stir well, and season with salt to taste.

title: Trinxat de la Cerdanya
text: boil the potatoes and cabbage in salted water until almost falling apart. in a paella, brown the diced cured pork belly in oil and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the well-drained potatoes and cabbage, stirring and mashing them together. when serving, top with the cured pork belly.

title: Coliflor arrebossada
text: boil the cauliflower. slice the cauliflower into rounds. dip it in beaten egg and flour, then fry in hot oil.

title: Colomins a la cassola
text: clean, char, and peel the potatoes, quarter them, and season with salt and pepper. fry the cured pork belly in a pot with a little oil, then add the potatoes, cured ham, and onions. once fried, add the bay leaf, cinnamon, and tomatoes. when softened, pour in the stale wine and brandy and let them reduce. sprinkle with flour, cook for about 5 minutes, stirring, and add a little water. cover the pot and simmer over low heat until the meat is tender.

title: Colomins amb moixernons
text: clean, lightly char, and wash the snails. make a broth by boiling the morels in water, drain them, and reserve both the mushrooms and the broth. season the snails with salt and pepper, inside and out, and brown them in a pot with oil and lard. add the peeled onions and, a little later, the diced ham. pour in the strained morel broth with a pinch of salt and let it simmer until everything is tender and the sauce has reduced. just before serving, add the morels. adjust seasoning with salt and serve with a slice of fried bread under each piece, garnished with the mushrooms and sauce around.

title: Confitat
text: season the pork loin, ribs, and ham shank lightly, and let them rest in the refrigerator for a few days to drain all the water and blood. hang the sausages in a dry place and let them dry slightly. cut all the meat into pieces and sear them briefly in a pot with equal parts oil and lard. reduce the heat and confit the meat until it is well cooked. place it in a earthenware crock or glass jars. tap the base of the jar before sealing it to release any possible air bubbles. let the oil from cooking the meat cool slightly, then pour it over the confit and seal the jars the meat should be covered with a layer of oil or fat.

title: Confitat amb salsa de tomàquet
text: render a little of the preserved fat in a pan with onion, tomato, and garlic, all finely chopped. season with salt and pepper, and when the mixture has reduced, add the meat cut into regular pieces. cook for about 10 minutes.

title: Confitura de tomàquet
text: blanch the tomatoes, peel them and remove the seeds. place them in a saucepan with the sugar, cinnamon, and 1 cup of water, and let it cook, stirring occasionally, until it resembles a jam.

title: Congre amb pèsols
text: sauté the onion in a pot with oil, add the flour, stir well, and then add water. once boiling, add the peas and then the eel, previously salted. at the end of cooking, stir in the chopped parsley.

title: Conill amb escamarlans
text: season and flour the rabbit pieces and brown them in a pot with oil, then set aside. in the same oil, fry the prawns and set them aside. make a sofrito with onion and tomato. add the rabbit, flambé with brandy, and cover with water. let it simmer, and when there are 10 minutes remaining, stir in the prawns and the chopped parsley with stale wine.

title: Conill amb olives trencades
text: brown the rabbit in a pot with oil. add the onions, carrot, leek, thyme, and bay leaf. once everything is softened, add the white wine and let it reduce. add water and let it simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes before finishing the cooking, add the crushed olives. season with salt and pepper at the end.

title: Conill a l'agredolç
text: brown the seasoned rabbit pieces in a pot with oil, lard, a bay leaf, and oregano. make a light syrup with the sugar and vinegar in a frying pan, and pour it over the rabbit. continue cooking over very low heat with the pot covered. season with salt to taste and let it cook until the rabbit is tender, stirring occasionally.

title: Conill a la brasa
text: cut the rabbit into quarters, season with salt and pepper. grease it with oil and place it on the grill over medium heat. halfway through cooking, turn the pieces and brush them with oil to prevent them from drying out.

title: Conill a la brasa dels caçadors
text: dress, gut, and clean the rabbit, salt it, and place it on the grill. skewer a piece of cured pork belly wrapped in larding paper and light the paper so that it slowly melts, dripping fat over the rabbit and basting it during cooking.

title: Conill a la caçadora
text: fry the garlic, liver, and a slice of bread in a pot with oil and lard. grind these fried ingredients together with almonds in a mortar. in the same pot, brown the salted rabbit and shallots. add water or meat broth and when it boils, add the herbs and mushrooms. let it simmer gently and when there are 10 minutes remaining, stir in the ground mixture with stale wine.

title: Conill amb cargols
text: flour and season the rabbit pieces with salt and pepper, and brown them in a pot with oil and lard. set them aside and, in the same oil, sauté the onion, garlic, and tomatoes. add the rabbit, cleaned and purged snails, salt, a bouquet of herbs, and enough water to cover. simmer until the rabbit is tender. with 10 minutes left, add the chopped parsley with a little of the cooking broth.

title: Conill farcit
text: make the stuffing with lean meat, chopped egg, well-drained bread, raisins, salt, and pepper. stuff the rabbit with this mixture and sew it up. place it on a plate greased with oil, with onions around it, and roast it in the oven. when the rabbit is browned, add the stale wine and let it reduce. finish cooking it in the oven, adding water if necessary, and baste it occasionally with the cooking juices. disassemble the rabbit, strain the sauce, and put everything in a saucepan with the finely chopped garnish. let it cook for another 10 minutes and season with salt and pepper.

title: Conill amb fredolics
text: brown the diced and seasoned rabbit in a pot with oil and lard, along with bay leaf and onion. flame with brandy, add water, and let it simmer. when it's halfway cooked, add the sautéed mushrooms and the chopped parsley left with a little of the cooking liquid. simmer together over low heat until the rabbit is tender.

title: Conill al jaç
text: brown the salt-seasoned rabbit with the bacon and oil, along with the garlic, bay leaf, and cinnamon stick. once browned, add the wine and let it reduce, then add a little water and simmer gently with the lid on. when there are 10 minutes left of cooking, stir in the chopped mixture.

title: Conill amb moniato
text: brown the salted rabbit pieces in a pot with oil and set aside. sauté the onion, carrot, leeks, tomatoes, and a bouquet of herbs in the same oil. add the rabbit, pour in the wine and let it reduce. dust with flour and stir for a couple of minutes. moisten with a little water and let it simmer slowly. peel the sweet potatoes and fry them lightly. add them to the pot 10 minutes before the end of cooking. season with salt and pepper.

title: Conill amb naps
text: brown the salted rabbit pieces in a pot with oil and set aside. make a sofrito in the same oil with onion, carrot, leeks, tomatoes, and a bouquet garni. add the rabbit, pour in the wine and let it reduce. dust with flour and stir for a couple of minutes. moisten with a little water and let it simmer gently. blanch, flour and fry the turnips, then drain them. add them to the pot 10 minutes before the end of cooking. season with salt and pepper.

title: Conill ofegat a la cassola
text: in a pot, combine all ingredients while they are cold. seal the pot and cook over very low heat for about three-quarters of an hour, shaking the pot occasionally to prevent sticking. season with salt to taste.

title: Conill amb pebrot i tomaca
text: brown the seasoned rabbit in a pot with oil and lard, then set aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion, bell pepper, and tomato. add the rabbit back to the pot and cover with water. simmer over low heat, and about 15 minutes before the cooking is finished, stir in the finely chopped mixture. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Conill amb peres i naps
text: brown the seasoned rabbit pieces in a pot with oil and set aside. make a sofrito in the same oil with onion, carrot, leeks, tomatoes, and a bouquet garni. add the rabbit, pour in the wine and let it reduce. dust with flour and stir for a couple of minutes. moisten with a little water and let it simmer gently. blanch, flour and fry the pears and turnips and drain them. add them to the pot 10 minutes before the end of cooking. season with salt and pepper.

title: Conill i pollastre amb samfaina
text: brown the rabbit and chicken, seasoned with salt and pepper, in a casserole dish with oil. drain the oil and add chopped tomatoes and a splash of water. simmer for 30 minutes. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Conill amb prunes
text: brown the rabbit pieces, bay leaf, and a head of garlic in a pot with oil and lard. once the rabbit is browned on all sides, cover the pot and let it simmer over low heat until tender, stirring occasionally, and adding a little water if needed. fifteen minutes before the end of cooking, add the dried plums that have been previously soaked.

title: Carns
text: brown the seasoned rabbit pieces in a pot with oil and set aside. make a sofrito in the same oil with onion, carrot, leek, tomatoes, and a bouquet of herbs. add the rabbit, pour in the wine and let it reduce. dust with flour and stir for a couple of minutes. moisten with a little water and let it simmer gently. add the raw grapes to the pot 10 minutes before the end of cooking. season with salt and pepper.

title: Conill rostit
text: brown the rabbit pieces, bay leaf, and head of garlic in a pot with oil and lard. once the rabbit is browned on all sides, cover the pot and let it simmer over low heat until tender, stirring occasionally, and adding a little water if needed.
