title: Conill amb samfaina
text: brown the seasoned rabbit in a pot with oil. remove the oil and add the tomato and a splash of water. let it cook for 30 minutes. season with salt and pepper.

title: Conill amb xocolata
text: fry the slices of toasted bread, rabbit liver, and garlic in a pot with oil. grind them together in a mortar with saffron, dried fruits, and chocolate. in the same oil, brown the rabbit pieces seasoned with salt and pepper. add the bouquet garni, garlic, and onions. when the onions are golden brown, add the wine, let it reduce, and then add water. towards the end of cooking, stir in the ground mixture with a little of the cooking liquid. let it simmer for a while longer, ensuring the sauce thickens. season with salt and pepper. remove the bouquet garni and cinnamon and serve in the same pot.

title: Coquetes de mel
text: mix all the liquids with the sugar, then with the flour, until a consistent dough forms. take small portions of the dough, roll them out thinly, and fry them on both sides. once cooled, drizzle with honey.

title: Coradella amb allioli
text: fry the diced lung and heart in a pot with oil and set aside. in the same oil, fry the liver and blood, also diced, and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the garlic, onion, tomato, bay leaf, and marjoram. add the wine and let it reduce. stir in the flour and cook for a couple of minutes. gradually add water, then add the lung and heart, and let it simmer gently. once tender, add the liver and blood and cook everything together for a little longer. season with salt and pepper. serve with alioli.

title: Corder amb carxofes
text: brown the lamb pieces in oil, then add the onion. season with salt and let it simmer, covered, over low heat. almost at the end of the cooking time, add the artichokes. if the artichokes are not very tender, blanch them for a few minutes beforehand.

title: Costella de porc amb castanyes
text: boil the chestnuts for about 20 minutes and peel them. roast the salted and peppered pork ribs in a pot with a little oil or lard and set aside. in the same pot, make a sofrito with onion, minced garlic, and tomatoes. once softened, add the pork ribs and a little water. simmer over low heat, adding the chestnuts halfway through cooking until the meat is tender. at the end of the cooking time, stir in the finely chopped parsley with a little water and cook for another 5 minutes. season with salt and pepper to taste. serve on a warm plate the pork ribs in the center, the chestnuts around, and the sauce drizzled over the top.

title: Costella de porc amb mongetes
text: in a paella pan, fry the ribs over medium heat until golden brown on the outside and cooked through season with salt. place the cooked beans on a plate, drizzle with the oil from cooking the ribs, and arrange the pieces of rib around the beans.

title: Costella de porc amb samfaina
text: season the ribs and fry them in oil until nicely browned drain them. add them to a cocotte and let them cook until the ribs are tender.

title: Costella de vedella ofegada amb patates
text: brown the ribs in a paella pan with oil and transfer them to a pot. in the same oil, sauté the finely chopped onion, garlic, and parsley with a bay leaf. add the wine and let it reduce. pour this over the ribs and cover with water, season with salt, and simmer gently. after about two hours, add the potatoes and cook until tender. season to taste and serve in the same pot.

title: Costelló de porc rostit
text: brown the seasoned pork ribs in a pot with a little oil. once browned, add the onion, garlic, marjoram, and tomatoes. flame with cognac and add a little water. simmer until the meat is tender, stirring occasionally. season with salt to taste.

title: Crancs de riu
text: make a sofrito with the onion, garlic, rosemary, and tomato in a pot with lard. once cooked, add the crab and wine and let it simmer over high heat for 5 minutes. add water if needed.

title: Crema de Sant Josep
text: bring the milk to a boil with the cinnamon and lemon zest. in a bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and sugar. stir in the strained milk and dissolved cornstarch. return the mixture to the heat, stirring constantly with a whisk until it comes to a boil, then immediately remove from heat. pour the custard into plates or individual ramekins and let it cool. before serving, sprinkle with sugar and caramelize with a very hot iron griddle or flat pan.

title: Crespells d'arengada
text: soak the herring in water overnight. make the batter with flour and egg. drain the herring, pat them dry, and coat them in the batter, then fry them in hot oil.

title: Crespells de borraina
text: clean the chard leaves and drain them well. make a dough with flour, water, and a pinch of salt. pass each leaf through the dough and fry them in plenty of oil until golden brown. place them in a platter and sprinkle with sugar or honey. they should be eaten freshly made.

title: Crespells de flor de carbassera
text: make a dough with flour, salt, egg, sugar, and a little water. dip the flowers in this dough and fry them in hot, abundant oil. drain them on absorbent paper and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Crespèths
text: in a bowl, combine the eggs, flour, salt, and yeast. gradually add the milk until you have a fairly liquid batter. let it rest for 30 minutes. grease a frying pan with butter and, when it s very hot, pour in a spoonful of the batter. lower the heat, let the crêpe cook on one side, then flip it. once cooked on both sides, sprinkle sugar over it. repeat with the remaining batter. lower the heat, let the crêpe cook on one side, then flip it. once cooked on both sides, sprinkle sugar over it.

title: Crestes de la figuera
text: boil the potatoes with their skins on, peel them, and mash them. mix in the egg and flour to form a dough. on a lightly oiled surface, place a spoonful of the mixture, shape it into a ball, and flatten it into a disc. place a little filling in the center and close it in the shape of a half-moon. fry the turnovers in plenty of oil until golden brown on both sides and serve immediately.

title: Croquetes d'abadejo
text: poach the salt cod, remove the bones, and flake it. boil the potatoes in the same water used to poach the cod, and then pass them through a food mill. pound the salt cod in a mortar. in a bowl, combine the flaked cod, finely chopped garlic and parsley, mashed potatoes, and egg yolks. mix everything together well with your hands. on a floured surface, shape the mixture into croquettes. dip them in beaten egg white and fry in moderately warm oil.

title: Croquetes de carn d'olla
text: chop the meat and vegetables. fry them in a paella and add a little flour, stirring constantly. then add milk, continuing to stir until a thick mixture forms. season with salt to taste. pour the mixture onto a plate and let it cool. shape into croquettes and coat them in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs. fry in plenty of oil until golden brown.

title: Croquetes d'ou
text: peel and cut the hard-boiled eggs into wedges. dip the egg wedges in a lightly warmed béchamel sauce, ensuring they are coated on all sides. then, dredge them in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs, in that order. fry in hot, abundant oil. drain the croquettes on a paper towel and serve immediately.

title: Croquetes de pernil
text: sauté the onion with butter in a saucepan until softened, then stir in the flour and cook for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. gradually add the boiling milk, salt, pepper, and nutmeg, stirring constantly. add the ham and cook the mixture for another 10 minutes. pour the mixture onto a plate and let it cool in the refrigerator. once cold, shape the mixture into croquettes, coating them in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs. fry in hot, abundant oil until golden brown. aim for a crispy exterior and a creamy interior.

title: Croquetes de pollastre
text: chicken croquettes make them like pork croquettes, but using cooked chicken instead of pork. ingredients 500g cooked chicken, shredded 100g onion, finely chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 50g butter 50g flour 500ml chicken stock 100ml milk 2 egg yolks nutmeg, to taste salt and pepper, to taste breadcrumbs, for coating 2 eggs, beaten instructions 1. sauté the onion and garlic in butter until softened. 2. add the flour and cook for a couple of minutes, stirring constantly. 3. gradually add the chicken stock, stirring until the sauce thickens. 4. stir in the milk, egg yolks, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. 5. add

title: Cua de bou a la cassola
text: cut off the tail of beef by separating the vertebrae, season with salt and pepper, lightly flour it, and brown it in a pot with lard or oil. add the vegetables and herbs and let it cook over medium heat. when the vegetables are golden brown, add the wine and enough water to cover, cover the pot, and let it cook until the meat is tender. remove the pieces of tail, place them in another pot, and pour the sauce over them. let it cook for a few more minutes. adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.

title: Arròs Clareta
text: escalivada treu els pebrots, la banya i la ceba del forn. pela'ls i talla'ls a tires gruixudes. posa'ls en una safata, rega-ho amb oli d'oliva verge extra, sala i pebre negre al gust. cou les anxoves en vinagre. escorre-les i posa-les a la safata amb les hortalisses. talla el pa ratjat a tires i posa-ho damunt de les anxoves. cou-ho al forn durant 5-10 minuts, o fins que el pa estigui daurat i cruixent. reposa una mica abans de servir.

title: Ametlles ronyoses
text: candied almonds ingredients 500g almonds 250g sugar 125ml water lemon zest instructions 1. in a saucepan, combine the sugar and water. 2. bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until the sugar is completely dissolved. 3. add the almonds and lemon zest to the saucepan. 4. cook, stirring constantly, until the syrup thickens and begins to crystallize around the almonds. this will take approximately 10-15 minutes. be careful not to burn them. 5. remove from heat and spread the almonds onto a sheet of parchment paper to cool and separate. 6. once cool, store in an airtight container.

title: Enrempinyades
text: candied almonds ingredients 500g almonds 250g sugar 150ml water pinch of salt instructions 1. in a saucepan, combine the water and sugar. heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely. 2. add the almonds and salt to the saucepan. 3. bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently, until the syrup thickens and coats the almonds. this will take about 15-20 minutes. be careful not to burn them. 4. remove from heat and spread the almonds in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. 5. separate the almonds with a fork as they cool to prevent them from sticking together. 6. let them cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

title: Guirlatxo
text: candied almonds ingredients 500g almonds 200g sugar 100ml water lemon zest instructions 1. place the almonds in a saucepan and cover with cold water. bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes. drain well. 2. in a clean saucepan, combine the sugar and water. heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely. 3. add the almonds and lemon zest to the syrup. 4. continue cooking over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the syrup thickens and coats the almonds. this will take about 10-15 minutes. the almonds should become a golden-brown color. 5. remove from heat and spread the almonds out on a sheet of baking paper to cool completely. once cool, separate the almonds.

title: Reganyores
text: candied almonds ingredients 500g almonds 200g sugar 150ml water lemon zest instructions 1. in a saucepan, combine the sugar and water. heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar is completely dissolved. 2. add the almonds and lemon zest to the saucepan. 3. increase the heat to high and cook, stirring constantly, until the water has evaporated and the sugar begins to caramelize. 4. continue stirring until the almonds are evenly coated in a golden-brown caramel. be careful not to burn them. 5. remove from the heat and spread the almonds onto a sheet of baking paper to cool completely, separating them as they cool to prevent them from sticking together.

title: Pèsols negres
text: soak the peas the day before in water with a little bicarbonate of soda. boil them with the onion, herbs, ham bone, and a little salt, until tender. fry the salt pork in a paella pan until it releases its fat. add the drained peas, minced garlic, and parsley to the paella pan. stir well and cook over heat for a moment.

title: Pèsols ofegats
text: stew the onion over low heat in a pot with a little oil until it begins to soften. add the peas and cover the pot with a plate filled with water. simmer over low heat until the peas are cooked, shaking the pot occasionally.

title: Pets de monja
text: beat the eggs with the sugar until pale. add the lemon zest and flour, and mix with a spatula. place the mixture in a piping bag fitted with a small, smooth nozzle and pipe small mounds onto a baking sheet greased with butter or lined with baking parchment. bake at 180 c until the pastries are dry and lightly golden.

title: Xulles amb fesols
text: season and fry the trotters in a pot. when they are lightly browned, add the chopped onion and whole garlic cloves, herbs, and pepper. once everything has taken on some color, add the beans with a little of their broth and let them simmer over low heat.

title: Xuixos
text: knead all ingredients except butter, sugar, and cream until a smooth, elastic dough forms that doesn t break when stretched. let it rest in a cool place. roll the dough into a cross shape, place the butter in the center, and fold it into thirds. immediately flatten the dough to a thin thickness. cut it into squares of about 40g each and roll them out to 25cm. fill them with cold cream and roll them into a cylinder, ending in a small point, being careful not to let the cream escape. let them rise in a warm place until they double in volume. fry them in hot, abundant oil. once cooked and drained, sprinkle with sugar.

title: Xocolata desfeta
text: melt the chocolate in the warm milk. simmer gently, stirring constantly, until thickened.

title: Xató
text: clean, wash, and drain the chicory thoroughly. blanch the artichoke hearts and remove the pulp. grind the dried fruits, garlic, and artichoke pulp in a mortar. add a slightly squeezed breadcrumb and stir slowly, gradually adding the oil until you reach the desired quantity and consistency. the sauce should be thick. season the chicory with the sauce, stirring to ensure everything is well combined, and garnish with salted cod and olives. drizzle a little more sauce over the top.

title: Verat xapat
text: remove the heads from the eels and open them along the back, from top to bottom. remove the spine and the innards, and clean them. once clean, soak them in brine for 24 hours and drain. rub them with a little oil, then with freshly ground black pepper and sweet paprika, in that order. finally, hang the eels in a shady, dry, and airy place until they are completely dry. once dried, they can be stored for a long time.

text: sauté the cured pork belly and cured ham in a pot with oil. add the onion, tomatoes, and a handful of herbs. when the sofrito is concentrated, add the tripe and water, and let it simmer slowly with the pot covered. towards the end, add the beans and chopped parsley.

text: sauté the oil, onion, and tomato. add the flour, diced belly pork, and prunes. cover with hot water and let it cook for half an hour. add the chopped parsley when there are 10 minutes left to finish cooking.

title: Ventre de porc amb pèsols

text: clean the pork belly thoroughly, slice it into strips, blanch it, and drain. fry it with oil in a paella pan until it s lightly browned. add the minced garlic and parsley and sauté for a couple of turns until they are also fried.

title: Vedella amb peres
text: season and roast the round cut of beef in a pot with oil. add the onion and half the pears, quartered and unpeeled. boil the remaining pears with the cinnamon stick and water. add the pear cooking broth to the beef. slice the meat and serve it with the boiled pears around and the strained sauce poured over.

text: boil the meat until tender. drain it and marinate it in the vinaigrette for a couple of hours. arrange the endive, tomatoes, and beef all chopped on a platter and drizzle everything with the vinaigrette used to marinate the meat.

text: once cleaned of fat and membranes, wash and slice the snails and snails into fairly thick rounds. season with salt and pepper and sauté in a paella with hot oil. when they begin to brown, add the garlic and then the parsley, all chopped.

title: Trumfada
text: boil the peeled potatoes in water and salt. drain them and mash with a fork. add milk until you reach a mashed potato consistency. season with salt to taste.

title: Truita de xicoies
text: clean and wash the samphire thoroughly, drain it, and place it in a hot paella pan with oil. quickly add the beaten eggs seasoned with salt. cook the omelet.

title: Truita de xanguet
text: sauté the blood sausage in a paella with oil. season it and add the beaten eggs. mix everything together and make the omelet.

title: Truita amb trampa
text: whisk the flour with the milk until smooth, free of lumps. beat the eggs, mix them with the milk and flour, and add the chopped garlic and parsley. in a paella with hot oil, pour in the mixture and stir until it is well set. once cooked on one side, flip it over to cook the other side.

title: Truita de tonyina
text: in a paella pan with hot oil, pour in the beaten eggs seasoned with salt. once the eggs are halfway set, add the drained and flaked tuna. fold it over like a french omelet.

title: Truita de tirabecs
text: season and fry the potato sticks until golden brown. drain the oil and mix the potato sticks with beaten eggs and salt. make a round omelet, first over low heat on one side, ensuring the mixture sets then flip it over to cook the other side.

title: Truita de tavelles de faves
text: season and fry the sliced artichokes until golden brown. drain the oil and mix the artichoke slices with beaten eggs seasoned with salt. make a round omelet, first over low heat on one side, ensuring the mixture sets then flip it to cook the other side.

title: Truita amb suc
text: sauté the vegetables and stir in the flour in a deep paella pan. cook for another 5 minutes, then add the water. let the sauce thicken and add the cut cod. simmer over low heat for a while longer.

title: Peuda
text: soak the trotters and ears for at least 24 hours. bring the feet to a boil with water and herbs. after an hour, add the ears and trotters, and continue to simmer for another two hours. meanwhile, in a separate pan, make a sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomatoes. add the flour, cook for a couple of minutes, stir, and moisten with the cooking liquid from the feet. once the feet, ears, and trotters are cooked, add them to the sofrito pan. season with salt to taste and let it cook together for a while, adding broth from the pork cooking liquid if it gets too dry. just before serving, add hard-boiled eggs cut in half.

title: Truita de samfaina
text: whisk the diced onion with the beaten eggs and a pinch of salt. pour it into a paella pan and stir until set. flip the omelet so that it cooks on the other side.

title: Peus de cabrit arrebossats
text: peel and wash the potatoes. boil them in salted water until tender. drain, season with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs. fry until golden brown.

title: Truita de rostillons
text: fry the cubed cured pork belly until dry. remove any excess fat. beat the eggs with salt, add them to the paella pan and make an omelet.

title: Truita de riu amb salsa d'ametlles
text: clean the trout and season with salt. dip them in milk and flour, then fry them in oil, ensuring they are cooked through and golden brown on the outside. drain and arrange them on a warm plate. in a frying pan, melt some of the drained oil with butter. once melted, fry the almonds until golden brown. sprinkle the almonds over the trout.

title: Truita de riu amb panses i pinyons
text: clean, salt, and place a sprig of thyme inside the trout. flour them and fry in very hot oil, then set aside. make a sauce in a saucepan with a little oil, garlic, and tomatoes, and add the dried fruit. place the trout in the saucepan with a little water and let it simmer over low heat for a few minutes together.

title: Peus de cabrit a la llauna
text: make a well-reduced sofrito with olive oil, onions, and tomatoes. add the flour and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring. place the sofrito in a dish, top with boiled goat s feet, and cover with breadcrumbs and alioli seasoned with a little of the cooking broth. bake in the oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Truita de riu escabetxada
text: season, flour, and fry the river trout, then set aside in a separate casserole. in the same oil, fry the garlic cloves until golden. add the paprika, vinegar, and bay leaf, and let the vinegar reduce. add a little water and bring to a boil for about 4 minutes. pour this sauce over the river trout and let them marinate for a few hours.

title: Truita de riu al forn
text: clean and season the trout. stuff them with a slice of cured ham and secure with toothpicks. roast the salted onions and potatoes in an oiled baking dish until they are almost cooked through. place the trout on top, along with a bay leaf, rosemary, lemon juice, and white wine. finish cooking in the oven.

title: Peus de cabrit amb pinyons i pèsols
text: boil the trotters in salted water, drain them, flour them, dip them in beaten egg, fry them, and set aside. make a sofrito with onion and tomatoes in a saucepan with oil. when reduced, add the trotters, pine nuts, and a little of the cooking broth, and let it simmer gently. at the last moment, add the peas and finely chopped parsley with stale wine.

title: Truita de riu a l'agredolç
text: season, flour, and fry the trout. remove a little oil from the paella, moisten the trout with vinegar and let it reduce by half. then add the honey and a little water, and let it cook for 1 minute more.

title: Recipe 3565
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella 250 g de carn de porc 150 g de cansalada viada 1 peu de porc salat 1 os de falça 2 patates mitjanes 1 pastanaga gran 1 branca d enesca 1 4 de col 1 xirivia 1 porro 1 cogombre 1 2 kg de mongetes seques sal i pebre negre al gust unes fulles de julivert picat per a servir opcional 1 ou per persona elaboració 1.
ingredients: escudella catalana ingredients vedella porc de cansalada viada peu porc patates mitjanes pastanaga gran branca d col xirivia porro cogombre pebre al gust fulles julivert

title: Carns
text: simmer the feet with the thinly sliced onion, carrot, leek, bay leaf, parsley, 2 whole garlic cloves, pepper, cloves, and salt. drain them, flour them, and fry them in a saucepan with oil. set aside. in the same oil, sauté the remaining onions and garlic, and the tomato. when the mixture is well concentrated, add the wine and let it reduce. stir in a tablespoon of flour, mix well, and add the feet. add the dried ham, a little of the broth from cooking the feet, and chopped parsley. let it cook together for about 10 minutes. season with salt and pepper.

title: Truita de patates
text: fry the potatoes in hot but not excessive oil until tender, then drain the oil. beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and add them to the potatoes. make a round omelette, first over low heat on one side, ensuring the mixture sets then flip it to cook the other side.

title: Peus de porc a la brasa
text: brush the soles with oil, coat them with a thin layer of breadcrumbs, and place them on a hot grill. when they are marked on one side, turn them. leave them on the grill for a moment longer, then remove.

title: Truita de Pasqua
text: fry the salted pork belly slowly, add the sliced sausages, tender garlic, and parsley. stir well. make a round omelet.

title: Truita de mongetes i botifarra
text: sauté the beans with oil, garlic, and chopped parsley. add the sliced botifarra, then the beaten eggs, and scramble until the first layer is set. flip to cook the other side.

title: Peus de porc amb cargols
text: dredge and fry the pig's trotters, then place them in a pot. in the same oil, make a concentrated sofrito with onion and tomato. add it to the pot with the trotters and cover with the broth from boiling them. add the snails, cured ham, and chili pepper, and let it simmer together for about 20 minutes. when there are 10 minutes left, add the chopped parsley with a little of the cooking broth.

title: Truita amb mel
text: beat the eggs with the salt, flour, and milk. in a frying pan with oil, make a round omelet. once made, drizzle honey over the top.

title: Truita de riu a la llosa
text: heat two flat stones. away from the fire, place on one stone, in this order, a slice of salted pork belly, the egg, and another slice of salted pork belly, and cover with the other stone. when the stone is cool, the egg will be cooked.

title: Peus de porc amb castanyes
text: dredge and fry the pork trotters in a pot with oil, and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion and tomato. boil the chestnuts for about 20 minutes and peel them. add the pork trotters to the sautéed vegetables with the lemon zest and the chestnuts, cover with water, and simmer gently until the chestnuts are tender.

title: Truita a la francesa
text: beat the eggs and season with salt. in a paella pan with a little very hot oil, pour in the beaten eggs and shape the omelette into an elongated form with pointed ends, turning it as it cooks. it should be cooked on the outside and runny on the inside.

title: Peus de porc amb escamarlans
text: lightly fry the broad beans in a pot and set aside. in the same oil, make a concentrated sofrito with onion and tomatoes. add the flour, cook it slightly, stirring constantly, then add the muscat wine and water. when it comes to a boil, add the pig's trotters and cook for about 10 minutes. add the broad beans and the chopped parsley with some of the cooking juices and let it simmer for a while longer. season with salt to taste.

title: Truita de formatge fos
text: in a paella pan with hot oil, pour in the beaten eggs seasoned with salt. when the eggs are halfway set, add the cheese. roll it up like a french omelet.

title: Truita de farina
text: make a smooth dough with flour, salt, and water. place it in a paella with oil, stir until it sizzles, and cook the fritatta.

title: Truita d'espinacs
text: sauté the roughly chopped spinach in a little oil. mix with beaten and salted eggs. make an omelet.

title: Truita de Dijous Llarder
text: fry the salted pork belly gently, then add the sliced sausages, tender garlic, and chopped parsley. stir well to combine. add the beaten eggs with a little salt and make a round omelet.

title: Peus de porc farcits amb bolets
text: chop the mushrooms and sauté them with oil, a little minced garlic, and parsley. in another paella, make a sofrito with 2 onions and when they are golden brown, add the mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. debone the trotters, stuff half with the mushrooms, top with the other half and wrap them with the caul fat. flour them and fry until golden brown. in a separate saucepan, make a concentrated sofrito with the other 2 onions, carrots, and tomatoes. add the stale wine and let it reduce, cover with the broth from boiling the trotters and let it cook together for about 30 minutes. put the trotters in a saucepan with the strained sauce and chopped herbs, and let it cook for 10 more minutes. season with salt and pepper.

title: Truita de Dijous Gras
text: fry the salted pork belly gently, then add the sliced sausages, tender garlic, and parsley. stir well. make a round omelet.

title: Peus de porc amb gambes
text: sauté the shrimp lightly in a pot and set aside. in the same oil, make a concentrated sofrito with the onion and tomatoes. add the flour, cook it slightly while stirring, then add the muscatel and water. when it comes to a boil, add the pork trotters and cook for about 10 minutes. add the shrimp and the chopped parsley, along with the cooking juices, and let it simmer for a while longer. season with salt to taste.

title: Truita de crostillons
text: fry the diced cured pork belly until it's dry. remove any excess fat. beat the eggs with salt, add them to the paella and make an omelet.

title: Truita amb ceba
text: gently fry the onion in oil until it becomes translucent, then drain it well. whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and mix them with the onion. in a paella pan with a little hot oil, cook the frittata as you would a french omelette. nutritional information this dish is very rich in high-quality protein and vitamin b12, making it very suitable for periods of growth such as childhood and pregnancy, but also when building muscle. however, eggs are also very rich in fat, especially cholesterol, so it is necessary to avoid exceeding their consumption and limit them in people with high cholesterol or a history of cardiovascular disease. on the other hand, the onion provides moderate amounts of fiber and vitamins to the dish. serving size 1 egg person nutritional composition per serving water 22 energy

title: Peus de porc a la llauna
text: make a well-reduced sofrito with oil, onions, and tomatoes. add the flour and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring. place the sofrito in a dish, top with boiled pork trotters, and cover with breadcrumbs and alioli seasoned with a little of the broth from cooking the trotters. bake in the oven for about 10 minutes.

title: Truita de carxofa
text: season and fry the sliced artichokes until golden brown. drain the oil and mix the artichokes with beaten eggs seasoned with salt. make a round omelet, first over low heat on one side, ensuring the mixture sets then flip it to cook the other side.

title: Truitada de carreretes
text: in a paella pan, sauté the garlic with the cured pork belly. clean the snails and add them to the sofrito, being careful not to overcook them. remove any excess oil from the paella, then add the beaten eggs and chopped parsley. make an omelet.

title: Truita de carbassó
text: fry the zucchini sliced thinly. drain well and mix with beaten eggs and a little salt. in a hot frying pan with oil, make one large round omelet or 4 small, spiral-shaped omelets.

title: Truita de botifarra d'ou
text: slice the botifarra sausage. whisk the eggs with salt and add the botifarra. make a round omelet in a frying pan with oil.

title: Peus de porc amb llenegues
text: brown the pig s trotters, rinse them, and boil them with onion, a bouquet garni, black peppercorns, and salt. once boiled, drain them. in a pot, make a sofrito with onion and tomato, add the pig s trotters and stale wine, and let it reduce for a minute. add a little of the cooking broth and simmer until tender. sauté the tripe in a paella pan with a little oil and minced garlic and add it to the pot. add the finely chopped parsley, season with salt and pepper, and cook over the heat until the tripe is cooked.

title: Recipe 3592
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a daus 1 2 kg de carn de porc a talls grossos 250 g de canelons secs 100 g de fesols de santa pau secs 2 patates mitjanes 1 porro 1 branca d'api 1 pastanaga 1 4 de col 1 xirivia 1 tall de gallina sal i pebre negre al gust oli d'oliva verge extra preparació 1. la nit abans, posar a remull els fesols de santa pau. 2. en una olla gran, escalfar una mica d'oli d'oliva a
ingredients: branca pastanaga col xirivia gallina sal pebre al gust oli d'oliva verge

title: Peus de porc amb moscatell
text: in a saucepan with oil, sauté the onion until golden brown. add the flour and cook for a moment, stirring constantly. pour in the white wine and let it reduce, then add a little of the broth from the trotters. bring to a boil. add the trotters to the sauce and let everything simmer together until the sauce thickens. season with salt to taste.

title: Truita de bolets
text: sauté the mushrooms with the chopped parsley season with salt. add the beaten eggs and make an omelet.

title: Peus de porc amb naps negres
text: make a sofrito with the onion and tomato in a saucepan with a little oil. dredge the trotters in flour and fry them, then add them to the sofrito. flambé with cognac and add a little of the cooking broth from the trotters and chopped parsley. peel, blanch, flour, and fry the turnips. add them to the saucepan with the trotters and let the mixture simmer for about 20 minutes. season with salt to taste.

title: Truita de bacallà, alls i juliverts
text: fry the chopped garlic slightly, add the well-drained salt cod, and then the chopped parsley. let it sauté together, mix with beaten eggs, and make an omelet.

title: Peus de porc amb pinyons i pèsols
text: start by sautéing the onion, garlic, bay leaf, and tomato in a pot with oil. when it s softened, add the wine and let it reduce. stir in the flour and cook for a moment. add the snails, a little of the cooking broth, and the chopped parsley with a bit more broth season with salt. once it comes to a boil, add the peas and cook until the peas are done.

title: Truita d'alls tendres
text: peel and chop the spring onions into small pieces. gently sauté the spring onions until they take on some color, then add the chopped parsley. mix with beaten eggs and a little salt, and make an omelet.

title: Truita d'all i julivert
text: peel and chop the garlic finely. mix with beaten eggs, chopped parsley, and a little salt, then make an omelet.

title: Peus de porc amb prunes
text: dust and fry the trotters. make a sofrito with onion and tomatoes in a saucepan with oil. when it s well caramelized, add the trotters, a little of the cooking broth, the prunes, and chopped parsley, and let it simmer for about 30 minutes. serve with garlic aioli drizzled over the top. season with salt to taste.

title: Truita d'albergínia
text: slice or dice the eggplant and fry it. salt it, drain it, and mix it with well-beaten eggs. cook the omelet in a paella with hot oil.

title: Peus de porc amb samfaina
text: dust and fry the pig s trotters. place the pig s trotters in a pot with the samfaina and let them simmer for about 20 minutes over low heat, shaking the pot occasionally to prevent sticking.

title: Truita d'espàrrecs de marge
text: season and fry the trimmed asparagus until golden brown. drain the oil and mix the asparagus with the beaten eggs seasoned with salt. make a round omelet, first over low heat on one side, ensuring the mixture sets then flip it to cook the other side.

title: Peus i tripa de xai
text: in a pot with oil, sauté the onion, tomatoes, garlic, and bay leaf. add the trotters and tripe and continue to sauté everything together. pour in the wine and let it reduce, then add water and simmer until the trotters and tripe are tender. stir in the chopped parsley, moistened with a little wine, 10 minutes before the end of cooking.

title: Pijama
text: place a scoop of ice cream, a slice of pineapple, two pieces of peach, a crème brûlée, and a dollop of whipped cream on each plate.

title: Pilota arrebossada
text: slice the meat from the escudella and carn d olla, dip them in beaten egg and flour, then fry them.

title: Pilotilles amb mantellina
text: make small meatballs with the meat, eggs, garlic, salt, and chopped parsley. wrap them in caul fat and fry them.

title: Recipe 3608
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 1 2 kg de carn de porc a trossos 1 4 kg de cansalada fumada 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 2 kg de mongetes seques 1 col gran 2 patates mitjanes 1 pastanaga gran 1 porro 1 branca d'api 1 2 repeny de tallarines o fideus sal i pebre negre al gust un raig d'oli d'oliva verge extra elaboració 1. en una olla gran, posem l'oli d'oliva i sof
ingredients: cansalada fumada porc mongetes col gran patates mitjanes pastanaga porro branca
fideus sal pebre al un raig d'oli d'oliva verge

title: Faves tendres
text: in a paella or large pan, fry the cubed salted pork. add the tender broad beans, cut into pieces to help them cook evenly. when they are halfway cooked, add finely chopped tender garlic and a few sprigs of parsley and mint.

title: Fesols amb bacallà
text: dredge and fry the salt cod, then remove it. in the same oil, make a sofrito with minced garlic, parsley, tomato, and red pepper. add the beans, the salt cod, and a little water, and let it simmer gently for a while.

title: Fesols amb patates
text: in a pot, boil the beans in a small amount of water. when they are about 20 minutes away from being cooked, add the peeled potatoes. season with salt at the end of the cooking time and serve dressed with a generous drizzle of olive oil.

title: Fetge amb ceba
text: slice the onion thinly and sauté it in a paella pan with oil until golden brown. slice the liver and fry it so that it remains juicy inside. serve the liver with the sautéed onions as a side dish.

title: Fetge de porc amb ceba
text: fry the sliced pork liver, seasoned with salt and pepper, in a large paella with a little oil set aside. in the same oil, sauté the chopped onion and garlic until golden. add the wine and let it reduce. deglaze with water, add the liver and let it simmer together for a few minutes. taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.

title: Fetge de vedella amb ceba
text: fry the sliced veal liver, seasoned with salt and pepper, in a wide, shallow pan with a little oil set aside. in the same oil, sauté the chopped onion and garlic until softened. add the wine and let it reduce. deglaze with water, add the liver and let it simmer together for a few minutes. taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed.

title: Fideuada
text: in a paella, sauté the prawns and shrimp over high heat set aside. in the same oil, make a sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomato. add the diced cuttlefish and, when it begins to soften, add the water. when it comes to a boil, add the noodles, let it simmer over low heat, and just before serving, top with the prawns and shrimp.

title: Fideus a la cassola
text: brown the pork ribs, sausage, and rabbit, all cut into pieces, in a pot with a little oil. add the onion, tomato, and garlic and sauté until softened. once done, add water, peas, and bay leaf. when it comes to a boil, add the noodles, stir, and let it simmer gently. halfway through cooking, add the crushed breadcrumbs mixed with a little of the cooking broth.

title: Fideus amb escamarlans i sipia
text: sauté the prawns in a pot and set aside. in the same oil, fry the cuttlefish and make a sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomatoes. once the sofrito is ready, add the water and, when it comes to a boil, add the noodles. before the cooking is finished, add the peas, chopped parsley, and prawns. the noodles should be in a broth-like consistency.

title: Fideus amb ganyims
text: sauté the onion, garlic, and peeled, chopped tomatoes in a pot with oil. once softened, add the paprika and potatoes, stir well, and then add water. bring to a boil, then add the snails, parsley, and noodles. cook until the noodles are done. add hot water if needed the noodles should be in a broth.

title: Fideus mariners
text: clean the sardines by removing the heads and innards, rinse them, and salt them. make a well-caramelized sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomatoes in a pan with olive oil. toss the noodles with the sofrito and let them brown slightly. add hot water and chopped parsley. season with salt to taste and let it cook until the pasta is al dente. add the sardines on top about 5 minutes before it s finished.

title: Fideus amb pop i pèsols
text: poach the fish in water with salt. make a sofrito with onion, tomato, and red pepper in a saucepan with oil. add the pasta, flaked fish, and chopped parsley, and sauté everything together for a moment. cover with hot water and when it comes to a boil, add the peas and cook until the pasta is done.

title: Fideus rossejats
text: fry the noodles in a paella pan until golden brown and drain off any excess oil. add the hot broth, season with salt, and let it cook until the noodles are done. if necessary, add more broth during cooking.

title: Figues amb nous
text: take a piece of walnut and place it inside a fig.

title: Flam
text: in a saucepan, caramelize 150g of sugar with a little water until it s a deep golden brown, then spread it evenly on the bottom of some molds. bring the milk to a boil. whisk the eggs and mix them with the strained milk. fill the molds with the mixture and bake them in a water bath until set.

title: Flam d'avellanes
text: grind the hazelnuts and boil them with water. let it sit for a few hours and strain this hazelnut milk. mix the milk and hazelnut milk and bring it back to a boil. beat the eggs with 250 g of sugar and add them to the milk, stirring constantly. make a caramel with 150 g of sugar and place it at the bottom of the molds. fill the molds with the liquid and bake in a water bath until set.

title: Flaones
text: to make the custard, heat the milk with the lemon peel and cinnamon stick. dissolve the flour in a little cold milk. whisk the egg yolks with the sugar, then add the thickened flour and the strained hot milk. place the custard over heat and continue stirring with a whisk until it thickens, but without letting it boil, and then remove from the heat. make a well in the flour and add the remaining ingredients, along with the yeast dissolved in a little water. knead the dough until it is flexible, then form it into 50g portions, shaped like balls. roll out these pieces into an oval shape. place custard in the center of each pastry, brush the edges with egg yolk, and fold over, pressing the edges firmly together. brush the pastries with egg yolk and bake in a preheated oven at 220 c for about 20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Freginat
text: fry the blood sausage and liver in a deep paella pan with oil and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion and garlic. add a little water, the blood sausage and liver, and season with salt. cover and simmer over low heat until tender.

title: Freixura
text: cut the veal and heart into cubes, season with salt, and place in a pot with oil. add the onion, tomatoes, garlic, herbs, orange peel, and stale wine. cover the pot and simmer over low heat, shaking it occasionally to prevent sticking. add water or meat broth as needed during cooking.

title: Recipe 3628
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella 1 2 kg de carn de porc 1 4 kg de fesols de santa pau 1 4 kg de civada 1 porro 2 cebes 2 tomàquets madurs 1 branca d'api 1 pastanaga 1 patata gran 1 os de pernil salat 1 2 repenyinet de julivert sal i pebre negre al gust oli d'oliva verge extra preparació 1. remenar els fesols de santa pau durant la nit en aigua freda. 2. en una
ingredients: escudella catalana ingredients vedella porc fesols santa pau civada porro tomàquets madurs branca d'api pastanaga patata salat repenyinet julivert sal pebre al gust oli d'oliva verge

title: Fricandó de carn magra de porc
text: soak the mushrooms in water for a couple of hours. season the meat with salt and pepper, then flour and fry it, setting it aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion and tomato. add the meat, flambé with brandy, and immediately reduce the white wine. cover with water and let it simmer for a good while. drain the mushrooms, lightly coat them in flour, and add them to the pot. when there are 10 minutes left, add the finely chopped parsley.

title: Recipe 3630
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 1 2 kg de carn de porc a trossos 1 4 kg de cansalada viada 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 branca d arròs rodó 150 g de mongetes seques 1 porro 2 pastanagues 1 branca de fenoll 1 4 repollo 1 patata gran 1 xirivia 1 2 kg de naps 1 4 kg de carbassó 1 ceba 1 tomàquet madur oli d oliva verge extra sal

title: Pistonat
text: sautéed fideos this dish is a significant source of complex carbohydrates, providing a high energy value. pasta is therefore a recommended food in the regular diet, particularly for children, adolescents, people with high physical activity, or during periods of recovery, when energy needs are greater. please note that pasta is rich in gluten and is therefore not suitable for those with celiac disease. nutritional information water 7.9 energy 384 protein 10.7 total fat 11.8 total carbohydrates 56.9 dietary fiber 4 saturated fat

title: Carns
text: season and pepper the duck and place it to roast in a casserole dish with a little oil over low heat, allowing it to render its fat. once browned, set aside and remove the excess fat. in the same casserole dish, sauté the onion and tomato. when the mixture is well concentrated, add the duck and the bouquet garni, moisten with water and let it simmer gently. meanwhile, peel and boil the black turnips whole. peel the pears and boil them with the wine, sugar, lemon zest, and cinnamon stick. when the duck is almost cooked, add the turnips, pears, and some of the cooking wine, and let it cook for a little longer. season with salt and pepper to taste. arrange the duck on a warm platter with the pears and turnips around it, and pour the sauce over the top.

title: Platillo de costellló de porc amb naps
text: brown the pork ribs in a pot with the lard and set aside. in the same fat, sauté the minced garlic and parsley and the tomatoes. add the flour, stir for a moment, and add the pieces of pork ribs. cover with water and let simmer gently until the ribs are tender. meanwhile, peel, boil, flour, and fry the turnips. when there are 20 minutes left for the ribs to finish cooking, add the turnips to the pot.

title: Platillo de menuts amb bolets
text: blanch the chicken feet, peel them and trim the nails. clean and season the remaining giblets. in a pot with oil and lard, brown the necks, wings, feet, and gizzards, and set aside. fry the liver and set aside. make a sofrito with the onions and tomatoes in the same fat, and when it s well concentrated, add the necks, wings, feet, and gizzards. cover with water, simmer gently, and 15 minutes before it s cooked, add the liver, mushrooms, and finely chopped parsley.

title: Platillo de menuts de gallina
text: peel and boil the turnips, cut them, flour them, and fry them. brown the duck giblets in a pot with oil and set aside. in the same pot, sauté the onion and tomato. season with cinnamon and marjoram, and reduce the cognac. add the giblets, peeled chestnuts, and water to cover. simmer until cooked, then add the turnips and chopped parsley about 10 minutes before the end.

title: Carns
text: peel and boil the turnips, then flour and fry them. brown the duck giblets in a pot with oil and set aside. in the same pot, sauté the onion and tomato. season with cinnamon and marjoram, and reduce the cognac. add the giblets, peeled chestnuts, and water to cover. simmer until almost done, then add the turnips and chopped parsley.

title: Platillo de pollastre amb mandonguilles i bolets
text: make the meatballs with beef and pork, egg, breadcrumbs, minced garlic and parsley, salt and pepper. coat them in flour and fry. separately, season and brown the chicken and set aside. in the same pot, make a sofrito with onion, minced garlic, tomato, thyme, and bay leaf when ready, add the chicken. add the old wine and let it reduce, cover the chicken with water and let it simmer. when it s halfway cooked, add the mushrooms and meatballs, and just before finishing cooking, add the finely chopped parsley with a little cooking liquid. cut the chicken into quarters and arrange it on a warm plate with the meatballs and mushrooms around it, and pour the sauce over the top.

title: Platillo de pollastre amb tripa de bacallà
text: season and brown the chicken pieces in a pot with oil, then set aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion, minced garlic, and tomato. add the chicken back to the pot and add a little water, then simmer gently. when it s almost done, add the shredded and chopped salt cod, and let it cook over low heat until the chicken and cod are cooked through. arrange the chicken pieces on a warm platter with the cod around it, and pour the sauce over the top.

title: Platillo de vedella amb carbassó
text: season and flour the steaks, then fry them in a pan with oil and set aside. flour and fry the zucchini, and set it aside as well. in the same oil, sauté the onion until softened, then add the meat. pour in the wine, let it reduce, and add water to cover. when the stew is almost cooked, add the chopped parsley and zucchini. let it simmer together until the meat and zucchini are cooked through.

title: Platillo de xai amb pèsols
text: brown the seasoned lamb pieces in a pot with lard and set aside. remove some of the fat and in the same pot, make a concentrated sofrito with onion and tomato. return the lamb to the pot, add the stale wine and let it reduce. cover with water and let it simmer gently until tender. about 10 minutes before the end, add the peas and continue cooking until they are done. arrange the lamb pieces in a crown on a warm plate, with the peas in the center and the strained sauce over the top.

title: Plat dels traginers
text: dredge and fry the salt cod, and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion. add the crushed tomatoes with a little water and simmer for 5 minutes. add the salt cod and beans. simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes.

title: Pollastre rostit a la cassola
text: season the chicken pieces and brown them in a pot with oil and lard in equal parts. add the onions, a head of garlic, and a bay leaf. cover, reduce the heat, and let it simmer until the chicken is tender, adding a little water if needed.

title: Pollastre rostit a la cassola amb castanyes
text: season and brown the whole chicken in a pot with oil. add the onions, oregano, and a head of garlic. pour in the wine and let it reduce. cover the pot and simmer over low heat until the chicken is cooked through, adding a little water occasionally. when there are about 15 minutes left of cooking time, add the chestnuts and cook together.

title: Pollastre rostit i escaldums
text: dissect the chicken into breasts, thighs, wings cut in half, giblets, saddle, feet, neck, gizzard, intestines, and comb. blanch the feet and peel them set aside. wash the intestines and gizzard and marinate them in water and salt for 12 hours set aside. season all the chicken pieces with salt and pepper and brown them in a pot with oil and lard. add the onions, tomatoes, garlic, marjoram, and rosemary, and continue cooking. add the white wine and let it reduce remove the blanched ingredients halfway through cooking. place the blanched ingredients in another pot, add water and a chopped mixture of almonds, and let them cook until tender.

title: Pollastre empanat
text: marinate the chicken for half a day with oil, salt, pepper, and lemon juice. strain the marinade and set aside. dredge the chicken in flour, then cook it in an oiled pan over very low heat, basting it with the reserved marinade juice until cooked through.

title: Pollastre a l'ast
text: roast the chicken until browned and crispy, then wash it. season with salt and pepper and stuff some of the herbs inside. skewer the chicken lengthwise and secure it. rub it with oil and the remaining aromatic herbs. place it on the spit over a tray below allow the chicken to rotate slowly and baste it occasionally with the juices that collect in the tray. serve with a salad of endive or chicory, or both.

title: Pollastre amb bolets
text: make a litre of broth with the neck, feet, and giblets of the animal. brown the seasoned and floured chicken pieces in a casserole dish with oil, and set aside. in the same casserole dish, make a sofrito with onion, minced garlic, and tomato. when the sofrito has colour, add the chicken and a bouquet of herbs. add the stale wine, let it reduce, and moisten with the broth you made earlier. cover and simmer until halfway cooked, then add the sautéed mushrooms with garlic and parsley.

title: Pollastre amb escamarlans
text: season, flour, and brown the chicken pieces in a pan with oil, then set aside. in the same oil, fry the prawns and set them aside. make a sofrito with onion and tomato. add the chicken, flambé with brandy, and cover with water. let it simmer, and when there are 10 minutes left, add the prawns and the chopped parsley with sherry.
