title: Pollastre farcit
text: clean the chicken and debone it, removing the wishbone. season it inside and out with salt and pepper. in a paella with oil, brown the lean meat and sausages cut into cubes. mix the cooked meats and dried fruits. stuff the chicken with this mixture and sew it up at the shoulder to restore its original shape. brown the chicken on all sides in a large, deep, heavy-bottomed pot with oil and lard. add quartered onions, whole garlic cloves, and quartered tomatoes. once everything has browned, add the bay leaf, cinnamon, brandy, and wine. cover and simmer for about two hours, basting the chicken with the cooking sauce from time to time. serve whole with the sauce on the side.

title: Pollastre amb mandonguilles i rovellons
text: make the meatballs by mixing all the ingredients, flour them, and fry them. season the chicken pieces and brown them in oil and lard. add the onion and, when softened, stir in a little flour. reduce the red wine and add a little water. separately, sauté the chanterelle mushrooms with garlic and parsley. when there are 10 minutes left to finish cooking the chicken, add the meatballs and chanterelle mushrooms and let everything cook together.

title: Ànec amb vinagreta
text: partridge with vinaigrette ingredients 4 partridges, cleaned and drawn salt and freshly ground black pepper 150g lard or olive oil 1 onion, finely chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 100ml dry white wine 50ml sherry vinegar 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme 100ml chicken stock instructions 1. season the partridges inside and out with salt and pepper. 2. heat the lard or olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. brown the partridges on all sides. remove from the pan and set aside. 3. add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
ingredients: ground black pepper lard or olive oil onion
minced 100ml dry white wine sherry vinegar fresh parsley chopped fresh thyme 100ml chicken stock instructions

title: Pollastre a la manresaneta
text: in a paella, brown the salt-seasoned chicken with a little oil, including the crest and liver, and transfer it to a casserole dish. in the same paella, sauté the olives and add them to the chicken. also in the same paella, fry the cured ham, sauté the onion, tomato, and parsley, and add everything to the chicken. sprinkle the flour over the casserole dish, stir well, and let it cook gently until the chicken is very tender add a little water or broth if it seems too dry. just before finishing, add the chopped garlic soaked in stale wine.

title: Pollastre amb prunes i pinyons
text: season the chicken and brown it in a pot with oil, lard, and a cinnamon stick. add the onions, bay leaf, and a head of garlic, and let it sizzle together. pour in the brandy, flame it, let it reduce, and add the thyme. cover the pot and let it simmer over low heat, adding a little water occasionally. fifteen minutes before turning off the heat, add the soaked prunes and pine nuts.

title: Pollastre amb samfaina
text: brown the seasoned chicken in a pot with oil. remove the oil and add the tomatoes and a splash of water. let it cook for 30 minutes. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Poma farcida de crema
text: peel and core the apples. place them in a baking dish and sprinkle with sugar. drizzle with muscatel wine, and add a cinnamon stick and lemon peel. bake in a preheated oven at 170 c until tender. once cooked, fill them with st. joseph s cream.

title: Pomes al forn
text: core the apples and place them in a baking dish. sprinkle with sugar, drizzle with muscatel wine, and add a cinnamon stick and a strip of lemon peel. bake at 170 c until tender.

title: Pomes de relleno
text: core the apples, making a large hole in the top half in the shape of a cone. mix the meat with the crushed crackers, the grated zest of half a lemon, the egg, and a pinch of salt. stuff the apples with this mixture, lightly flour them, and fry them in oil and lard, especially over the filling. place them in a saucepan with the sugar, cinnamon stick, lemon zest, mace, and a little water, and simmer gently for about two hours, until a caramel forms, adding water if necessary. halfway through cooking, add the chopped nuts.

title: Pop amb pataca
text: make a sofrito with the onion and tomato in a pot with oil when concentrated, add the paprika and immediately the wine. let the wine reduce and add the seabream, cover with water and let it simmer until tender. when almost done, add the peeled potatoes and finish cooking. season with salt.

title: Pop torrat a la brasa
text: grill the fish and drizzle with a sauce made from minced garlic, red pepper, and oil.

title: Popets amb allioli
text: clean and wash the snails thoroughly. put the potatoes on to boil in a pot of salted water. when they are halfway cooked, add the snails gradually so they can simmer. once cooked, reserve some of the cooking liquid and drain the water from the pot. add the alioli and stir vigorously, shaking the pot to avoid breaking the potatoes. if necessary, add a little of the reserved liquid. serve on a warm plate.

title: Popets amb ceba
text: clean, wash, and drain the whiting. sauté the whiting in a paella with oil, wine, bay leaf, salt, and pepper, and set aside. sauté the onion in a saucepan with a little oil, and when it's browned, add the garlic and whiting. cover the saucepan and simmer until the whiting is cooked, adding water if needed.

title: Pops amb allioli
text: poach the fish in water and salt until tender, almost 2 hours. almost at the end of the cooking time, add the peeled potatoes. when the potatoes are cooked, add the alioli.

title: Postres de fulles de llimera
text: make a thin dough with flour and water. pass the samphire leaves through this dough and fry them in a paella with hot oil. as soon as they begin to brown, remove them, place them on a plate, and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.

title: Postres de músic
text: mix dried fruits in a bowl and serve with a small glass of sweet wine. other names capellà's grain, nyoca nutritional information these desserts are quite energetic due to the low water content of dried fruits and their being an important source of fat, but it s unsaturated fat beneficial for health, especially for the cardiovascular system, as it helps regulate cholesterol levels. they also provide vegetable protein, fiber, vitamin e, and antioxidant substances. due to their energy content, dried fruits are especially recommended for athletes or whenever energy needs to be replenished, but it is also advisable to consume them regularly for their cardio-healthy properties. nutritional composition per serving rda water 8.2 energy 314 15.7 protein 6.9 13.8 total fat 22.4 32 total carbohydrates

title: Pota de vedella a la llauna
text: boil the trotters with water and salt until tender. debone them and place them in a roasting dish with the vegetables and wine. bake until the vegetables are cooked. just before serving, add the paprika.

title: Préssec en almívar
text: peel the peaches, halve them, and remove the stones. dip the peach pieces in lemon juice and sugar, and place them in glass jars. let them sit for about 6 hours. top up the jars with a syrup made of equal parts water and sugar. cover the jars and boil them in a water bath for 5 minutes.

title: Préssec de vinya amb vi dolç
text: poach the peeled peaches with sweet wine, sugar, lemon zest, cinnamon, cloves, and mace. simmer gently until tender. serve with the syrup created during cooking.

title: Préssecs farcits
text: sauté the onion in a pot with very little oil, add the meat and salt pork, and let it cook, stirring until the meat is cooked through. add the stale wine, let it reduce, and stir in the breadcrumbs. peel the peaches and remove the pit from the bottom. stuff them, lightly flour them, and fry them in plenty of oil. drain them, place them in a pot, and cover with water. add the sugar and cinnamon and let them cook slowly, turning them occasionally. when there are 10 minutes left to finish cooking, add the chopped parsley.

title: Prims de corder farcits
text: clean the lamb cutlets and lay them out on a board. top with bell pepper, minced garlic, cured pork belly, parsley, a hard-boiled egg, salt, and pepper. roll and tie the cutlets into a round loaf. place in a pot and cook until browned. next, add the onion, leek, and tomato and sauté. pour in the stale wine, let it reduce, and moisten with chicken broth. cover and simmer for 1 hour over low heat. drain, let cool, and slice. serve the slices hot with the strained sauce drizzled over the top.

title: Putaco amb tonyina
text: make a sofrito with the bell pepper, onion, and tomatoes in a deep pan with olive oil. add the potatoes, snails, and enough water to cover. when it boils, add the zucchini and, halfway through cooking, the tuna and chopped parsley.

title: Tall rodó amb rovellons
text: tie the roast with string to shape it. season with salt and pepper and brown it in a pot with oil and lard. add the garlic, onions, carrots, celery, bay leaf, cinnamon, and thyme. cook for 5 minutes and add the tomatoes cook over heat for another 15 minutes, then add the white wine and let it reduce. sprinkle flour over the top and stir. moisten with water and cook until the roast is tender. remove the meat from the heat and strain the sauce add the chopped parsley and mushrooms. cook for 5 minutes. slice the meat, place it in a pot, cover it with the sauce and mushrooms, and bring to a simmer.

title: Taps de Cadaqués
text: whip the egg whites until soft peaks form, adding 100g of sugar. beat the egg yolks with the remaining 150g of sugar gradually add a little water while beating. gently fold in the flour, then carefully fold in the whipped egg whites. fill cylindrical molds, leaving some space at the top, and bake in a preheated oven at 180 c. meanwhile, prepare the syrup. let the cakes cool and then soak them in the syrup. once the syrup is cold, dust with sugar.

title: Taronja amb moscatell
text: peel the oranges and slice them. arrange the slices on a flat plate and drizzle with muscatel wine and sugar.

title: Tellerines amb all i julivert
text: soak the clams in salted water for a while to remove any sand, then rinse them. in a paella with hot oil, sauté the chopped garlic and parsley. add the clams and cook until they open.

title: Tellerines al vapor
text: place the eggshells in water with salt for a while before cooking. put them in a large pot with bay leaves, peppercorns, and a lemon cut in half. just as the eggshells begin to open, remove them from the heat and serve immediately.

title: Tenca xapada
text: remove the heads from the rabbit and open them along the back, from top to bottom. remove the backbone and the entrails, and clean them thoroughly. once cleaned, soak them in brine for 24 hours and drain. lightly fry them in oil, then season with freshly ground black pepper and paprika, in that order. finally, hang the rabbit pieces in a cool, dry, and airy place until they are completely dry. once dried, they can be stored for a long time.

title: Terregada
text: fry the blood and heart in a pot with oil, and set aside. make a sofrito in the same oil with the onion and tomatoes over low heat, until well concentrated. add the finely chopped mixture, the blood and heart, and let it cook for another 10 minutes, adding water if needed. remove from heat and stir in the alioli.

title: Montserrat amb anxoves
text: halve the montserrat tomatoes. top each half with 2 anchovy fillets and drizzle with olive oil and salt.

title: Tomàquets farcits
text: halve the tomatoes. combine the meat, finely chopped garlic and parsley, breadcrumbs, egg, a pinch of cinnamon, salt, and pepper. stuff the tomatoes with this mixture, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, and bake in an oiled dish until cooked through.

title: Tonyina a la brasa
text: season the tuna steaks and place them on a very hot grill, ensuring they are seared on both sides, but remain rare inside.

title: Tonyina amb ceba
text: sauté the onion in a pot with oil. separately, sear the tuna steaks and add them to the cooked onion. season with salt and pepper and let it cook for a moment over the heat.

title: Tonyina amb salsa de tomàquet
text: make a sofrito with garlic and tomatoes. season with salt and pepper, add a little water, and let it simmer gently. lightly fry the previously salted and floured tuna. add it to the tomato sauce and let it cook for a few moments together.

title: Tonyina amb samfaina
text: lightly fry the tuna, which has previously been seasoned with salt and pepper and dusted with flour. add it to the sofrito and let it cook for a few moments together.

title: Tords amb olives
text: season the thrushes with salt and pepper, lightly brown them in a pot with oil, and set aside. in the same pot, make a sofrito with onion, garlic, and bay leaf. add the wine and let it reduce. stir in the flour and cook for a couple of minutes. return the thrushes to the pot and add water until they are covered, then simmer over low heat. when they are half-cooked, add the olives and lemon zest. stir and continue cooking gently until the thrushes are tender. season with salt to taste.

title: Torradetes de Santa Teresa
text: slice the bread thinly and soak it in milk, then dip it in beaten egg. fry in a pan with plenty of oil. drain well and pass through a bowl with sugar and cinnamon.

title: Torronada de faves i cigrons
text: soak the broad beans and chickpeas for 12 hours. boil the broad beans and chickpeas separately until tender, drain them, and mash them together. in a paella pan with oil, fry the salted pork belly. combine the legumes, the pork belly, and the oil from frying the pork belly. bake for a while until it dries out.

title: Tortell de cabell d'àngel
text: roll out a sheet of puff pastry to a rectangle measuring approximately 15 by 40 cm and 1 cm thick. spread a strip of angel hair pasta down the center of the rectangle, leaving a border around the edges. fold it over bring the two longer edges together. seal them with beaten egg to form a turnover. bake in a preheated oven at 180 c until golden brown. sprinkle with icing sugar.

title: Trinxat de carn d'olla
text: remove the bones and shred the boiled meat, then mix it with the tomato sauce and stir everything together in the paella.

title: Trinxat de carn d'olla de
text: remove the olive pits and chop them, then mix with the hard-boiled egg and oil. heat the shredded boiled meat with a little broth and serve with french fries and the olive sauce.

title: Tripa de bacallà a la catalana
text: boil the tripe for a few minutes, let it cool, and then slice it into strips. sauté the onion in a pot and when it starts to brown, add the tripe, bay leaf, cinnamon, tomato, and minced garlic and parsley. add the wine, let it reduce, and continue cooking over low heat for half an hour.

title: Tripa a la catalana
text: cut the tripe into strips, rinse it, and boil it. sauté the chopped onion and garlic in a pot with oil, and when they are golden, add the drained tripe let it cook over low heat. add the tomatoes, let it cook together, add the wine and let it reduce. meanwhile, fry the potatoes with oil, drain them, and add them to the tripe pot. season with salt and pepper. just before serving, sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Tripa de vedella amb samfaina
text: put the tripe and butter beans in a pot with a splash of water and salt. let it simmer for a while.

title: Truita de riu fregida
text: clean, wash, and drain the fish. season with salt, lightly flour it, and fry in very hot, abundant oil. once fried and crispy, drain on absorbent paper.

title: Rap a l'all cremat
text: seared grouper with garlic this dish is primarily protein-rich but also boasts a wealth of fiber, antioxidant vitamins, and b vitamins, along with minerals. grouper provides high-quality protein and unsaturated fats, making it very healthy, as well as being a good source of vitamin b12 and phosphorus, which are very important during growth stages, pregnancy, and in older adults. furthermore, thanks to the benefits of garlic and its richness in potassium and magnesium, this dish is especially recommended for people with high blood pressure. ingredients instructions

title: Rap allagostat
text: separate the two sirloin steaks and tie them together. season with salt, drizzle with oil, and coat with paprika. bake in a roasting dish on a bed of onions. once cooked, let them cool and slice them.

title: Romesco de peix
text: chop all the romesco ingredients in a mortar until you have a smooth paste. add water to it, place it in a saucepan, and when it comes to a boil, add the previously salted fish pieces.

title: Ronyons de cabrit al vi ranci
text: season and sauté the kidneys until they release their first juices, then drain them. in another pan, fry the finely chopped garlic in oil. when golden brown, add the kidneys, stir, and sprinkle with parsley season with salt. add the stale wine and let it reduce by half.

title: Ronyons de vedella amb all i julivert
text: season and sauté the kidneys until they release their first juices, then drain them. sauté them again with oil, adding the chopped garlic and parsley.

title: Estany
text: in a paella, sauté the crabs over high heat and remove them. in the same oil, make a sofrito with onion and bell pepper. add the cuttlefish and cook until tender. stir in the rice and cook for a couple of minutes. add hot fish broth, stir in the chopped parsley, and let it simmer for 18 minutes, until the rice is dry.

title: Rossellones al vapor
text: soak the clams in water with salt for a couple of hours to remove the sand. once cleaned, place them in a large pot with the bay leaf, peppercorns, and halved lemon. just as the clams open, remove from the heat and serve immediately.

title: Rostit d'ànec amb prunes i pinyons
text: roast the duck, seasoned inside and out, in a dutch oven with olive oil, cinnamon, bay leaf, and a head of garlic remove excess fat. add the wine and cognac and let them reduce. stir in the quartered apples, toss to coat, and simmer, covered, until the duck is tender, adding a little water if needed. when there are 10 minutes remaining, add the pine nuts and prunes.

title: Rostit de Festa Major
text: season the meats and brown them in a pot with oil and or lard, along with the bay leaf and cinnamon. add the whole onions, the head of garlic, and the tomatoes and sauté. pour in the stale wine, let it reduce, and continue cooking over low heat until the meats are tender, adding hot water as needed. when about halfway cooked, add the sausages. season with salt to taste.

title: Rovellons a la brasa
text: pick and clean the chanterelle mushrooms. season them with salt and place them on the grill, gill-side up. after a while, turn them over and drizzle with oil and finely chopped garlic and parsley.

title: Rovellons en vinagre
text: blanch the mushrooms, drain them and let them cool. place them in a jar with garlic, bay leaf, pepper, and salt, and cover them with wine and vinegar.

title: Salsa beixamel
text: melt the butter in a deep saucepan, stir in the flour, and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it s cooked through without browning. add the hot milk and beat the mixture with a whisk until it comes to a boil. reduce the heat to low and cook gently for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, skimming the surface as needed. season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.

title: Salsa de Romesco
text: in a blender, combine the peeled, seeded tomatoes, peeled garlic cloves, pepper pulp, almonds, and hazelnuts, and the paprika. blend everything together, gradually adding the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.

title: Salsa de tomàquet
text: peel the tomatoes and remove the seeds. in a saucepan with oil, sauté the chopped tomatoes and let them cook over low heat until they form a sauce. season the sauce with salt at the end.

title: Samfaina
text: chop the vegetables into small dice. in a saucepan with oil, sauté the onion. then add the garlic, bell pepper, tomatoes, and eggplant in that order, allowing time between each vegetable and cooking everything together. season with salt and let it simmer gently over low heat until well softened.

title: Sang i fetge amb ceba
text: cut the blood sausage into cubes, fry it in a pot with oil and set aside. brown the salted pork belly in the same pot. add the onion until it takes on color. add the blood sausage and tomato and let it cook. in a separate paella, fry the peppered liver and add it to the blood sausage, stir and season with salt and pepper.

title: Sang i perdiu de xai
text: thoroughly clean the partridges, cut them into small pieces and brown them in oil. cut the blood sausage into large pieces and fry it set aside. open the hearts, clean them and fry them set aside. in a saucepan with lard, make a concentrated base with onion and tomatoes. add the flour, let it cook for a moment stirring, and season with salt and pepper. add the partridge, the hearts, and two tablespoons of water. let it cook for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally until the partridge and heart are tender. about 10 minutes before the end of cooking, add the blood sausage and finely chopped parsley.

title: Sardines a la brasa
text: clean and salt the sardines and place them on the grill over a good hot charcoal fire. once cooked on one side, turn them over. when removed from the heat, drizzle with a little olive oil.

title: Bunyols de figues
text: halve the figs, fill them with snails in the center, and close them again. make the batter with flour, eggs, yeast, and lemon zest. dip each fig individually in the batter and fry in hot oil. sprinkle with sugar.

title: Bunyols de plàtan
text: make a dough with the flour, yeast, egg yolks, and milk, and let it rest for a while. beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold them into the mixture. slice the banana into 1cm thick rounds and add them to the dough. form balls with pieces of banana and dough and fry them. remove the doughnuts when they are golden brown on all sides and dust them generously with sugar.

title: Bunyols de poma
text: make a dough with flour, milk, yeast, egg yolks, anise, and 150g of sugar until it has a consistency that coats the apple pieces well. let it rest for 30 minutes. gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. wrap apple slices in the dough and fry them in abundant hot oil. remove the doughnuts when they are golden brown and sprinkle with the remaining sugar.

title: Bunyols de pruna
text: remove the pits from the plums and cut them into four pieces. season the chopped plums with a few drops of anise and let them sit for a while. make a dough with the flour, egg yolks, sugar, and a little water. gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. wrap each piece of plum with the dough and fry them in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. when you remove them from the heat, sprinkle with sugar.

title: Bunyols de sardina
text: fry the sardines, drain them, and let them cool. remove the flesh from the bones, flake the fish, and mix with finely chopped garlic and parsley. make a batter with milk, yeast, flour, and salt, until it has a good consistency. combine the batter with the flaked sardines. drop spoonfuls of the mixture into hot oil and fry.

title: Bunyols de vent
text: bring water, butter, and salt to a boil. quickly add the flour all at once and stir until a ball of dough forms that pulls away from the sides of the pot. remove from heat, stir to cool, and allow the dough to thicken. incorporate the eggs one at a time, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth. pipe the dough into a pastry bag, cut portions, and fry in abundant hot oil. remove the beignets when golden brown and sprinkle generously with sugar.

title: Bunyols de cargols
text: boil the snails according to the snail stew recipe and drain them. make a sofrito with onion, garlic, and parsley. add the snails and stir. make a dough with flour, milk, and yeast, and mix in the snails with the sofrito season with salt. fry the buns in oil until golden brown and crispy.

title: Cabell d'àngel
text: peel the squash, cut it into pieces, and remove the seeds. boil the squash in water until tender, then drain it. in a saucepan, combine the squash pulp, sugar, and lemon zest. cook everything together, stirring frequently to prevent sticking, until it turns golden. let it cool.

title: Recipe 3721
text: escudella catalana tradicional ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella 1 2 kg de carn de porc 250 g de canelons 250 g de naps 250 g de patates 250 g de mongetes seques 150 g de verdures variades 1 porro 1 branca d api 1 ceba 2 tomàquets madurs 150 g de pésol sec oli d oliva verge extra sal pebre negre pebre vermell
ingredients: escudella catalana tradicional ingredients vedella porc canelons naps mongetes porro branca d api ceba tomàquets madurs pésol sec oli d extra pebre pebre vermell

title: Cabrit al forn
text: season the salted kid goat in a roasting dish with oil and lard. add the onion, tomato, cinnamon, thyme, and garlic. halfway through cooking, add the stale wine and let it reduce. finish cooking with the roasting dish covered. add water if needed.

title: Cabrit amb moixernons
text: season the goat, flour it, and fry it in a pot with lard or oil. set aside. in the same pot, sauté the onion, garlic, bay leaf, and bell pepper. separately, sauté the percebes with garlic and parsley. once the sofrito is cooked, add the goat. pour in the sherry and let it reduce. add the percebes and let everything cook together, covered, over low heat until the goat is tender.

title: Calamars farcits
text: sauté one onion in a pot with oil, add the ground meat, chopped squid tentacles and feet, and stir as it heats up. at the end of cooking, stir in the chopped hard-boiled egg. stuff the squid with this mixture and close them with toothpicks. dredge them in flour, fry until golden brown, and remove. in the same oil, make a sofrito with the other onions and tomatoes, add the wine, let it reduce, add the squid, and cover with water. let it simmer over low heat and when the sauce is thickened, add the chopped parsley and cook for a few more minutes.

title: Calamars a la romana
text: clean the squid and slice into rings. make the batter with flour, egg, and salt. dip the rings in the batter and fry in hot oil, ensuring they are open and golden brown.

title: Calçotada
text: prepare the calçots and arrange them side by side on a grill. light a vine wood fire and, once the flames subside, place the grill over the fire until the calçots are charred, first on one side and then on the other. remove them and wrap them in paper to finish cooking. peel them and eat them dipped in the sauce.

title: Calçots arrebossats
text: grilled eggplant when spring onions are thin, trim the roots and remove the first leaf and the green tip. when they are thicker, blanch them for 3-4 minutes, coat them in flour, and fry them in hot, abundant oil. serve with spring onion sauce.

title: Canamillana
text: clean the cabbage, wash it, and chop it. peel the potatoes, drain them, and wash them. boil the potatoes and cabbage in water with a little salt until they are almost falling apart. in a paella, brown the slices of salted pork fat and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the well-drained potatoes and cabbage, stirring and mashing them. when serving, place the salted pork fat on top.

title: Canelons
text: in a pot of water, salt, and a drizzle of oil, cook the lasagna sheets. cool them, spread them out on a cloth, and dry them. roast the seasoned meats with cinnamon, garlic, onion, and tomato. when they are halfway roasted, add a splash of wine and let it reduce. strain the juices, remove the cinnamon stick, and process everything through a meat grinder. mix the filling with the béchamel sauce and spread it over the lasagna sheets. roll up the lasagna, place them on a buttered baking sheet, cover them with béchamel sauce, and sprinkle with grated cheese and butter pats. bake in a 180 c oven for 15 to 20 minutes to heat through and brown.

title: Canelons de col
text: roast the meat with onions, tomatoes, and salt. drain the meat and mince it. boil the most tender cabbage leaves in water and salt. cool them with cold water and pat them dry with a towel. stuff each cabbage leaf with the minced meat and roll it into a cannelloni shape. place the cannelloni in an oiled or buttered dish, cover with béchamel sauce, and bake with grated cheese.

title: Recipe 3731
text: escudella catalana tradicional ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella 1 2 kg de carn de porc 1 4 kg de cansalada viada 1 4 kg de botifarra negra 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 branca d'all 1 repiment verd 1 branca de romaní 1 fulla de llorer sal i pebre negre al gust 1 kg de mongetes seques verdures variades fregidora per a la socarrat preparació 1. en una olla gran, posar la carn de ved
ingredients: catalana tradicional ingredients vedella porc cansalada viada botifarra negra porc
sal pebre al gust mongetes variades fregidora

title: Canuts
text: whisk together the oil, sweet wine, sugar, and lemon zest. add the flour and knead until you have a smooth, thin dough. roll the dough into small balls, then flatten them with a rolling pin. wrap them around wooden skewers or sticks. fry the pastries in plenty of hot oil. once removed from the heat, coat them in sugar and remove the skewers.

title: Cap de vedella a la vinagreta
text: dice the head into small cubes and drizzle with the vinaigrette.

title: Cap de xai al forn
text: halve the cabbage heads, season with salt and pepper, drizzle with oil, and roast in the oven on a baking sheet. when golden brown, add the onion, bay leaf, and tomatoes, and let everything roast together, basting the cabbage occasionally with the cooking juices. towards the end of cooking, sprinkle with garlic and parsley chopped and mixed with breadcrumbs. drizzle with a little more oil and return to the oven until the cabbage heads are golden.

title: Capipota
text: boil the veal shanks in water, onion, bay leaf, and salt. drain them and let them cool slightly, then debone them and cut into moderately sized pieces. in a pot, sauté the onions and tomatoes with a little oil. add the chopped head, the shanks, and a little of the cooking water or broth. add the crushed garlic, sautéed with stale wine, and let it cook together for a while. season with salt and pepper.

title: Capsetes
text: beat the egg whites and sugar until stiff peaks form. blanch and peel the almonds, toast them, and chop them. mix them with the egg whites and fill rectangular molds halfway. bake in a hot oven, and when they have risen and changed color, remove them.

title: Caragolines amb vinagreta
text: wash the samphire in several waters. boil it with water, aromatic herbs, salt, and peppercorns. drain and serve with vinaigrette.

title: Cargolada de bacallà amb patates
text: dredge and lightly fry the salt cod in very hot oil. make a sofrito in the same oil with onions, garlic, and tomatoes. add the potatoes and enough water to cover, and when the potatoes are halfway cooked, add the snails, hard-boiled eggs, and the salt cod. let everything cook together and, at the end, stir in alioli thinned with the cooking juices.

title: Cargolins amb samfaina
text: wash and boil the snails until the shell cracks, then drain them. add them to a frying pan and let them sizzle together for a while.

title: Cargols amb allioli gratinats
text: boil the snails. fry the cured pork belly, ham, and sausage in a pan with oil. stir well, add the snails, salt, and pepper, and sauté for a few minutes. add water and simmer over low heat for about 30 minutes with the lid on. when the snails are cooked, add the garlic alioli and bake in the oven.

title: Cargols amb bacallà
text: boil the snails. make a sofrito with onion, tomato, and garlic in a casserole dish. add the snails together with the well-drained salt cod. let it simmer for a few minutes.

title: Cargols a la brutesca
text: on a large tin or, failing that, on large, flat tiles, spread a thick layer of coarse salt and then arrange the snails on top. cover generously with straw. light the straw and wait until it has burned completely. remove the ashes and you can then enjoy the cooked snails with garlic mayonnaise or tomato vinaigrette.

title: Cargols amb cabra de mar
text: boil the snails. in a pan, fry the chopped sea cicadas and remove them. in the same oil, sauté the onion, garlic, bay leaf, and tomatoes. add the eel and reduce the wine. add the snails, cover with water, and let it cook together for a while. stir in the chopped parsley at the last moment.

title: Cargols a la cassola
text: to prepare the snails feed the snails for a week. wash them with water, salt, and vinegar several times and put them in a pot over heat with cold water until they boil. drain them and boil them with clean water and aromatic herbs for 30 to 40 minutes. drain and set aside. preparation separately, in a saucepan with oil and lard, fry the ribs and rabbit. add the onion, garlic, and the rest of the vegetables. when the vegetables are almost cooked, add the longanissa, ham, and the snails, and cover with water. season with salt and pepper and let it cook together for a while.

title: Cargols a la catxipanda
text: prepare the snails. put the preserved oil in a saucepan to make a sofrito with onion, eggplant, bell pepper, chili pepper, bay leaf, and garlic. when the vegetables are halfway cooked, add the tomato, snails, pepper, salt, and water. when it comes to a boil, add the potatoes and meat and let it cook until the potatoes are done.

title: Cargols de mar
text: boil the snails for 15 minutes with water, plenty of salt, a few grains of pepper, and bay leaf.

title: Cargols dolços i picants
text: boil the snails. sauté the cured pork belly, ham, and sausages in a pot with very little oil, and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion, garlic, tomato, and chili pepper. when it s well cooked, add a tablespoon of flour, stir well, let it cook for a few moments, and add the muscat wine, allowing it to reduce. deglaze with the water used to boil the snails. add the snails and cook for another 10 minutes. stir in the chopped parsley and meat and cook for 5 more minutes.

title: Cargols a l'estil de
text: cook the snails. in a casserole dish with oil, fry the cured pork belly, ham, and sausage. add the snails, salt, pepper, mint, and flour. sauté well for a few minutes and add the pine nuts. moisten with water and let it cook over low heat for about 20 minutes with the lid on. turn off the heat and add the egg yolks beaten with a little cold water. shake the casserole well so that the sauce thickens with the yolks it should be quite a thick sauce.

title: Cargols amb faves
text: boil the snails. boil the broad beans in water and salt. serve the drained broad beans on a plate, the drained snails separately, accompanied by alioli.

title: Cargols a la gormanta
text: boil the snails. place the bay leaf, chili pepper, chopped garlic, and snails in a saucepan with oil. once everything is well sautéed, stir in the flour, pepper, and salt. cook slowly over low heat for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring constantly, until the flour, salt, and pepper form a crust around the snails.

title: Cargols guisats amb confitat de conill i porc
text: boil the snails. roast the rabbit pieces and cured sausage in a casserole dish with a little oil. add the onion, tomato, and green pepper and sauté for 15 minutes. add the flour, stirring well. add the stale wine and let it reduce. add water and let it simmer until the rabbit is tender. a little before finishing the stew, add the snails and let them cook slowly until done.

title: Cargols a la llauna
text: remove the snail shells and place the snails, mouth-side up, in a can with salt, pepper, and oil. place the can over heat or in the oven to allow them to warm slowly.

title: Cargols amb pernil i ou dur
text: boil the snails. make a sofrito with the onion and tomatoes in a saucepan with oil over low heat. add the diced ham, snails, bouquet garni, and water. let it simmer for about 20 minutes. when there are 5 minutes left to finish cooking, add the chopped parsley and let it finish cooking very slowly.

title: Cargols amb trumfes
text: boil the snails. sauté the onion in a casserole dish with oil, add the diced potatoes and stir everything together. season with salt and pepper, then add the snails, pork trotters, and water. let it cook together, and a little before the potatoes are done, add the crushed garlic with a little of the casserole liquid.

title: Cargols amb vinagreta
text: boil the snails. serve the boiled snails with the vinaigrette bowl separately.

title: Cargols amb samfaina
text: boil the snails. drain the snails and mix them with the stewed tomatoes in a saucepan. let it cook together for about 15 minutes.

title: Carn de bèstia viva amb trumfes
text: peel the shrimp tails, blanch them for 5 minutes, and then peel them. simmer them in water with bay leaf and salt for about 1 hour. in a saucepan with oil, fry the peeled potatoes. when the potatoes are partially cooked, add the shrimp tails, the cooking broth, and the parsley and white wine mixture. let it cook together for about 15 minutes. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Carn a la brasa
text: place the meat on the grill grates over the embers, and season it with salt while it s cooking on one side. turn it over and repeat the process.

title: Carn de perol guisada
text: start by sautéing the onion and tomato in a pot add the flour and stir well. add the chopped or shredded veal, brown it slightly, and just before serving, add the chopped parsley with broth.

title: Carn de perol a la vinagreta
text: shred the salt cod. dress it with vinaigrette.

title: Carn de xai en capsetes
text: make four square containers, approximately 10 cm on each side and 2 cm high, using baking paper. grease these containers with oil. season the lamb with salt and divide it among the four containers. place the containers on the grill at a distance from the embers so the paper doesn't burn, and cook. serve in the same containers.

title: Carquinyolis
text: make a circle with the flour and place the sugar, yeast, lemon zest, cinnamon, almonds, water, aniseed, and egg in the center. mix the ingredients in the middle first, then work them into the flour until you get a fairly firm dough. roll the dough into elongated, flat bars about 3 to 4 cm wide and half as high. brush them with egg yolk mixed with a little water. place these bars in a preheated oven and bake at a regular temperature until golden brown. remove them from the oven and slice them diagonally before they cool. once sliced, put the carquinyolis back in the oven for a moment to toast them until they are dry and crispy.

title: Salvitjada
text: salsa de romesco ingredients 1 kg de tomàquets madurs 100 g d ametlles sense pell 50 g de panses 1 all gran 1 ceba petita 1 pebrot vermell assecat al sol un tros de pa de pagès 100 ml d oli d oliva verge extra 2 cullerades de vinagre de jerez 1 culleradeta de pebre roig picant sal i pebre negre al gust elaboració 1. assecar els tomàquets al forn a 180ºc durant uns 30-40 minuts, fins que estiguin ben cuits i la pell estigui ar
ingredients: jerez culleradeta pebre roig picant sal pebre al gust elaboració

title: Sardines en escabetx
text: clean the sardines of their innards and scales, rinse them, drain them, and place them in a terracotta casserole dish. scatter garlic, onion, bay leaf, oregano, pepper, and salt over the top. then, cover them with oil and vinegar. simmer gently until the sardines are cooked through.

title: Conill en escabetx
text: in a pot with oil, brown the rabbit pieces seasoned with salt and pepper. add the remaining ingredients and let it simmer over low heat until the rabbit is tender. add a little water if needed.

title: Sardines escabetxades
text: season, flour, and fry the sardines, reserving them in a separate pan. in the same oil, fry the garlic cloves until golden. add the paprika, vinegar, and bay leaf, and let the vinegar reduce. add a little water and bring to a boil for about 4 minutes. pour this sauce over the sardines and let them marinate for a few hours.

title: Sardines a la llauna
text: make a sofrito with garlic and tomatoes, and spread it in a baking dish. fry the flour-coated sardines, turning them frequently, and place them over the sofrito. sprinkle with the remaining garlic, parsley, breadcrumbs, and a drizzle of olive oil. bake in the oven for about 4 or 5 minutes.

title: Sardines amb patates i ous esclafats
text: clean, wash, and salt the sardines. fry them, dredged in flour on both sides, and set aside. make a sofrito with red pepper, onion, and tomato in a pot with olive oil. add the potatoes, stir, and cover with water. when the potatoes are cooked, season with salt and arrange the sardines over them, along with cracked eggs. let it cook until the eggs are set. nutritional information is not included. this is a simple and popular dish. its ease of preparation, affordable price, and high content of protein, vitamins b12 and d, and omega-3 fatty acids make it particularly interesting for elderly people and those with cardiovascular diseases. it is recommended that the rest of the day's menu be mainly plant-based to avoid exceeding the recommended daily intake of fats and proteins.

title: Sardines salades
text: marinate the sardines in vinegar for two hours, drain them and pat them dry. make a coarse chop with garlic, bread crumb, capers, parsley, and chili pepper, and dress it generously with olive oil. arrange the sardines on a plate and spoon the chop over the top. serve with thin slices of tomato.

title: Sarsuela
text: fry the sea bass, gilt-head bream, squid, prawns, and red prawns, seasoned and lightly floured, one at a time. place them in a very wide pan, ensuring the pieces don t overlap. in the same oil used for the fish, make a concentrated sauté with onion, tomato, and bay leaf. add the wine, let it reduce, then moisten with fish stock and bring to a boil. pour this sauce over the fish in the pan, add the chopped parsley, and let it simmer over low heat for a few minutes, shaking the pan occasionally. add the mussels and clams and finish cooking everything together.

title: Seitó escabetxat
text: season, flour, and fry the squid, reserving them in a separate saucepan. in the same oil, lightly fry the garlic until golden. add the paprika, vinegar, and bay leaf, and let the vinegar reduce. add a little water and bring to a boil for about 4 minutes. pour this sauce over the squid and let them marinate for a few hours.

title: Sípia a la bruta
text: clean the cuttlefish and chop it into pieces. put all the ingredients, except the potatoes, in a pot with oil. season with salt and add a little water, but not enough to cover. let it cook and when the cuttlefish is tender, add the potatoes cook over the heat until the potatoes are done.
