title: Sípia ofegada
text: sauté the onion, garlic, and bay leaf in a pot with oil. add the cuttlefish, stir, and let it cook with the lid on over low heat until the cuttlefish is tender. shake the pot occasionally, adding water if needed, and season with salt at the last moment.

title: Sopa amb crosta
text: make meatballs with ground meat, finely chopped garlic and parsley, breadcrumbs, and salt set aside. sauté the onions, add the cured pork shoulder, and when it's browned, add the flour-dusted meatballs and bread crumbs ground in a mortar. stir well and add broth. simmer until the meatballs are cooked through. separately, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, add the yolks, and pour this mixture over the casserole. sprinkle with grated cheese and gratine.

title: Sopa amb flam
text: whisk the beaten eggs with ½ liter of broth and salt. pour into ramekins and bake in a water bath. serve each flan with hot broth poured over the top.

title: Sopa blanca
text: clean the seabream and fillet it. place it in a pot with 1 ½ liters of cold water. when cooked, remove it, let it cool, remove the bones and carefully pick over the fish to ensure no bones remain. return the bones to the broth and boil over high heat for 10 minutes. strain the broth into another pot, reserving some of it. add bread to the broth, and let it cook for about 15 minutes. blend the soup until smooth, removing any large breadcrumbs that may remain. turn off the heat, add the fish and alioli, and blend again. season with salt to taste. the soup should be creamy.

title: Recipe 3778
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella 150 g de carn de porc salada 150 g de botifarra negra 150 g de botifarra blanca 100 g de peu de porc salat 1 branca d arròs 1 4 de febró verd 1 branca de porro 1 patata mitjana 1 enciam petit 1 ou oli d oliva verge extra sal pebre negre elaboració 1. en una olla gran, posem la carn de vedella, la carn de porc salada, el peu de porc salat i la botifarra negra i blanca. co
ingredients: enciam petit d extra pebre negre

title: Arròs a la milanesa
text: in a saucepan with oil, sauté the onion until golden brown. add the sliced pork and bay leaf. when it begins to brown, add the tomato and cook everything together. brown the rice in the sofrito, then add boiling water, peas, and chopped parsley. let it cook for about 15 minutes, and add grated cheese a little before it s finished.

title: Cabra amb cargols
text: deceive the snails. make a sofrito with onion, parsley stems, cinnamon, and tomatoes in a pot with olive oil. add the flour, stirring for a couple of minutes, then add the goat meat, snails, and a little water, and let it simmer. when there are five minutes left of cooking, add the parsley, previously chopped and seasoned with stale wine and anise.

title: Canelons de peix
text: to make the filling sauté finely chopped onion in a paella with oil. dice the fish and add it to the onion. add the previously boiled mussels. let it cook for a while, add the wine and let it reduce. add a slightly thick béchamel sauce, season with salt and pepper, and stir. boil the lasagne sheets in salted water. drain and dry them. spread the filling over the sheets and roll them up. place the cannelloni in a baking dish greased with butter, cover with béchamel sauce and sprinkle with grated cheese. bake in a preheated oven at 180 c for 10 to 15 minutes to heat through and brown.

title: Carn a la llosa
text: heat the stone very well over a wood fire or charcoal. place the seasoned and oiled meat cuts on top. when browned on one side, turn them over. serve immediately.

title: Sopa d'all
text: in a pot with a drizzle of oil, fry the garlic cloves and then the bread. add the water and bring to a boil. blend the soup until smooth. season the soup with salt to taste.

title: Sopa de caldo
text: make a sofrito with the onion and tomato. add the broth and, when it boils, add the shredded chicken and alphabet pasta. let it cook until the pasta is done.

title: Sopa de carbassa
text: sauté the onion and bay leaf in a pot with oil. add the pumpkin and let it sweat with the lid on. add water and when the pumpkin is halfway cooked, add the rice. season with salt and pepper.

title: Sopa de ceba
text: in a saucepan with oil, sauté the onion until softened. pour in the water and let it simmer for half an hour. season with salt and pepper, add the slices of bread, and bring to a boil.

title: Sopa de fonolls
text: boil the cabbage and potato in water and salt. when it comes to a boil, add the rice, noodles, and leeks. just before serving, add the chickpeas and let it simmer.

title: Sopa de fredolics
text: sauté the onion and garlic in a pot with oil. add the mushrooms and let them release their water. cover with water, add the herb bouquet, and bring to a boil for half an hour. when there are 10 minutes left of cooking time, add the sliced bread and chopped parsley. remove the herb bouquet and season with salt and pepper.

title: Sopa de llagosta
text: cut off the lobster tails into slices about half an inch thick and split the heads in half. sauté the tail pieces, meat-side down, in a hot pan with oil, then flip them over after a moment. remove and extract all the meat and the tomalley. in the same oil, make a sofrito with chopped onions, garlic, celery, parsley, and tomatoes. add water and, when it comes to a boil, add the head, tail claws, and herbs. simmer for about 15 minutes. strain the broth, add the chopped tomalley and diced lobster meat, and cook for another 5 minutes.

title: Sopa de lluç
text: simmer the monkfish in water, salt, and a bay leaf. strain the broth and remove the monkfish flesh. cook the noodles in the monkfish broth, and just before they're done, add the monkfish flesh.

title: Sopa de menta
text: boil the mint with water, oil, and salt. remove the mint and add the bread slices, blend until smooth, and let it cook for a little longer.

title: Sopa de musclos
text: put the mussels in a pot over heat with a little water to open them. make a sofrito with onion and tomato, and deglaze it with the mussel cooking liquid and a little more water if needed. when it comes to a boil, add the slices of bread, the mussels without shells, and the parsley diluted with brandy. let it simmer for 10 minutes and season with salt to taste.

title: Sopa de nous
text: grind the walnuts very finely in a mortar. spread them out on shallow plates and scald with boiling water.

title: Sopa de núvia
text: make a broth with the chicken, brisket, rib, bone, and vegetables. strain it and pick the meat from the chicken, brisket, and beef. make very small meatballs with the ground meat, beaten egg, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper. bring the broth to a boil and add the meatballs and the meat you have picked. season with salt to taste.

title: Sopa de pa
text: in a pot, bring water, oil, and salt to a boil. once boiling, add the bread. let it cook for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth.

title: Sopa de pa torrat amb múrgoles
text: sauté the onion. add the snails and sauté everything together. pour in the broth and let it simmer until the snails are tender. add the beaten eggs and bread. stir with a hand blender until it thickens.

title: Sopa de patata ratllada
text: bring the broth to a boil in a pot. add the grated potato, the small-diced potatoes, the minced garlic, and the chopped parsley. let it simmer together, stirring occasionally. just before serving, add the chopped hard-boiled eggs.

title: Sopa de perdiu
text: boil the partridge with the ham bone. strain the broth, remove the meat from the partridge and set aside. make a thick, concentrated sofrito with oil, onion, and tomato. add the sofrito to the broth and when it comes to a boil, add the rice, noodles, and, at the last moment, the partridge meat season with salt if needed. before serving, stir in garlic aioli.

title: Sopa de pescadors
text: make a sofrito with onions, garlic, and tomatoes in a pot with oil. add the monkfish, turbot, and prawn heads, and let it simmer for about 20 minutes. strain it and pick out the fish flesh set aside. return the broth to the heat and, when it comes to a boil, add the rice. when the rice is halfway cooked, add the fish flesh, prawn tails, and chopped parsley.

title: Sopa de rap
text: make a broth with the spine, skin, and head of the monkfish, bay leaf, and thyme. in a separate saucepan, prepare a sofrito with onions, garlic, and tomatoes. add the bread and broth, and let it simmer. at the last moment, add the finely chopped parsley and the monkfish tail cut into pieces, and let it boil for a while.

title: Sopa de ventre
text: in a pot, fry the cured pork belly and add the bacon lardons. cover with the two broths and bring to a boil. gradually add the flour as if it were falling rain, stirring constantly with a whisk to prevent lumps. let it simmer gently for about 20 minutes.

title: Sopa fosca
text: boil the broccoli and potatoes in salted water. place the bread slices in bowls and pour over them the boiling broth. serve the vegetables separately.

title: Sopa pavesa
text: start by sautéing the onion and tomato. add the meat broth and, once it boils, add the beaten eggs mixed with a little broth and toasted bread. let it simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring frequently. at the end of cooking, sprinkle grated cheese on top.

title: Sopa torrada amb pilotilles
text: mix the meat, finely chopped garlic and parsley, beaten egg, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper, and form small meatballs. wrap them in caul fat, lightly flour them, and fry them. make a sauce in a saucepan with oil, sautéing the onion and tomato. add the broth and the finely chopped mixture. gradually add the crushed or grated toasted bread, stirring constantly until the soup reaches a medium consistency. add the meatballs and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Sopes d'ametlles
text: boil the almonds in water and grind them finely. add the grated bread, a pinch of cinnamon, and salt, stirring well. off the heat, add the egg yolks, continuing to stir.

title: Sopes de brosses
text: make a broth with the beef, bones, salt pork, lamb, and chicken, skim it and pick out the meat set aside. prepare small meatballs. blend the bread into the broth and add the shredded meat and meatballs. simmer until the meatballs are cooked.

title: Sopes de caldo de fesols
text: boil the beans with water and a ham bone. in a pot, sauté the diced cured pork and garlic. add the bean cooking broth and stale bread. bring to a boil and blend until smooth. before serving, stir in a few beans and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Sopes de cireres
text: melt a portion of butter in a paella pan. fry bread cubes in it and set aside. soak the cherries in water, lightly flour them, and fry them in the remaining butter. add sugar and let it caramelize. add a splash of water and let it simmer until the cherries are cooked through. add brandy and, at the last moment, the fried bread cubes.

title: Sopes de farigola
text: boil the farigola and a drizzle of oil in a pot of water for about 10 minutes. remove the farigola. season with salt and add the bread slices. blend the soup until smooth.

title: Sopes de llet
text: bring the milk and sugar to a boil. once it boils, remove from the heat and add the slices of bread until they are soaked.

title: Sopes de pastor escaldades
text: bring water to a boil with thyme. sauté the onion and salted pork, adding a pinch of paprika at the end. fry the bread slices with garlic and arrange them on plates. top with the onion and salted pork, then pour the boiling thyme water over them.

title: Sopes escaldades
text: arrange the bread slices on a plate with marjoram and moisten them with the vegetable broth. add a drizzle of oil and salt.

title: Sèpia amb pèsols
text: clean and chop the cuttlefish, and sauté it in a pot with a little oil. add the onion, sauté until softened, then add the garlic and tomatoes. once everything is sautéed, cover with water. bring to a boil, then add the peas and simmer over low heat until cooked season with salt. just before serving, stir in the chopped parsley with some of the cooking juices.

title: Suquet d'anxova
text: make a sofrito with the garlic, parsley, and tomatoes in a saucepan with oil. season with salt and pepper. add the flour, stir well, and add a little water. once it boils, add the cleaned anchovies. cook for a short time, until the anchovies are cooked through.

title: Suquet de clavellada
text: sauté the finely chopped ingredients and then pound them in a mortar. make a well-reduced tomato sauce in a saucepan with oil. add the flour, stir well, and then incorporate the pounded mixture with a little water. bring to a boil, add the potatoes, and cover with enough water. when the potatoes are halfway cooked, add the peeled and salted pieces of cod. just before serving, stir in the blanched garlic mayonnaise.

title: Suquet de moixina amb rossellones
text: season, flour, and lightly fry the fish in hot oil, and set aside. sauté the garlic, parsley, bell pepper, and tomatoes in a saucepan with a little of the fish frying oil. add the wine, let it reduce, and moisten with just enough water. when it boils, add the fish and, at the last moment, the chopped parsley and saffron threads, and cook until the fish flakes.

title: Suquet de peix
text: in a pot with oil, make a sofrito with tomatoes and garlic. when the tomatoes have reduced well, add the potatoes, stir everything together, and cover with hot water. cook for a while until the potatoes are half-cooked. add the fish sliced and chopped parsley and let it finish cooking.

title: Suquet de tenca
text: make a sofrito with the onion, garlic, and tomato in a saucepan with oil. add the white wine, let it reduce, and season with black pepper, bay leaf, and a pinch of chili flakes. cover with water, bring to a boil, and add the previously salted seabream, head and all.

title: Suquet d'ous de tenca
text: start by sautéing the onion, garlic, and tomato in a pot with oil. add white wine, let it reduce, and season with black pepper, bay leaf, and dried thyme. cover with water, add the previously salted, peppered, and floured roach eggs, and let it simmer.

title: Calamars a la Sitgetana
text: sauté the onion and bay leaf with a little oil in a covered pot over very low heat for about 2 hours, adding water if needed. clean the squid, season with salt, flour them, and fry them in a paella with oil. drain the squid and add them to the pot with the onion, then pour in a glass of malvasia. let it cook together for another 10 minutes. season with salt to taste and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Conill fregit
text: cut the rabbit into small pieces and season with salt, pepper, and marjoram. in a paella with oil, fry the unpeeled garlic cloves. when the garlic is golden brown, add the rabbit, first over high heat and then over low heat, until the rabbit pieces are browned.

title: Costelles de cabrit arrebossades
text: season the kid goat ribs. dredge them in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs. fry them in plenty of hot oil.

title: Llom arrebossat
text: season the pork chops with salt and pepper. dip them in flour, then beaten egg, and finally breadcrumbs, in that order. fry them in hot oil on both sides.

title: Llibrets de llomillo
text: season the pork loin slices. butterfly the pork loin and stuff with sweet cured ham and cheese. dip them in flour, then beaten egg, and finally breadcrumbs, in that order. fry in very hot oil until golden brown on both sides.

title: Macarrons amb llet i canyella
text: boil the pasta in water with salt and a bay leaf until al dente. drain and cool. return the pasta to an empty pot. brown the ground meat in the pot, then add the onion. stir in cinnamon powder, a bay leaf, salt, and pepper until the onion is browned over high heat. cover and simmer gently. add enough milk to cover the pasta and bring to a simmer over low heat. pour the milk sauce over the pasta, stir occasionally, and let it sit, covered, for 1 hour, until the pasta is dry.

title: Macarrons de Frare
text: simmer the soaked chickpeas until tender. once cooked, remove half of the cooking liquid and replace it with fresh water. make a sofrito with onion, tomatoes, saffron, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. add the sofrito to the chickpeas and let it simmer. after a while, add the pasta and remove from the heat when the pasta is cooked. stir in the well-beaten egg yolks into the broth. the dish should be served warm. serve with grated cheese to taste.

title: Platillo de Sant Climent de Llobregat
text: soak the dried fruits in warm water for an hour. sauté the chopped onion with the lard. add the lean meat, let it brown, and then add the sausage. reduce the cognac and add the soaked dried fruits, then cover with water or broth. simmer over low heat for an hour, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. stir in the chopped almonds during the last 10 minutes. season with salt to taste and adjust as needed.

title: Popets amb all i julivert
text: heat the oil in a paella and add the whole squid. once they have released their juices, add the white wine and reduce it. add the garlic and chopped parsley, cover the paella and let it cook for 15 to 20 minutes together. taste and adjust seasoning with salt.

title: Recipe 3829
text: escudella contramembres ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 1 2 kg de carn de porc a trossos 1 4 kg de cansalada viada 1 4 kg de botifarra negra 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 4 kg de mongetes seques 1 4 kg de naps 1 porro 1 branca d'api 1 ceba grans 2 tomàquets madurs 150 g de pasta petita oli d'oliva verge extra sal pebre negre pimentó dol
ingredients: ingredients vedella tallada trossos trossos cansalada viada botifarra negra porc mongetes naps porro branca ceba grans

title: Pollastre amb prunes
text: chicken with prunes and pine nuts ingredients 1.5 kg chicken pieces 200g pitted prunes 100g pine nuts 1 onion, finely chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 150ml dry white wine 150ml chicken stock 2 tbsp olive oil 1 cinnamon stick pinch of saffron threads salt and pepper to taste instructions 1. season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper. 2. heat the olive oil in a large casserole dish over medium heat. brown the chicken on all sides, then remove from the dish and set aside. 3. add the chopped onion and garlic to the casserole dish and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. 4. pour in the white wine and let it
ingredients: minced 150ml dry white wine 150ml chicken stock olive oil cinnamon stick saffron threads salt

title: Pollastre fregit
text: cut the chicken into small pieces and season with salt, pepper, and rosemary. in a paella pan with oil, fry the unpeeled garlic cloves. when the garlic is golden brown, add the chicken, first over high heat and then over low heat, until the chicken pieces are browned.

title: Truita de faves amb tavella tendra
text: season and fry the broad beans with sliced chorizo until golden brown. drain the oil and mix the beans with beaten eggs and salt. make a round omelet, first over low heat on one side, ensuring the mixture sets then flip it over to cook the other side.

title: Arròs de bugies
text: cut the scallops in half lengthwise. remove the coral with a spoon, fry it, and crush it. in a saucepan with oil, sauté the seasoned scallops, flame them with brandy, and set aside. in the same saucepan, make a well-reduced sofrito with garlic, bell pepper, and tomato. add the rice and toast it, then add the hot broth and the crushed coral season with salt. let it cook for 18 minutes, the first 5 on high heat. when there are 5 minutes left until the end of cooking, add the scallops.

title: Arròs de fotja
text: in a pot, sauté the salted and peppered pieces of monkfish in oil and set aside. in the same pot, make a sofrito with onion and chopped tomatoes. once the sofrito is ready, add the paprika and monkfish, stir well, and add water. simmer until the monkfish is tender. ensure there is 1 liter of broth in the pot and, without stopping the boil, add the rice. cook for about 18 minutes and season with salt and pepper. just before the cooking is finished, stir in the finely chopped parsley.

title: Arròs de polla d'aigua
text: in a pot, sauté the salted and peppered pieces of chicken in oil and set aside. in the same pot, make a sofrito with the onion and chopped tomatoes. when the sofrito is ready, add the red pepper and the chicken, stir well, and add water to cover. simmer until the chicken is tender. ensure there's 1 liter of broth in the pot and, without stopping the boil, add the rice. cook for about 18 minutes and season with salt and pepper. just before the cooking is finished, stir in the finely chopped parsley.

title: Arròs de seitó
text: in a pot, make a sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomatoes. when the sofrito is concentrated, add the rice, stir well, and add the boiling water. when it comes to a boil, add the chopped parsley with a little water and the peas. when there are 2 or 3 minutes left until the cooking is finished, scatter the cleaned and salted mussels over the rice.

title: Bacallà a la colomina
text: dredge the salt cod with flour, fry it, and set aside. sauté the onion in a saucepan, add the spinach, and stir until almost cooked. add the raisins and pine nuts, place the salt cod over the spinach, add a splash of water if needed, cover, and let everything finish cooking together. once cooked, drizzle quince aioli over the top and broil.

title: Bacallà a la lleidetana
text: dredge the cod with flour, fry it, and set aside. sauté the onion in a saucepan, add the spinach, and stir until almost cooked. add the raisins and pine nuts, place the cod on top of the spinach, add a splash of water if needed, thinly sliced apple, cover, and let everything finish cooking together.

title: Brunyols
text: crumble the yeast in the lukewarm milk. place the flour on a marble surface, forming a mound, and gradually add all the ingredients except the oil and 50g of sugar. knead well for a good while until the dough is elastic and smooth, so that it doesn t tear when stretched. form the dough into a ball, place it in a bowl, cover it with a cloth, and let it rest in a warm place for about 2 hours, until doubled in size. take pieces of dough and, using your fingers oiled, shape them into rounds, make a hole in the middle, and fry them in hot oil. when they are golden brown on one side, turn them over. drain the fritters and sprinkle them with sugar.

title: Bunyols d'avellana
text: heat the milk with the ground hazelnuts, cinnamon, and lemon zest. whisk the egg yolks with the sugar and cornstarch. add the milk and cook over heat, stirring constantly until a thick cream forms. let it cool, then fry small doughnuts, dipped in flour and beaten egg, in abundant hot oil until golden brown. sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon when removed from the heat.

title: Canelons a la barcelonina
text: boil the lasagna sheets in salted water with a drizzle of oil. cool them, lay them out on a cloth, and dry them. roast the seasoned meats with cinnamon, garlic, onion, and tomato. when they are halfway roasted, deglaze with wine. strain the juices, remove the cinnamon stick, and process everything through a meat grinder. mix the filling with the béchamel sauce and spread it over the lasagna sheets. roll up the lasagna, place them on a buttered baking sheet. add tomato sauce to the béchamel and pour it over the lasagna. sprinkle with grated cheese and butter pats. bake at 180 c for 15-20 minutes to heat through and brown.

title: Canelons d'espinacs
text: clean and wash the spinach in two or three waters and chop it roughly. fry the ham and pine nuts in a paella and add the spinach and raisins season with salt. cook the cannelloni pasta, cool it in cold water, and drain well. fill the cannelloni with the spinach. place the cannelloni in a dish greased with oil or butter, cover with béchamel sauce and grated cheese, and bake in the oven.

title: Capsetes de rovell
text: beat the egg yolks and sugar until light and fluffy. blanch, peel, toast, and chop the almonds. mix them with the egg yolks and fill rectangular molds halfway. bake at a high temperature and remove when they have risen and changed color.

title: Cassola d'arròs a la sitgetana
text: heat the oil and lard in a cast iron pot, and when very hot, add the ribs until golden brown set aside. add the cuttlefish to the same fat, and when it has released its water, add the ribs, onion, and peppers. let it sauté together for a bit. add the tomato, a glass of malvasia wine, and a little salt. simmer over low heat for half an hour. moisten with broth and add the peas. when it comes to a boil, add the rice and chopped parsley. when the rice is halfway cooked, add the prawns, shrimp, sausages, and clams. season with salt and finish cooking in the oven to get a little color on top. it shouldn't be dry.

title: Civet de conill de bosc
text: marinate the rabbit with the wine, sliced onion, herbs, and pepper for 24 hours reserve the marinade liquid. remove the pieces of meat, season them with salt, and brown them in a pan. when they start to color, add the onion and herbs, and after a while, the marinade liquid. cover and simmer over low heat until the meat is tender, adding water as needed. remove the herbs, stir in the chopped parsley, and continue cooking gently for about 10 minutes. season with salt and pepper to taste. arrange the rabbit on a warmed platter and pour the sauce over it.

title: Bacallà amb truita amb trampa
text: dredge and fry the salt cod. in the same oil, sauté the onion, garlic, tomato, and parsley. when the vegetables are halfway cooked, stir in the soaked raisins and chopped parsley. once the sofrito is ready, add the salt cod, a splash of water, and halved hard-boiled eggs. simmer together for 5 minutes over low heat. make a thin, round omelet with eggs, flour, water, salt, and pepper, place it over the salt cod, and cook for another 2 minutes over the heat.

title: Cóc de mel
text: whisk together the oil, brandy, and flour until you have a very thin paste. line all parts of a can with this paste and bake in the oven for 10 minutes. with the ingredients for the filling, make a very light dough, place it inside the lined can, and bake in a very hot oven to start, then reduce the temperature. when the cake has acquired a golden color, remove it from the oven immediately and drizzle with honey.

title: Rosquilles d'anís
text: whisk the eggs, milk, oil, anise, 100g of sugar, and lime zest vigorously. add the flour, baking powder, and soda water, and work until a firm dough forms. cut the dough into pieces, shape them into small churros, and join the ends to form small, ring-shaped donuts. let them rest for a while, then bake in a preheated oven until cooked through. sprinkle with the remaining sugar as soon as they come out of the oven.

title: Conill amb salsa de pinyons
text: season the rabbit pieces and brown them in a pot with oil and lard. add the onion, let it soften, and pour in the stale wine. let it reduce, cover the pot, and simmer over low heat until the rabbit is tender. add the pine nuts and finish cooking with the pot covered. arrange the rabbit on a heated platter, blend the sauce, adjust seasoning with salt and pepper, and pour it over the rabbit.

title: Cor de vedella guisat
text: cut the heart of palm into cubes and fry it in a pot with oil set aside. in the same oil, sauté the onion, garlic, and tomatoes add the herbs, spices, and dried orange peel. reduce the stale wine, add water or meat broth, and add the heart of palm. simmer with the lid on over low heat until the heart of palm is tender.

title: Conill rostit a la cassola amb llimona
text: sauté the garlic cloves in oil or lard in a pot. add the seasoned rabbit and let it brown, turning occasionally. when it s halfway cooked, add the lemon pieces, cover the pot, and let it cook until the rabbit is tender. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Croquetes de bacallà
text: melt the butter in a saucepan and sauté the onion. add the flour and cook for a few minutes, stirring constantly. gradually add the boiling milk with salt, pepper, and nutmeg, stirring well and letting it simmer for a few minutes. add the drained, previously soaked salt cod and chopped parsley. pour onto a dish and let it cool in the refrigerator for about 12 hours. shape into croquettes, coat them in flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumbs, and fry in plenty of oil.

title: Pèsols i faves ofegats
text: fava beans in stew ingredients 1 kg of dried fava beans 150 g of salt pork 1 large onion 2 cloves of garlic 1 sprig of rosemary 1 bay leaf olive oil salt water instructions soak the fava beans in cold water overnight. the next day, drain the beans and place them in a large pot. cover with fresh water and bring to a boil. skim off any foam that rises to the surface. add the salt pork, chopped onion, garlic, rosemary, and bay leaf to the pot. season with salt. reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 2-3 hours, or until the beans are very tender. stir occasionally to prevent sticking. add more water if necessary. once the beans are cooked, remove the salt pork, onion, garlic, rosemary, and bay leaf. traditionally,
ingredients: bay leaf olive oil salt water

title: Fricandó de corder
text: soak the chanterelle mushrooms in water for a couple of hours. season the meat with salt and pepper, flour it, and brown it in a pot with oil. set aside. in the same oil, make a concentrated sofrito with onion and tomato. add the meat, flambé with brandy, then add the white wine and let it reduce. cover with water and simmer over low heat until the meat is tender. drain the mushrooms, lightly sauté them in a pan, and add them to the pot. when there are 10 minutes left, stir in the finely chopped parsley.

title: Llagosta amb cargols de marge
text: cut the lobster into pieces reserve the coral and liver. sauté the lobster in a cast iron pot with hot oil, add the malvasia wine and flame it. drain the lobster pieces and set aside. sauté the onion and tomato in the same oil. when softened, add the red pepper, chopped parsley, saffron, and chopped almonds. moisten with hot broth, add the lobster and snails, pepper, and the coral with the liver, finely chopped, and cook for about 10 minutes. season with salt to taste.

title: Mongetes ambllomillo
text: fry the salted and peppered pork chops and remove them from the heat when they are almost cooked through drain them and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the beans with minced garlic and parsley. add the pork chops and turn them over until they are fully cooked. if necessary, add a little of the bean cooking liquid.

title: Salsitxes amb samfaina
text: season the sausages with salt and pepper and fry them in oil drain them. add them to a frying pan and let them cook for a while.

title: Panetela
text: beat the eggs with the sugar in a bowl, then add the oil and flour, mixing well. next, add the grated lemon zest and mix again. bake in a preheated oven at 175 c for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Suquet d'ous de tenca
text: start by sautéing the onion, garlic, and tomato in a pot with oil. add white wine, let it reduce, and then add black pepper, bay leaf, and chili flakes. cover with water and bring to a boil. season the perch eggs with salt and pepper, then lightly dust them in flour and add them to the pot.

title: Truites al forn
text: make 4 small, round omelets with eggs, oil, and a little salt. fry the potatoes. in a baking dish, layer fried potatoes, then a little tomato sauce, then the omelet to cover everything well. cover with béchamel sauce and grated cheese, and bake.

title: Arròs a la mesqueta
text: fried rice it is prepared like fried rice, but the broth is added to the searing hot oil and, when it boils, the rice is added. it must be dry.

title: Recipe 3862
text: escudella contramembres ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 1 2 kg de carn de porc a trossos 1 4 kg de botifarra negra 1 4 kg de botifarra blanca 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 4 kg de cigrons cuits 1 4 kg de naps 1 4 kg de patates 1 4 kg de pastanaga 1 4 kg de carbassa 1 branca d api 1 4 d un porro 1 tomàquet madur ratllat sal i pebre negre al gust oli d oliva verge extra aigua elaboració 1.
ingredients: ratllat sal pebre al d oliva

title: Cuixa de xai al forn
text: season the pork leg and brown it in a frying pan with oil and a little lard. once browned, add the vegetables. once the vegetables have softened, add water and cover. bake in the oven until the pork leg is tender, basting it occasionally with the cooking juices. serve the pork leg on a warm plate with the strained sauce on the side.

title: Currutacos
text: cream the lard with the sugar and gradually add the eggs, lemon zest, and cinnamon until you have a creamy dough. add the flour and milk and continue working it until you get a compact but not hard dough. let it rest for 30 minutes. roll it out to a thickness of 1 cm. using cookie cutters, cut out pieces of dough in different shapes and make a hole at one end of each piece. place them on baking sheets, brush with egg, and bake at 180 c for about 20 minutes, until they are dry.

title: El niu
text: soak the monkfish for 4 days and the salted tripe for 2 days. in a pot, make a sofrito with onions and tomatoes. add the monkfish, salted tripe, and thistles, cover with water, and simmer gently. after 20 minutes, add the diced potatoes and continue cooking over low heat. when there are 10 minutes left, stir in the chopped parsley with a little of the cooking liquid.

title: Embotit de coll farcit
text: skin the chicken necks, rinse them, and peel them as if they were socks. chop all the meat, season with salt and pepper, and mix with the egg. stuff the neck and sew up both ends. cook it in the escudella broth. once cooked, let it cool and slice it like a ham.

title: Empedrat
text: combine the drained salt cod, onion, olives, beans, hard-boiled eggs, and tomatoes. season with oil, salt, and pepper.

title: Enciam brut
text: roast the potatoes and onions in the oven. peel the potatoes and remove the skin from the onions. slice the onions and potatoes. layer potatoes, onions, and skinless, boneless herring fillets in a dish. season with oil, salt, pepper, and a few drops of vinegar. serve the salad warm. this dish combines the energy provided by potatoes in the form of starch with the protein from herring. it is also low in cholesterol and very rich in important vitamins, such as b12, as well as vitamins d, c, and b6. the two main ingredients also make this a very heart-healthy dish, as herring is a fatty fish rich in omega-3 fats that help regulate cholesterol levels, and potatoes, rich in potassium and magnesium, are very suitable for people with hypertension. nutritional composition per serving water 251 energy 307 protein g

title: Ensalada russa
text: dice and peel the potatoes and carrots. add the chopped green beans. boil together with the peas. cool and mix in the chopped hard-boiled egg. then add the mayonnaise.

title: Entremesos
text: arrange all the cured meats on a platter in a circular shape, and place the russian salad in the center.

title: Escalivada
text: roast the peppers over the hottest part of the fire for a short time, and the aubergines over a lower heat for longer. wrap the onions and potatoes in aluminum foil and bury them in the embers. check the vegetables are cooked by pressing them gently with your fingers. once the peppers and aubergines are cooked, place them in a covered dish to retain moisture and make peeling easier. peel the ingredients, place them in a serving dish, and season with oil, salt, and pepper. other names rustifaci.

title: Escarola amanida
text: clean, wash, and chop the endive by hand. drain it well. season with oil, salt, and a little vinegar.

title: Romesco
text: mix the romesco sauce with the escarole and serve.

title: Escudella barrejada
text: bring the bones to a boil in a pot with water for half an hour. add the chicken, salt pork, tripe, shank, and giblets, all cut into bite-sized pieces. an hour later, add the diced and washed vegetables, drained. let it simmer for another half hour and add the rice and noodles. allow it to finish cooking and just before serving, add the sausage.

title: Escudella de blat de moro escairat
text: soak the dried corn kernels in water for 24 hours. salt the pork foot or tail. boil everything together over low heat for several hours, until it becomes a thick soup.

title: Escudella de carbassa i mongetes
text: simmer the beans with lean meat, a ham bone, bay leaf, and water. let it cook gently, and when there's about half an hour left of cooking time, add the onion, pumpkin, and rice. serve with the meat shredded.

title: Escudella i carn d'olla
text: in a pot with cold water, place the meats, except for the sausages and the meatball. bring to a boil, skimming frequently, and add the chickpeas. after another hour, add the vegetables, except for the potatoes. meanwhile, combine all the meatball ingredients and work them for a while until well combined. shape into an oval. after another hour of simmering the broth, add the potatoes, sausages, breaded meatball, and salt. cook for another half hour, and when everything is cooked, separate the broth and boil the pasta in it. serve the soup first, followed by the meat stew.

title: Recipe 3878

ingredients: catalana ingredients vedella porc cansalada fumada botifarra negra porc
patates mongetes fesols santa pau civada porro ceba tomàquets madurs

title: Escudella catxaruda
text: clean and wash the vegetables and chop them. bring the water to a boil with the pork bone and breaded calf's sweetbreads skim off any foam as it forms. after an hour, add the vegetables and let it simmer. remove the bone and sweetbreads and add the noodles and rice. season with salt and cook until everything is done.

title: Escudella de Congre
text: soak the conger eel. chop the vegetables and boil them with the eel. once the eel is cooked, remove it. add the rice and noodles, and at the very end, the shredded conger eel.

title: Escudella de mongetes amb bacallà i bledes
text: prepare the chard, wash it and chop it. bring the beans to a boil and when they have about 20 minutes left of cooking time, add the chard, rice, salt cod, and a drizzle of oil. add more water if needed. season with salt and cook until the beans are tender but not falling apart.

title: Escudella Montserrat
text: clean the eel, chop it into pieces and blanch it twice for 3 minutes. place it in the water to simmer. add the chickpeas and beans, and let it cook together. after 1 hour, add the potatoes and cauliflower and let them simmer until they fall apart. strain the broth. mash everything that has been cooked into a coarse crumble. make a soup with the broth, rice, and small pasta.

title: Escumes de Sitges
text: beat the egg whites until soft peaks form, then gradually add the sugar. gently fold in the flour and ground almonds. form portions of dough, about 2.5 cm in diameter, onto trays greased with oil or butter. sprinkle with slivered almonds and granulated sugar. bake in a very low oven until golden.

title: Espardenyes amb tomàquet
text: make a sofrito with the chopped garlic and tomatoes in a paella pan. when it s about halfway cooked, add the cockles and season with salt. let it finish cooking and sprinkle with chopped parsley on top.

title: Espatlla de corder
text: season, pepper, and drizzle the lamb shoulder with oil, then place them on a baking sheet. once browned, add the onion, garlic, tomatoes, bay leaf, rosemary, and thyme. let the vegetables soften, then add the wine and allow it to reduce. baste the meat frequently with the cooking juices and add water if it seems dry. cook until the lamb is cooked through and crispy on the outside. serve the lamb shoulder on a warm platter, with the sauce strained separately.

title: Espigalls bullits
text: clean, wash, and slice the samphire. boil it in plenty of salted water. drain and dress with olive oil.

title: Espinacs a la catalana
text: clean and wash the spinach in two or three waters and drain well. sauté lightly with a little oil. add the pine nuts and soaked raisins. season with salt and pepper and continue to sauté everything together for a couple of minutes.

title: Espines d'anxoves fregides
text: clean the anchovies and keep their spines. soak the spines in milk for half an hour. flour them and fry them in plenty of hot oil. drain them on a paper towel and serve hot.

title: Farcellets de col
text: clean the collard greens by removing the thickest ribs, wash them, blanch the leaves, and cool them with water, drying them on a towel. mix the ground meat, breadcrumbs, raisins, and pine nuts, and season with salt and pepper. place a spoonful of the prepared meat in the center of each leaf and roll it up into a small bundle. dredge the bundles in flour and fry until golden brown. place them in a pot, add the stale wine and let it reduce, add the chopped parsley, and cover with water simmer over low heat for half an hour.

title: Farcit de carnaval
text: it can be made with lamb instead of pork. you can use half pork and half beef. sometimes, cured pork belly is added to the filling. you can make the parcels without filling, just with the cabbage coated in egg and flour. before placing them in the pot, you can make a sofrito of onion, tomato, and bell pepper. you can add cured ham.

title: Espineta amb caragolins
text: marinate the snails for a few hours. make a sofrito with the onion and tomatoes in a pot with olive oil. add the tagine snails, potatoes, and snails, and enough water to cover. about 10 minutes before the end of cooking, add the crushed garlic and stale wine.

title: Esqueixada de bacallà
text: drain the salt cod and mix it with the tomatoes and olives. season with plenty of olive oil, salt, and pepper.

title: Farinetes
text: bring water to a boil, then add the flour, stirring constantly, and cook for about 20 minutes. season with salt and pepper. fry the slices of cured pork belly and serve with the farinata.

title: Farinetes amb bolets barrejats
text: whisk the flour with water, place over heat and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until thickened. keep it on the heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, and season with salt. sauté the onion, garlic, and bell pepper. in another pan with oil, brown the cured pork belly and add the mushrooms. combine the sautéed vegetables, the flour dumplings, the mushrooms, and the chopped parsley, and season with salt and pepper.

title: Farinetes de Fajol
text: put a pot on the heat with the water and gradually add the chickpea flour, stirring constantly until a thick paste forms. pour the mixture into molds and let it cool. cut it into slices and fry them in hot oil until golden brown on all sides. sprinkle with sugar or drizzle with honey.

title: Farinosa
text: dissolve the yeast in the water and add the oil, sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon, and salt. add flour until a consistent dough forms, but not too stiff. cover with a cloth and let it rise to ferment. when it starts to rise, shape it into balls and let them ferment again. roll out the dough balls into half-moon shapes. place pieces of apple, sugar, and a few drops of oil in the center of each piece of dough. brush the edges with egg yolk and fold in half, pressing the edges firmly together. brush the pastries with oil and sprinkle with sugar, then bake in the oven until golden brown.

title: Farro
text: bring the flour and semolina into a pot of boiling water. cook for about 20 minutes, stirring constantly. fry the salt pork and add it to the pot, along with the bread.

title: Recipe 3899
text: escudella contramembres ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 1 2 kg de carn de porc a trossos 1 4 kg de cansalada fumada 1 4 kg de botifarra negra 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 branca d arròs 1 branca de naps 1 branca de pastanaga 1 4 kg de patates 1 4 kg de mongetes seques 1 4 kg de civada 1 4 kg de fesols 1 porro 1 ceba 2 tomàquets madurs 1 fulla de llorer uns grams de fumet de peix oli d oliva
