branca d arròs naps pastanaga patates mongetes civada fesols porro ceba tomàquets madurs fulla

title: Farro tarragoní
text: place a washed pork knuckle and beans in a pot with water. after half an hour, add the vegetables and continue to boil. just before serving, add the pasta and a pinch of salt, and continue cooking until the pasta is done.

title: Faves a la brutesca
text: thread the broad beans onto a skewer and place over heat. shell them while hot and drizzle with the sauce.

title: Faves a la catalana
text: stewed fava beans ingredients 1 kg dried fava beans 1 large onion, roughly chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 carrot, peeled and roughly chopped 1 leek, cleaned and roughly chopped 1 tomato, grated 100g smoked bacon or pancetta, diced 1 sprig of fresh rosemary salt to taste olive oil instructions 1. soak the dried fava beans in cold water overnight. 2. the next day, drain the beans and place them in a large pot with plenty of fresh water. bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the beans are almost tender. 3. while the beans are cooking, heat some olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. add the onion, garlic, carrot, and leek and sauté until softened

title: Estofat de corder amb pataca i olives verdes
text: chop, season with salt and pepper, and brown the meat in a pot with oil. add the onion, tomato, and bay leaf, and let it sauté. pour in the wine and let it reduce, then add water and let it simmer gently with the lid on. when there are about 10 minutes left of cooking time, add the potatoes and olives.

title: Faves amb bledes
text: boil the broad beans and cleaned, chopped chard. drain them and puree. meanwhile, in a paella pan, fry the salted pork with oil and add it with its juices to the vegetables.

title: Estofat d'isard
text: put the gurnard to marinate for 24 hours with the wine, vegetables, and herbs. add water, salt it, and let it cook until the flesh is tender.

title: Estofat de pataca, cigrons i tonyina de sorra
text: start by sautéing the oil, onion, bell pepper, bay leaf, and tomato. add the white wine and let it reduce, then add the potatoes. stir well and add enough of the chickpea cooking liquid to just cover. when the potatoes are almost cooked, add the tuna and chopped parsley. cook the whole mixture for about 5 minutes.

title: Estofat detocino
text: in a pot, place the pork, a drizzle of oil, a head of garlic, herbs, stale wine, a little salt, and water to cover. cover the pot and let it simmer over very low heat for about 3 hours, shaking it occasionally to prevent sticking. when there are about 20 minutes left of cooking, add whole potatoes and crumbled chorizo in a drizzle of water. season with salt to taste.

title: Estofat de vedella
text: brown the seasoned beef in a pot with oil. add the vegetables cut into large chunks, whole garlic cloves, herbs, and a few grains of pepper. stir well, add the wine, and let it reduce. cover the pot and place a large plate with water on top of the lid. simmer until the beef is tender, adding water as needed to prevent sticking. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Gall dindi farcit
text: clean the turkey and debone it through the shoulder to remove the craw. season inside and out with salt and pepper. in a paella with oil, brown the lean meat and sausages cut into cubes. mix the cooked meats and dried fruits. stuff the turkey with this mixture and sew it up through the shoulder to restore its original shape. brown the turkey on all sides in a large, deep, heavy-bottomed pot with oil and lard. add quartered onions, whole garlic cloves, and quartered tomatoes. once everything has browned, add bay leaves, cinnamon, brandy, and wine. cover and simmer for a couple of hours, adding broth as needed during cooking. serve whole with the sauce on the side.

title: Capó farcit
text: clean the capon and debone it through the shoulder to remove the craw. season it inside and out with salt and pepper. in a paella with oil, brown the lean meat and sausages cut into cubes. mix the cooked meats and dried fruits. stuff the capon with this mixture and sew it up through the shoulder to restore its original shape. brown the capon on all sides in a large, deep, heavy-bottomed pot with oil and lard. add the quartered onions, whole garlic cloves, and quartered tomatoes. once everything has browned, add the bay leaf, cinnamon, brandy, and wine. cover and simmer for about two hours, basting the capon occasionally with the cooking sauce. serve whole with the sauce on the side.

title: Gall de Sant Pere amb patates
text: sauté the onion, leeks, garlic, and tomatoes in a deep pot, in that order. season with salt and when cooked, add the potatoes and fish broth until they are covered. just before the potatoes are done, add the fish that has been previously salted and cook over the heat until it is cooked through.

title: Recipe 3912
text: escudella catalana tradicional ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 500 g de carn de porc a trossos 150 g de cansalada viada 100 g de botifarra negra 100 g de botifarra blanca 1 porro gran 2 cebes mitjanes 2 tomàquets madurs 1 enciam català 1 branca d'api 1 pastanaga 1 patata gran 150 g de naps 150 g de mongetes seques 1 os de pernil un grapat de feixos de julivert fresc sal i pe
ingredients: escudella catalana tradicional ingredients vedella tallada
trossos de cansalada viada botifarra negra porro gran mitjanes tomàquets madurs enciam català branca d'api

title: Gallina a la cassola
text: brown the chicken in oil, then add the onions, garlic head, and tomatoes. season with salt and when softened, add water and simmer over low heat until the chicken is stewed. towards the end of cooking, stir in the finely chopped mixture.

title: Galtes de porc a la brasa
text: wash the cheeks and pat them dry. make cross-shaped slits in each cheek. season with salt and pepper and brush with oil. place them on a grill over medium heat, as this is a fibrous meat and takes a long time to cook. during cooking, brush them with a brush dipped in the marinade.

title: Galtes de porc rostides
text: wash and dry the cheeks, then score them with a crosshatch pattern. season with salt and pepper, rub with lard or oil, and place them on a baking sheet in the oven. when browned, add the onions, leek, bouquet garni, and tomatoes. once the vegetables are golden, add the wine, let it reduce, then add water and let everything simmer together. once the cheeks are tender, arrange them in a saucepan and pour the sauce over them. stir in the finely chopped mixture and let it cook together for another 10 minutes. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Galtes de vedella rostides
text: wash and dry the cheeks, then score them with a crosshatch pattern. season with salt and pepper, rub with lard or oil, and place them on a baking sheet in the oven. once browned, add the onions, leek, parsley, and tomatoes. when the vegetables are golden, add the wine, let it reduce, then add water and let everything simmer together. once the cheeks are tender, arrange them in a saucepan and pour the sauce over them. stir in the finely chopped mixture and let it cook together for another 10 minutes. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Gambes a la planxa
text: place the prawns on a very hot grill and season them. when cooked on one side, turn them over to cook the other side. keep in mind that the cooking time should be very short.

title: Gambes amb xocolata
text: sauté the prawns with oil, season with salt and pepper, and set aside. sauté the onion, garlic, parsley, and a piece of orange peel in the same oil. once sautéed, add the prawns back in and deglaze with water. let it cook together for 5 to 8 minutes, then stir in the chopped parsley with a little of the cooking juices.

title: Ganyims amb caragols
text: clean and purge the snails. make a sofrito with garlic, onion, and tomatoes, all chopped, in a pan with olive oil. add the snails and the snails' broth, cover with water, and let it cook until everything is done season with salt if needed.

title: Garoines
text: halve the cockles and remove the viscera. place them on a slice of bread.

title: Garró
text: bring a whole pork leg to a boil in salted water. after about 2 hours, remove it and let it cool. slice it into fairly thin pieces and fry them in oil. as you remove them from the heat, sprinkle with paprika.

title: Gelea de condony
text: simmer the quinces with the lemon juice and water until tender. drain them for 24 hours. combine 450 g of sugar with every 600 cl of filtered liquid and boil for about 10 minutes. pour into molds and let cool.

title: Girella amb cap i potes
text: boil the head and feet of the lamb with water, salt, and herbs drain them and let them cool slightly. remove the meat from the head and, if desired, debone the feet. make a sofrito with onion and tomato, add the meats, chopped parsley, and wine. let it cook for a while, and just before removing it from the heat, add slices of fried veal sweetbreads.

title: Girella dels Pallars
text: clean the stomach and tripe with boiling water. boil the tripe, lung, and heart for about 20 minutes. chop coarsely together with the salt pork belly. mix with rice, eggs, garlic, parsley, saffron, pepper, and salt. stuff the stomach with this mixture, sew it up, and boil for approximately 2 hours, piercing it occasionally. once cold, slice the stuffed stomach into rounds and fry in hot oil.

title: Granotes amb all i julivert
text: season the duck legs, flour them, and fry them. add the minced garlic and parsley at the last moment.

title: Granotes amb samfaina
text: season and fry the frog legs, then drain them. mix them with samfaina and let it cook together for a few minutes.

title: Guatlles escabetxades
text: place the cockles in a pot with the onions, carrots, garlic, bouquet garni, peppercorns, oil, salt, vinegar, and enough water to cover. cover and cook until the meat is tender. let it rest for at least 2 days.

title: Guisat de tonyina
text: sauté the previously salted tuna steaks and set aside. fry the green pepper in a pot with the remaining tuna oil, add the peeled potatoes and enough water to cover, and season with salt. when the potatoes are almost cooked, add the chopped ingredients and, at the last moment, the tuna. let it cook until the potatoes are tender.

title: Postres i dolços
text: mix the ingredients and make a smooth paste. open the pastry shell or can and drop in a tablespoon of the prepared paste. close the mold and place it over high heat until cooked. repeat the process until all the paste is used.

title: La cassola
text: simmer the meat with water, salt, bay leaf, and onions pierced with cloves until tender. let it cool, remove the bones, and chop the meat. mix with egg yolks, honey, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. place in a lard-greased casserole dish, cover the inside with breadcrumbs, and bake in a preheated oven at 180 c for about 30 minutes.

title: Llagosta a la catalana
text: cut the lobster, separating the legs, head, and tail, and season with salt and pepper. set aside the liver and the liquid it releases. sauté the lobster pieces in a pan with oil over high heat, and reserve. sauté the onion, garlic, chopped herbs, and a piece of orange peel in the same pan. return the lobster to the pan and deglaze with fish broth. let it cook together for about 10 minutes and stir in the chopped parsley with the liquid released by the lobsters.

title: Llagostins bullits
text: blanch the langoustines in boiling, salted water. refresh them with ice water and salt.

title: Llagostins al forn
text: sprinkle coarse salt on a baking sheet. arrange the prawns on top and drizzle with oil. bake in a preheated oven until the prawns are cooked through.

title: Llebre en civet
text: marinate the hare with wine, sliced onion, herbs, and pepper for 24 hours reserve the marinade. remove the pieces of meat, season them, and brown them. when they begin to color, add the onion and herbs, and after a while, the marinade. let it cook together, covered and over low heat, until the meat is tender, adding water as needed. remove the herbs, stir in the chopped parsley, and let the cooking finish over low heat for about 10 minutes. season with salt and pepper. arrange the hare on a warm platter and pour the sauce over it.

title: Llebre amb xocolata
text: marinate the hare with the vegetables, spices, and wine for at least 24 hours. drain the meat and vegetables, reserving the marinade liquid. season the hare pieces and brown them in a pot with oil. add the salt pork, then the vegetables, and fry for a few more minutes. moisten with the marinade liquid and water if needed, until covered. cover and simmer over low heat for about 2 hours, or until the hare is tender. strain the hare and transfer it to a saucepan. add the strained sauce. season with salt and add the chopped parsley with a little of the cooking liquid. simmer over low heat for another 10 minutes.

title: Llengua de vedella guisada amb pèsols
text: blanch and peel the tongue. season with salt and pepper, and gently sauté it in a pot with bacon and salt pork. add the onion, carrots, minced garlic, and a bouquet garni. when the vegetables are browned, add wine, let it reduce, and then add water to cover. simmer until the tongue is tender. slice the tongue, place it in a pot with the strained sauce and peas, and simmer until the peas are cooked.

title: Llengua de vedella amb moixernons
text: simmer the tongue, peel it, and slice it, then season with salt. dredge it in flour, fry it in a pan with oil, and set aside. make a sofrito with chopped onion and tomatoes. add the tongue, soaked chanterelle mushrooms, and a little water if needed, and let it simmer for about 30 minutes. just before serving, stir in the finely chopped parsley.

title: Llenguado fregit
text: dredge the plaice fillets in salt and flour, then quickly fry them in a hot pan with plenty of oil.

title: Postres i dolços
text: in a bowl, cream together the butter, a pinch of vanilla, eggs, and sugar very well. gradually add the flour until the dough comes together and is smooth. transfer the dough to a piping bag and pipe elongated shapes onto a baking sheet, leaving space between each one. bake in a preheated oven at 180 c for a very short time, then cool on marble.

title: Llenties bullides
text: bring the lentils to a boil in cold mineral water, first over high heat, then continue cooking gently. season with salt at the end.

title: Llenties estofades amb costella de porc
text: sauté the cured pork belly and ribs in a pot with a little oil. once they've browned slightly, add the onion, garlic head, tomatoes, and a handful of herbs. when well sautéed, add the rinsed lentils and water to cover. season with salt and simmer, covered, over low heat until the lentils are cooked. depending on the lentil variety, they may need to be soaked beforehand.

title: Llenties amb vinagre
text: rinse the lentils and place them in a pot to boil with onion, leek, aromatic herbs, peppercorns, salt, and water. meanwhile, in a paella pan, sauté the chopped onion, then add the drained lentils and stir. once removed from the heat, drizzle with a tablespoon of vinegar. nutritional information for a half portion of daily reference intake energy 211 10.6 protein 12.1 24.2 total fat 5.95 8.5 total carbohydrates 22.4 8.3 dietary fiber 9.4 31.3 saturated fat 0.9 monounsaturated fat

title: Llet merengada
text: heat the milk with the sugar, cinnamon stick, and lemon zest. reduce the milk, stirring constantly. strain it and place it in the freezer, stirring occasionally, until it reaches a slushy consistency. whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gently fold them into the frozen milk. serve in glasses and sprinkle with a little cinnamon powder.

title: Llenguado a la nyoca
text: fry the salted, floured sole in a paella pan with oil and set aside. in the same oil, sauté the dried fruits until they begin to brown, then sprinkle them over the sole.

title: Llom rostit a la cassola
text: sear the salt-seasoned pork loin in a pot with oil and lard. once browned, add the vegetables and herbs. when the vegetables are browned, flame with cognac. add a little water, cover, and simmer until the pork is tender. slice it and add the strained sauce and chopped garnish on top. let it come to a simmer together.

title: Llom amb samfaina
text: season the pork loin and fry it in oil drain it. add it to the frying pan and let it cook until the loin is tender.

title: Llom amb llet
text: season and flour the pork loin, and brown it in a casserole dish with oil. once it s slightly browned, sprinkle the almonds over the top, chopped and mixed with milk. bake everything together in the oven, shaking occasionally to prevent sticking. season with salt and pepper to taste. the sauce should have a thick texture and a white color.

title: Recipe 3948
text: escudella contramembres ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 1 2 kg de carn de porc a trossos 1 4 kg de botifarra negra 1 4 kg de botifarra blanca 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 4 kg de cigrons cuits 1 4 kg de naps tallats a rodones 1 4 kg de patates tallades a daus 1 4 kg de pastanaga tallada a rodones 1 4 kg de carbassa tallada a daus 1 branca d'api 1 ceba 2 tomàquets madurs ratllats 1 pell de llimona sal i pebre al gust
ingredients: ingredients vedella tallada trossos trossos botifarra negra botifarra
pastanaga tallada rodones carbassa tallada daus branca ceba tomàquets madurs

title: Llomillo amb salsa de tomàquet
text: sear the salted pork belly in a paella pan. add the tomato sauce and let it cook together for a few minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.

title: Lluç a la romana
text: season the slices of monkfish. flour them and dip them in beaten egg. fry them in plenty of hot oil, ensuring they are golden brown on both sides and cooked through.

title: Lluerna a l'all cremat
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a daus 500 g de carn de porc a trossos 150 g de botifarra negra 150 g de botifarra blanca 100 g de peu de porc salat 1 2 kg de mongetes seques 1 4 kg de naps 1 4 kg de patates 1 4 kg de pastanagues 1 branca d enesca 1 fulla de llorer sal i pebre negre al gust oli d oliva verge extra elaboració 1. remenarem les mongetes en aigua freda durant unes hores, o millor, la nit anterior. 2.
ingredients: sal pebre al gust d oliva verge

title: Llunes de Vilanova
text: cream the butter with the caster sugar and salt. gradually add the remaining ingredients, except the egg and flour. make a smooth dough, then add the flour and knead until it can be rolled out. chill the dough in the refrigerator. roll out the dough to a ½ cm thickness and cut out crescent shapes using a cutter. brush the crescents with beaten egg, sprinkle with sugar, and bake in a preheated oven at 180 c for 7-8 minutes.

title: Macarrons
text: boil the pasta in water with salt, bay leaf, and a drizzle of olive oil. brown the meat in a pan with oil, then add the onion, garlic, and tomatoes. simmer everything together over low heat until the meat is cooked. if all the liquid has evaporated before the meat is cooked, add a little of the pasta water. mix with the pasta and top with grated cheese before baking.

title: Macarrons amb bacallà
text: boil the pasta in water with salt and a drizzle of olive oil. make a sofrito with onion, tomato, and a bay leaf in a saucepan, seasoning with salt and pepper. once the sofrito is ready, add the salt cod and stir. combine the pasta with the sofrito and salt cod.

title: Postres i dolços
text: make juice with 2 oranges. chop the remaining fruit into small, even squares. place them in a bowl and moisten with the orange juice.

title: Maduixes amb vi i sucre
text: place the cleaned and roughly chopped strawberries in a bowl. sprinkle over the sugar and sweet wine. let it sit for a while. these easy-to-prepare desserts provide a large amount of vitamin c and folic acid, as well as being a moderate source of iron, magnesium, and phosphorus. the high vitamin c content of strawberries makes this dish an excellent antioxidant, in addition to its role in collagen formation, bones, and teeth, and helping to better absorb iron from food. strawberries are also recommended for people with high blood pressure due to their low sodium and high potassium content, and their diuretic effect.

title: Maduixes amb vinagre
text: place the cleaned and roughly chopped strawberries in a bowl. sprinkle with sugar and a few drops of vinegar. let it sit for a while. this dessert is easy to prepare and rich in vitamin c, folic acid, and fiber. the high vitamin c content of strawberries makes this dish particularly suitable for winter, as it helps boost resistance to infections. it is also an antioxidant and aids in better iron absorption. furthermore, the high folic acid content makes this dessert very beneficial for pregnant women, as this important vitamin helps prevent fetal deformities such as spina bifida.

title: Magdalenes
text: lightly beat the eggs with the sugar add the oil while stirring, then the milk. incorporate the flour, salt, and sifted baking powder. let it rest in the refrigerator. grease the muffin tins with a little more oil and flour and fill them with the batter to about ¾ full. bake in a preheated oven at 170 c for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the muffins are golden brown.

title: Magranes amb moscatell
text: remove the seeds from the pomegranates and place them in a bowl with the muscatel and sugar. let it macerate for a few hours.

title: Maionesa
text: whisk the egg yolk in a mortar with salt, gradually adding the oil drop by drop, stirring constantly with the mortar s pestle until a thick, smooth sauce forms.

title: Mandonguilles de bacallà
text: poach the salt cod, cool it, flake it, and pound it in a mortar. mix it with bread, garlic, parsley, egg, a pinch of flour, salt, and pepper. form this mixture into small meatballs, lightly flour them, and fry them. in a saucepan, heat some oil to fry. sauté the reserved chopped vegetables in the oil, deglaze with stale wine, add water, and then add the meatballs until they are cooked through.

title: Mandonguilles amb calamars
text: meatballs with cuttlefish and peas ingredients 500g ground beef 200g cuttlefish, cleaned and chopped 100g peas, fresh or frozen 1 small onion, finely chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 50g breadcrumbs fresh parsley, chopped salt and pepper to taste olive oil 400ml tomato sauce instructions 1. in a bowl, combine the ground beef, cuttlefish, onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, and parsley. season with salt and pepper. 2. mix well until all ingredients are thoroughly combined. 3. form the mixture into small meatballs, approximately 2-3cm in diameter. 4. heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. 5. add the meatballs

title: Mandonguilles de peix
text: debone the fish, removing all bones and skin. mix it with soaked bread, well squeezed, minced garlic and parsley, a beaten egg, salt and pepper. form this mixture into meatballs. dust them with flour, fry them in hot oil and set aside. make a sofrito with onion and tomato in a saucepan with oil. add a tablespoon of flour, stir for a few minutes, then add white wine and let it reduce. moisten with fish broth and let it simmer for about 20 minutes. strain the sauce and pour it into the saucepan along with the meatballs. add the chopped chives, with the cooking juices, and let it cook over low heat for about 10 minutes.

title: Mandonguilles amb sípia i pèsols
text: make the meatballs with the meat, breadcrumb, egg, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper. dredge them in flour and fry them. in the same oil, sauté the onion and tomatoes, add the cuttlefish, stir, add water, and let it cook until the cuttlefish begins to soften. add the meatballs, chopped parsley, and peas. season with salt to taste and let it simmer gently until cooked through.

title: Mandonguilles amb tomàquet
text: make the meatballs with the minced meats, finely chopped garlic and parsley, eggs, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper. coat them in flour and fry them in a pan. add tomato sauce, moisten with a little water, and let it simmer together for a while. season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Mantecado
text: heat the milk with the lemon and cinnamon for 2 minutes. whisk the egg yolks with the sugar, then stir in the strained milk and diluted cornstarch. return to the heat and stir constantly until it begins to thicken. beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form and fold them into the custard when it is completely cold. chill.

title: Mató
text: bring the milk to a boil, remove from heat, and stir in the diluted rennet. strain the milk through a very fine cheesecloth to separate the cheese curds from the whey.

title: Mel i mató
text: serve the cut mató on individual plates and drizzle with honey.

title: Melindros
text: separate the egg yolks and whites. beat the egg yolks with the sugar until light and fluffy. gradually add the sifted flour, mixing well. gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites. fill a piping bag fitted with a round nozzle with the batter and pipe it onto parchment paper in strips about 2 inches long sprinkle with powdered sugar. bake in a hot oven for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the surface of the biscuits is golden.

title: Menjar blanc
text: blanch, peel, and chop the almonds. soak them in water for a few hours, then drain them using a cloth until all the almond milk has been squeezed out. place the almond milk in a saucepan with cinnamon, sugar, salt, and a lemon peel. add the diluted cornstarch, stirring constantly until thickened. serve in dishes or small bowls. nutritional information these are very energetic desserts, rich in sugars, proteins, and fats from the milk. due to their calcium and phosphorus content, they are very suitable for situations where an extra intake of these minerals is needed, such as during growth or in cases of osteoporosis. they are also easy to chew and a very nutritious concentrated food, making them suitable for convalescence and the elderly. nutritional composition per serving water 226 energy 444 22.2 protein 11.4 22.8

title: Menjar blanc tarragonès
text: blanch almonds, peel them, and chop them finely. soak them in water for a few hours and strain them through a cloth until all the almond milk has been extracted. place the almond milk in a saucepan with cinnamon, sugar, salt, and lemon zest. add the cornstarch dissolved in a little water and stir constantly until thickened. serve in a dish or small bowls.

title: Menjar de traginers
text: debone and shred the boiled meat. sauté the onion and tomato. mix the boiled meat with the sautéed vegetables and stir everything together in the paella pan.

title: Mona de Pasqua
text: mix the flour with the sugar, eggs, salt, yeast, butter, and lemon zest. gradually add milk, a little at a time, until a smooth, elastic dough forms that doesn t stick to your hands. let it rest for 30 minutes. shape the dough into a round and make a hole in the center, gradually enlarging it to form a crown shape. brush with oil and arrange hard-boiled eggs all over, securing them with cloves. brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar. let it rise for about 20 minutes and bake in a preheated oven at 170 c for approximately 45 minutes.

title: Mongeta verda amb pernil
text: boil the chopped beans with water and salt, and drain them. fry the cured pork belly in a paella pan and remove it when it's nicely browned. in the same oil, sauté the garlic cloves and tomatoes. once the tomatoes are cooked, add the beans and pork belly. this dish is primarily a source of high-quality protein from the pork belly, making it very beneficial during growth stages, and also fiber from the green beans, which helps maintain good bowel function. it is also particularly rich in antioxidant vitamins, such as c and e, as well as vitamin a, folic acid, iron, and magnesium. remember that serrano ham has a high salt content, so it is advisable to moderate its consumption in people with high blood pressure. nutritional information per serving water 323 energy 232 protein 11.8 23.6

title: Mongetes amb bolets
text: soak the snails. sauté the garlic and parsley in a saucepan with oil. add the snails and some of the strained soaking water, and let it cook together until the snails are done. add the beans with a little of their cooking liquid and chopped parsley, and bring it to a boil.

title: Botifarra amb mongetes
text: grill or fry the sausages. add the freshly cooked and still warm beans, dressed with a generous drizzle of olive oil and served with the sausages.

title: Mongetes bullides
text: soak the beans for about 12 hours. cook them in cold mineral water, ensuring the water covers the beans by about four finger widths. simmer over low heat, adding cold water if needed. salt them at the end of the cooking time.

title: Mongetes anb cansalada i botifarra esparracada
text: fry the salted pork belly in hot oil. once browned, add the perol sausage, sliced open lengthwise, so that it spreads out. add the drained beans and, over high heat, stir frequently until they are slightly crispy.

title: Mongetes amb cap de vedella
text: make a sofrito with garlic and parsley in a saucepan with olive oil. add the drained beans and the diced veal. season with salt and cook over heat for about 10 minutes.

title: Mongetes amb coliflor
text: boil the cauliflower in water and salt. mix the beans with the cauliflower and dress with a generous drizzle of oil and salt.

title: Mongetes amb confitat de porc
text: in a paella, sauté the ribs with their own fat. add the drained beans and cook for a while, stirring occasionally.

title: Mongetes a l'estil pobre
text: start by sautéing the onion, garlic, and tomato. add the paprika and salted cod. stir well, then add the drained beans and let it simmer for a while. if needed, add some of the bean cooking liquid.

title: Mongetes estofades amb orella i morro
text: place everything, cold, into a pot the beans, the ear, the snout, a piece of salted pork belly, the onion, the head of garlic, and the bay leaf. cover with water. simmer over low heat, shaking the pot occasionally. season with salt at the end.

title: Recipe 3984
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella 150 g de cansalada viada 150 g de botifarra negra 150 g de peu de porc salat 1 branca d'arròs o ferradura 1 2 kg de patates 1 4 kg de naps 1 4 kg de pastanagues 1 4 kg de mongetes seques 1 branca de julivert fresc sal i pebre negre al gust oli d'oliva verge extra elaboració 1. la nit abans, posar les mongetes en remull en aigua freda. 2. en una olla gran, pos
ingredients: escudella catalana ingredients vedella de cansalada viada 150 botifarra negra porc
sal pebre al gust oli d'oliva verge

title: Mongetes tendres bullides amb patates
text: boil the potatoes in a pot of water. when they are half-cooked, add the beans. once cooked, drain them and dress with olive oil, seasoning with salt.

title: Moniatos fregits amb sucre i canyella
text: peel the sweet potatoes and slice them thinly. fry them in hot oil until golden brown. once removed from the oil, sprinkle them with sugar and a dusting of cinnamon.

title: Morro i orella amb mongetes
text: boil the trotters and ears in salted water for 1 hour with a peeled onion, a clove of garlic, and a bay leaf. once cooked, cut the meat into pieces and set aside. make a thick, concentrated sofrito with the remaining onion and tomatoes in a saucepan add the wine and let it reduce. stir in the flour and cook for a few minutes. immediately add the pieces of trotter and ear and cover them with some of the cooking broth. simmer, then add the chopped parsley and the beans after 5 minutes.

title: Mostillo
text: bring the grape must and walnuts to a boil for about 30 minutes let it cool slightly. return it to the heat, add the flour diluted with a little cold must, stir well, and let it cook for another 20 minutes. let it cool before serving and cut into portions.

title: Recipe 3989
text: escudella contramembres ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella tallada a trossos 1 2 kg de carn de porc a trossos 1 4 kg de cansalada viada 1 4 kg de botifarra negra 1 4 kg de peu de porc salat 1 branca d arròs 1 2 kg de naps 1 2 kg de patates 1 4 kg de pastanagues 1 4 kg de mongetes seques 1 4 kg de civada 1 porro 2 alls 1 ceba unes fulles de romaní sal i pebre negre al gust
ingredients: ingredients vedella tallada trossos trossos cansalada viada botifarra negra porc
pastanagues mongetes civada porro alls ceba fulles romaní pebre al gust

title: Musclos a la marinera
text: steam the mussels with a little water in a covered pot and strain the broth. sauté the onion and tomato, add the wine and let it reduce, then stir in the flour and cook for a few minutes. moisten with mussel cooking water and simmer for 10 minutes. add the mussels and chopped herbs, and cook for another 5 minutes.

title: Musclos al vapor
text: clean the mussels. place them in a large pot with the bay leaf, peppercorns, and halved lemon. remove from the heat just as the mussels open and serve immediately.

title: Neules
text: combine the flour, butter, sugar, egg white, and lemon zest until a smooth dough forms if the dough is too stiff, add a few drops of water. let it rest. roll out the dough into circles on parchment paper and bake at 170 c until golden. remove from the oven and quickly roll them into a cylindrical shape around a rolling pin.

title: Oca amb peres
text: clean the goose, singe it, wash it, and cut it into large pieces. brown it in a pot with a little oil over low heat, allowing it to release its fat. remove the excess fat and add the onion, herbs, and tomatoes. pour in the wine and let it reduce, then add water and simmer gently for approximately 1 1 2 hours. add the peeled pears halfway through cooking. in the last 10 minutes, add the chopped walnuts with stale wine. season with salt to taste. serve the goose on a warm platter with the pears around it and the sauce over the top.

title: Ofegat de la Segarra
text: start by sautéing the onion and tomatoes. add the trotters, ear, snout, cheek, and a whole head of garlic, all chopped into pieces. cover with plenty of water, add salt, paprika, and black pepper. cover the pot well and simmer over low heat for approximately 2 hours. when there are 20 minutes left of cooking time, add the potatoes and chopped parsley, and cook until the potatoes are done.

title: Olives cendroses
text: olives a la cendra ingredients 1 kg d'olives verdes, de preferent varietat grosella o similar aigua abundant sal gruixuda oli d'oliva verge extra fulles de llorer branquetes de romaní fresc alls tendres elaboració 1. rentarem les olives a fons sota aigua corrent per treure ls tota la pols i la terra. 2. posarem les olives en remull en aigua abundant durant 24 hores, canviant l aigua cada 8 hores. això ajudarà a treure ls part del sabor amarg. 3. després de les 24 hores, escalfarem una olla gran amb aigua

title: Olives fregides
text: pit the olives and fry them in a paella pan, covered, until they release some of their oil. serve them preferably hot.

title: Olives mortes en conserva
text: once you ve picked the olives from the tree, freeze them for 2 days. then, spread them out in the sun and in good weather with plenty of salt. when they are dry, mix them with orange peel, lemon peel, lots of salt, thyme, olive oil, and a few drops of vinegar. store them in glass jars or tins.

title: Olla aranesa
text: make a broth with the meats, sage, and beans. let it simmer for a couple of hours, skimming occasionally. add the cabbage, carrots, potatoes, and leeks to the pot. prepare the meatball by mixing the meats with egg, salt, pepper, garlic, parsley, and breadcrumbs, and when it's firm, dust it with flour. after a while, add the noodles and the meatball, and just before serving, add the black pudding.

title: Olla barrejada
text: in a pot, bring the pork face, shank, and bones to a boil. when the meat is almost cooked, remove the bones and shank, and add the chopped cabbage and diced potatoes. then add the chickpeas, noodles, and rice. after about 10 minutes, add the saffron and beans.

title: Olla de congre amb hortalisses i arròs
text: soak the conger eel and beans. blanch the eel and drain it. bring the beans to a boil in a pot and when they are half-cooked, add the eel. clean and wash the chard, drain it and chop it. when there are 20 minutes left of cooking time, add the rice, chard, potatoes, and seasoned breadcrumbs with a drizzle of oil.

title: Olla de recapte
text: start by sautéing the garlic, red pepper, and bay leaf. separately, boil the potatoes and chard, then add the beans and artichoke hearts. add the sautéed mixture to the pot with the vegetables.

title: Olla verda
text: simmer the backbone bones, trimmed and floured veal, and salt pork for about an hour. skim off any foam. remove the bones, add the vegetables, potatoes, and lettuce. bring to a boil, then add the rice and noodles.

title: Òpera
text: fry the sea bass, gilt-head bream, squid, prawns, red prawns, and lobster, lightly and one at a time, seasoned with salt and dredged in flour. place them in a very large pan, ensuring the pieces don t overlap. in the same oil used for the fish, make a concentrated sauté with onion, tomato, and bay leaf. add the wine, let it reduce, deglaze with fish broth, and let it simmer. pour this sauce over the fish in the pan, add the chopped parsley, and let it cook over low heat for a few minutes, shaking the pan occasionally. add the mussels and clams and finish cooking everything together.

title: Orada escabetxada
text: cut the whiting into slices, then season with salt, flour it, and fry it, placing it in a casserole dish. in the same oil, strain it, and fry the garlic cloves until golden. add the paprika, vinegar, and bay leaf, and let the vinegar reduce. add a little water and let it simmer for about 4 minutes. pour this sauce over the whiting and let it marinate for a few hours.

title: Orada a la sal
text: remove the innards of the bream, but not the scales. rinse and drain it. spread a 1 cm thick layer of salt on the bottom of a baking dish, place the bream on top, and completely cover it with a layer of salt. spritz with water and bake at high temperature for 20 to 25 minutes. to serve, remove the salt crust and this will detach the skin and scales from the fish. it can be served with a light sauce or some vegetables. it can be seasoned with extra virgin olive oil and served with steamed potatoes.

title: Orelletes
text: sift the flour, form it into a mound, and make a well in the center. add the eggs, anise, marzipan liqueur, 125g of sugar, herbs, and the yeast dissolved in warm water. combine the ingredients in the center first, then gradually incorporate the surrounding flour until you have a smooth, firm dough. cover the dough with a cloth and let it rest for 4 to 5 hours. next, shape the dough into large walnut-sized balls, cover them, and let them rest for a while. roll out the balls into discs about 3 feet in diameter. fry them in a pan on both sides and sprinkle generously with sugar.

title: Ortigues de mar fregides
text: clean the nettles thoroughly, lightly dust them with rice flour, and fry them in plenty of oil.

title: Ous durs
text: boil the eggs in water and salt for 10 minutes. the white and yolk should be completely set. to peel them easily, they should be eggs that are 6 or 7 days old. fresh eggs are very difficult to peel and the whites break easily.

title: Ous ferrats
text: in a paella pan with oil, add the eggs two at a time. pour hot oil over them, until the whites are set. drain them and season with salt. traditionally served with french fries. the oil should be very hot and abundant, so the tips of the whites will be crispy.

title: Ous ferrats amb mel
text: fry two eggs in a paella with hot oil season them. when the whites are set, place them on a plate and drizzle with honey.

title: Ous passats per aigua
text: boil the eggs in salted water for 3 minutes. remove them and serve immediately. the white should be lightly cooked, and the yolk runny.

title: Ous al plat
text: grease individual earthenware dishes with butter, crack 2 eggs into each, season with salt, and drizzle a little oil over the yolks. place the dishes on a griddle for a moment to allow the whites to begin setting, then finish cooking them in the oven, ensuring the yolks remain tender and the whites are fully set. serve in the same dishes.

title: Ous de reig a la brasa
text: grill the quail eggs over charcoal, being careful not to dry them out too much, and season with salt. once removed from the grill, drizzle with a little olive oil.

title: Ous remenats
text: in a paella pan with not-too-hot oil, add the lightly beaten and seasoned eggs. stir constantly with a whisk or fork until they have a creamy texture.

title: Ous remenats amb fredolics
text: in a paella with oil, sauté the blanquettes until they release all their water. season them and mix with lightly beaten eggs. stir constantly until the eggs are almost set.

title: Ous remenats amb tomàquet
text: in a paella, fry the tomatoes with oil, salt, pepper, and a little sugar. lower the heat, add the eggs and keep stirring until they begin to set and the mixture has the consistency of a jam.

title: Amanides i plats freds
text: rub the bread with garlic. season with olive oil and salt, and serve with grapes. this simple and economical recipe, with the sweetness of the grapes contrasting with the garlic, makes for a very healthy breakfast or snack, as it combines two products with excellent properties and widely used in traditional catalan cuisine olive oil and garlic. it is especially suitable for preventing cardiovascular diseases, as olive oil, when consumed raw, is rich in monounsaturated fatty acids that help reduce cholesterol levels, and garlic helps reduce blood pressure. nutritional composition per serving rda water 98.9 12.55 energy 251 protein 5.8 11.60 total fat 4.1 5.86 total carbohydrates 46.3 17.15 dietary fiber 2.

title: Pa de figues
text: chop the almonds, figs, and walnuts separately in a mortar and then mix them in a bowl. add the muscatel and anise, and stir everything until you have a homogeneous and compact mixture. place it in a floured mold with a weight on top and, every 3 hours, compress it with your hands, being careful not to break the shape you have given it. let it rest in a cool place for 2 to 4 days. when serving, slice it.

title: Pa amb llard i sucre
text: scatter lard over the warm slices of bread. sprinkle sugar on top.

title: Pa amb mel i nous
text: brush the slices of bread with honey while they are still warm, then sprinkle with walnuts. nutritional information per serving water 27.8 energy 314 protein 7.3 total fat 10.3 total carbohydrates 46.6 dietary fiber 3 saturated fat 1.3 monounsaturated fat 1.8 polyunsaturated fat 6.5 cholesterol 0 nutrient highlights per serving agm agp ags 6.
ingredients: energy protein fat carbohydrates fiber cholesterol nutrient highlights agm ags

title: Pa amb oli i sucre
text: brush the bread slices with oil and sprinkle with sugar.

title: Pa amb oli i xocolata
text: bread with olive oil and sugar this simple and economical recipe, perfect for snacks or desserts, combines two very healthy ingredients olive oil and cocoa. both promote cholesterol reduction in the body when consumed regularly and are a good source of antioxidants. additionally, chocolate contains phosphorus and magnesium, necessary for maintaining bones and teeth. it is recommended to use extra virgin olive oil to enhance its nutritional richness. nutritional information per serving water 21.3 energy 260 protein 5.9 total fat 8.5 total carbohydrates 38 dietary fiber 4.4 saturated fat 3.4 monounsaturated fat 3.9 polyunsaturated fat 0.70 cholesterol 1.4
ingredients: energy protein fat carbohydrates fiber fat fat cholesterol

title: Pa de pessic de Vic
text: whisk the eggs with the sugar and lemon zest until doubled in volume. gently fold in the flour and sifted baking powder using a spatula. pour the mixture into a greased and floured baking tin and bake in a preheated oven at 180 for about 30 minutes.

title: Pa amb el tel de mel i llet
text: bring the milk to a rolling boil, ensuring it comes to a boil three times. let it cool. once cold, remove the skin from the milk, spread the skin over the slices of bread, and drizzle generously with honey.

title: Pa amb tomàquet
text: slice the bread. rub the bread with a halved tomato. season with oil and salt and eat immediately before it goes soggy.

title: Pa amb vi i sucre
text: brush the bread slices with red wine. sprinkle with sugar.

title: Paella
text: in a paella pan with oil, brown the salted ribs and rabbit, and set them aside. in the same oil, sauté the prawns and langoustines, and remove them. make a sofrito with onion, peppers, and tomatoes. once the sofrito is ready, add the squid until it releases its water. add the meat, mussels, and peas, then the rice. stir well, add hot water, and let it simmer for approximately 18 minutes. five minutes before the end, add the seafood and the chopped parsley with a little of the paella s liquid. if needed, add a splash of boiling water.

title: Palos
text: make the pastry as for wind fritters. using a piping bag with a fluted nozzle, pipe long strips. bake in the oven at 180-190ºf until golden brown and firm. meanwhile, heat the milk. whisk the egg yolks with the sugar and mix in the flour dissolved in a little cold water. add the milk and place over heat, stirring constantly, until it comes to a boil, to create a custard. let the oven-baked pieces cool, then slice them lengthwise and fill with the custard.

title: Palpís de corder
text: debone the thigh, season with salt and pepper, and stuff it with cured lean bacon, a clove of garlic, and chopped parsley. tie the thigh, place it to roast in a casserole dish with a little oil. once browned on all sides, add the vegetables, garlic, and herbs, and let it cook for a while with the lid on. add the white wine and sherry, and let them reduce. baste the thigh frequently with the cooking juices until it s cooked through. once the thigh is roasted, remove the herbs and strain the sauce. slice the thigh and place it on a warm platter with the sauce poured over.

title: Panadons d'espinacs
text: clean the spinach and wash it in two or three waters. mix the flour with a little salt and then with the yeast diluted in water. work it until you get a smooth dough. form some balls from the dough, slightly larger than an egg, cover them with a cloth and let them rest to rise. separately, mix the spinach with pine nuts and raisins, and season with salt and pepper. roll out the dough balls into circles and place some filling on each. close the turnovers by folding the dough in half, so they resemble a crescent shape, and press the edges together with your fingers to seal them. bake the turnovers in the oven for half an hour.

title: Panadons de carbassa
text: combine the flour with a little salt, then add the yeast diluted in water. knead until a smooth dough forms. shape the dough into balls slightly larger than an egg, cover them with a cloth, and let them rest to rise. separately, mix the pumpkin with pine nuts and raisins, and season with salt and pepper. roll out the dough balls into circles and place some filling on each. close the panadons by folding the dough in half, forming a crescent shape, and press the edges together with your fingers to seal. bake the panadons in the oven for half an hour.

title: Panellets d'ametlla
text: make a thin dough by mixing and working all the ingredients thoroughly. let it rest in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours, wrapped in a damp cloth. shape the dough into oval balls of about 20g each, dip them in egg, and attach a slivered almond by pressing it gently. brush the panellets with egg. place them in an oiled baking tin and bake in the oven at 230-250 c for about 10 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Panellets de  cafè
text: make a thin dough by combining and kneading all ingredients well. let it rest in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours, wrapped in a damp cloth. form oval-shaped balls of dough, about 20g each, dip them in egg, and mix the finely ground coffee with the dough. also coat with icing sugar and make a slit down the middle to resemble a coffee bean. brush the panellets with egg. place them in an oiled tin and bake in the oven at 230-250 c for about 10 minutes, until golden.

title: Panellets de coco
text: combine the shredded coconut and egg whites with the marzipan dough until you have a mixture slightly firmer than that used for pine nut panellets. roll the mixture into balls and shape them into pyramids with a flat base using your fingertips. brush the panellets with beaten egg and bake in a preheated oven at 230-250 f for about 10 minutes, or until they are set.

title: Panellets de codonyat
text: roll out the marzipan dough for pine nut sweets into a rectangular strip. spread sliced quince strips along one side, cover with the other half of the dough, and press the seam together with a fork to ensure it s sealed. cut into portions and bake in the oven as you would pine nut sweets.

title: Panellets de pinyons
text: make a thin dough by mixing and working all the ingredients well. let it rest in the refrigerator for at least 24 hours, wrapped in a damp cloth. form small balls of dough, about 20g each, dip them in egg, and press pine nuts into them. brush the panellets with egg. place them in an oiled tin and bake in the oven at 230-250 for about 10 minutes, until golden.

title: Paracotes
text: whisk together the eggs, milk, anise, lemon zest, and mint. add the yeast and flour until you achieve a smooth, thin batter. stir in the figs, then use a spoon to coat the figs with the batter and fry them in hot oil. sprinkle with sugar when you remove them from the heat.

title: Pastissets de Tortosa
text: rub the flour with oil, aniseed, and sugar. shape into balls and flatten them into circles. fill the circles with angel hair pasta and fold them into a crest shape, which you will define by pressing your fingers. brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with sugar, and bake until golden brown.

title: Pataca amb abadejo
text: in a pot, place the potatoes covered with water. when they ve been boiling for a while, add the peas and, a little later, the well-drained salt cod. just before serving, add the finely chopped parsley and a drizzle of olive oil. season with salt and add the hard-boiled eggs, cut in half.

title: Patata amb ceba, bacallà i allioli
text: boil the potatoes, onion, and bay leaf in a pot with just enough water to cover them. after a while, add the cubed or shredded salt cod. serve in a deep dish, with the cooking broth, seasoned with a spoonful of garlic alioli mixed with parsley.

title: Patates estofades amb costella de porc
text: in a pot with oil and lard, fry the ribs until well browned. then, make a concentrated sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomatoes. add water, let it boil, and add the potatoes. season with salt and pepper, and add the chopped parsley at the last moment.

title: Patates amb fredolics
text: boil the potatoes with their skins on, peel them, and mash them. fry the salted pork belly and garlic until golden brown, then add the chard. once the chard is cooked, stir in the mashed potatoes.

title: Patates emmascarades
text: boil the potatoes, peel them, and mash them. fry the salted pork belly in a paella pan, add the black pudding meat, and stir. add the potatoes and mix well.

title: Patates farcides
text: boil the potatoes with their skins on, cut them in half and scoop out the flesh set aside. make a sofrito with onion and garlic, add the ground meat and let it cook for a while, stirring to prevent it from forming balls. add the stale wine, let it reduce, and add the hard-boiled eggs. stuff the potatoes, sprinkle with the picada and bake for a few minutes.

title: Patates fregides
text: peel and cut the potatoes into regular sticks. fry them in a large pan with plenty of hot oil. drain and season with salt.

title: Olot
text: make a sofrito with the onion and tomatoes. add the ground meat, breadcrumb, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. add the sherry and let it reduce. slice the potatoes and fry them. take the potato slices two at a time, put meat paste in the middle, dip them in egg white, and fry them. other names potatoes of the ten, split potatoes.

title: Patates de pastor
text: boil the potatoes and slice them thickly. arrange them on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil, salt, pepper, minced garlic, and parsley. cut the uncured bacon into small pieces and scatter them over the potatoes.

title: Patates amb pela
text: boil the potatoes with their skins on and slice them thickly. fry the salted pork belly until it releases its fat and set aside. in the same oil, brown the potato slices until they are golden. add the chopped garlic and parsley. serve the dish with the fried pork belly.

title: Patates viudes
text: make a sofrito with onion, garlic, and tomatoes in a pot with oil. add the roughly chopped potatoes, cover them with water, and season with salt. when there are 5 minutes left for the cooking time, stir in the finely chopped. nutritional information this dish features potatoes, a staple food, which is a good source of carbohydrates and therefore energy. the combination with vegetables complements the nutritional value of the dish with vitamins a, c, folic acid, and b6, as well as fiber. furthermore, the potassium and magnesium content of potatoes, together with garlic, makes this dish particularly suitable for people with high blood pressure. nutritional composition per serving rda water 344 energy 381 19.05 protein 9.7 19.40 total fat 14.3 20

title: Pebrots farcits
text: halve the peppers. combine the meat, finely chopped garlic and parsley, breadcrumbs, egg, a pinch of cinnamon, salt, and pepper. stuff the peppers with this mixture, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, and bake in an oiled dish until cooked through.

title: Peix al forn
text: in an oven-safe dish with hot oil, place the onion and when it s slightly cooked, add the potatoes and then the tomatoes. season with salt and pepper, add the wine and let it reduce. place the scaled and seasoned fish over the vegetables and bake in a hot oven, basting occasionally with the juices until cooked through.

title: Peix fregit
text: clean, wash, and drain the fish. season with salt, lightly flour it, and fry in very hot, abundant oil. once fried and crispy, drain on absorbent paper.

title: Peix de roca amb picada
text: sauté the roughly chopped potatoes in a pot with oil, cover them with water, and let them boil. when they are halfway cooked, add the cut fish and the crushed garlic with stale wine. season with salt and pepper and cook over the heat until the fish is done.

title: Peix amb suc
text: in a pan with hot oil, add the ground fish, with a little water. cover the pan and let it cook for a few minutes. add the fish, previously salted, cover it, and cook over high heat until done.

title: Perdius estofades
text: clean, singe, and gut the partridges, reserving the livers. season the partridges with salt and pepper and place them in a saucepan with the cured ham, onions, tomatoes, a bouquet garni, a little oil, and wine. simmer gently. after a while, add the chopped livers, sautéed with a splash of brandy and a splash of vinegar. cook until the partridges are tender. season with salt to taste. halve the partridges, arrange them on a heated platter, and pour the sauce over them.

title: Perdius amb farcellet de col
text: clean, singe, gut, salt, pepper, and lard-rub the partridges inside and out truss them. place them in a casserole with the oil, salted pork belly, sausage, carrots, head of garlic, herbs, and onion with a clove stuck in. cover with a lard-buttered baking parchment and leave in the oven, turning occasionally so they brown evenly on all sides. meanwhile, boil the cabbage leaves in water and salt, cool them, and let them drain. make the bundles with the larger cabbage leaves, stuffing them with pine nuts and pieces of the smaller leaves. flour them, dip them in beaten egg, fry them, and set aside. when the partridges are cooked, untruss them, cut them in half, and place them in another casserole with the bundles, salted pork belly, and sliced sausage. add stale wine and let it reduce. in the casserole where you roasted the partridges, add a little water, let it boil, strain the

title: Carns
text: start by creating a layer of onion at the bottom of a tall pot. arrange the partridges on top, alternating with the shallots. in a saucepan, combine water, vinegar, oil, salt, paprika, black pepper, and sugar. bring to a boil, then pour over the partridges and let simmer for 3 to 4 hours over very low heat.

title: Carns
text: place all the ingredients in a pot. simmer until the partridges are tender, adding water if necessary. stir in the parsley and white wine, and continue to cook for another 10 minutes.

title: Peres farcides
text: sauté the onion in a pot with oil, then add the ground meat, stirring to prevent it from forming balls. thicken with flour, add milk, and simmer over low heat until the meat is tender. partially scoop out the pears, leaving the skins on and without reaching the bottom. stuff them with the meat, dredge them in flour and beaten egg, and fry them in plenty of oil. place them in a pot with the cinnamon stick, sugar, lemon zest, chocolate, and salt. cover with water and cook until tender. a little before the cooking is finished, add the chopped parsley.

title: Peres al vi
text: bring the wine, pears, sugar, cinnamon stick, and orange peel to a boil. simmer gently until the pears are tender. remove the pears and reduce the cooking liquid. return the pears and let cool.

title: Perles del Vallès
text: whisk the egg white with the sugar and coconut, and cook in a saucepan until it thickens. using a piping bag and a round nozzle, pipe mounds 2 cm in diameter onto a baking sheet. bake in a low oven for 25 to 30 minutes, until set and crusty.

title: Recipe 4062

ingredients: catalana ingredients vedella porc d'ocell porc
mongetes branca porro alls ceba fulles d'encimera

title: Bacallà dels segadors
text: make the picada with all the ingredients and mix it with well-drained salt cod. finally, season with a good drizzle of olive oil.

title: Baldana amb samfaina
text: in a saucepan, fry the mussels. add the monkfish and let it simmer over low heat for a while.

title: Barreja de bolets amb botifarra
text: fry the sausages in a paella pan with oil and remove them. in the same oil, sauté the cleaned, chopped, and salted mushrooms. return the sausages to the pan, add a minced mixture of garlic and parsley, and let everything cook together for a while longer.

title: Becada rostida
text: place the snails, seasoned with salt and pepper, in a hot oven with oil until they brown. drizzle with old wine and continue cooking for about 15 minutes, ensuring the meat remains pink, without overcooking.

title: Bisbalenc
text: roll out the dough on a baking sheet and place the angel hair pasta in the center. roll it up like a gypsy arm. brush with beaten egg diluted with water and sprinkle with pine nuts and sugar. bake in the oven at 180 c for 35 minutes.

title: Bistec a la planxa
text: place the steaks on a very hot, lightly oiled grill. when cooked on one side, turn them over to cook the other. season with salt and pepper halfway through cooking or at the end, to avoid toughening the meat.

title: Blat pelat a la cassola
text: boil the wheat with the pork trotters, spine bone, and bay leaves until cooked through. meanwhile, fry the pork ribs, loin, and bacon, all cut into pieces. once browned, set aside. in the same oil, make a concentrated sofrito with onion, garlic, tomatoes, and orange peel. add the meat and wheat, stirring well. cover with broth from cooking the wheat, season with salt and pepper, and let it simmer until almost all the liquid has been absorbed. it should have the consistency of rice in a casserole.

title: Bledes amb all
text: wash and chop the chard. boil it in salted water and drain well. fry the minced garlic in a paella with oil. add the chard and let it cook together for a while, allowing the flavors to blend. this is a very economical and simple first course that provides a large quantity of vitamins and minerals. chard is very rich in vitamin a, folic acid, and vitamin c, as well as calcium and iron. furthermore, it is also a good source of fiber. its richness in vitamins and minerals makes it an excellent first course for pregnant women and during menopause, and in general, for maintaining good skin, bone, and vision health. it is recommended to combine it with a citrus fruit in the same meal to improve the absorption of the iron contained in the chard.

title: Bledes amb cansalada
text: wash and chop the chard. boil it in salted water. in a paella pan, fry the diced cured pork belly until browned. once crispy, add the drained chard and cook for a moment together.

title: Bledes amb ganyims
text: wash and blanch the chopped chard in salted water. in a saucepan with oil, sauté the onion, garlic, and tomato. fry the cockles and add them to the saucepan along with the chard, butter beans, and some of their broth. let it cook together for a while.

title: Bolets de soca amb patates i ceba tendra
text: in a pot with oil, fry the garlic, potatoes, and spring onion. add water and let it simmer. separately, fry the mushrooms until cooked through. add them to the pot, season with salt and pepper, and let everything cook together for a while.

title: Borregos
text: crumble the yeast with a little warm milk, add 100g of flour and let it rise for a while. mix the remaining flour with the egg, grated lemon zest, margarine, lard, the rest of the milk, sugar, cumin, and anise. knead well, add the risen yeast mixture, and work the dough until it s compact. divide it into two portions and shape them into cylindrical bars, 4 cm in diameter. let them rest for a while and bake in a preheated oven at 180 for about 15 minutes. let cool and cut into 2 cm thick slices. return the slices to the oven for 5 minutes.

title: Botifarra dolça
text: in a pot with oil and lard, brown the sausages well. add a cinnamon stick, a lemon peel, a pinch of savory, and hot water until they are almost covered. let it simmer gently until the water is absorbed.

title: Botifarra dolça amb poma
text: in a pot with oil and lard, brown the sausages well. add a cinnamon stick, a lemon peel, a pinch of saffron, the peeled, seeded apples cut into quarters, and hot water until they are almost covered. simmer gently until the water has evaporated.

title: Botifarra amb peres
text: in a saucepan, gently sauté the pears with the rendered lard. when they are browned, add a little sugar and let them caramelize. in a separate paella, fry the sausages. add them to the saucepan with the pears and let everything cook together for a while. add water if needed. let it rest before serving.

title: Botifarres amb vi
text: prick the sausages and place them in a non-stick paella pan with a few drops of oil. cover them with wine and let them simmer until cooked, turning them halfway through. the wine should be completely evaporated.

title: Braç de Gitano
text: separate the egg whites from the yolks. whisk the egg yolks with half of the sugar. gradually add the water until the mixture doubles in volume. beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form, with the remaining sugar. gently fold the egg whites into the yolks. add the flour until you have a smooth batter. pipe the batter onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. bake in a hot oven for 10 minutes. let it cool, covered with a damp cloth. remove the cloth, spread with whipped cream, roll it up, and dust with confectioners sugar.

title: Braç de gitano de patata
text: boil the potatoes and mash them until smooth. once cooled, spread the mash on parchment paper and flatten it to about ½ inch thick. top with tuna, drained and mixed with a little mayonnaise. roll it up, using the paper as an aid, to form a log. cover with mayonnaise and garnish with sliced hard-boiled egg, thinly sliced bell pepper, and olives.

title: Brandada de bacallà
text: lightly fry the garlic with the oil and strain it. blanch the salt cod, remove the skin and bones. in the same boiling water, cook the potato and remove it. put the salt cod and potato in an electric blender and gradually add the oil and warm milk. emulsify everything until it binds like mayonnaise.

title: Verdures i altres hortalisses
text: sautéed broccoli this is made like fried eggplant, but substituting the eggplant with broccoli, previously boiled in salted water.

title: Arròs amb bacallà sec
text: in a saucepan, make a sofrito with olive oil, onion, and tomatoes. meanwhile, soak the salt cod and then rinse it lightly to remove excess salt. add the shredded cod to the sofrito, along with the artichokes and rice. stir everything together. add hot water and let it simmer for about 15 minutes. when there are about 3 minutes left of cooking time, add the minced garlic, parsley, and saffron. cover the saucepan and let it rest for 5 minutes.

title: Recipe 4084
text: escudella catalana ingredients 1 kg de carn de vedella 1 2 kg de carn de porc 250 g de canelons 150 g de naps 150 g de patates 150 g de pastanaga 150 g de mongetes seques 1 branca d'api 1 porro 1 ceba 2 tomàquets madurs 1 4 de kg de bitxo o caragols oli d'oliva verge extra sal pebre negre arròs
ingredients: escudella catalana ingredients vedella porc canelons de naps patates pastanaga
mongetes branca porro ceba tomàquets madurs bitxo o caragols d'oliva extra pebre negre

title: Arròs amb anguila i ànec
text: clean the eel, chop it into pieces, fry it, and set aside. in a pot, fry the duck in olive oil. once golden brown, add the onion, bell pepper, and tomato, all finely chopped. when the sofrito is ready, add the paprika and then the water or meat broth, and let it simmer for about 15 minutes. then add the rice and the eel and cook for another 15 minutes. season with salt and add the minced garlic and parsley, and continue cooking for 5 minutes more. it should be slightly soupy.

title: Arròs en anguila i crancs
text: in a paella pan with hot oil, sauté the crabs, onion, bell pepper, garlic, and parsley, all finely chopped. when the onion is golden, add the peas, paprika, and rice. stir well, then add hot water. once it comes to a boil, add the chopped eels and salt. after 15 minutes, turn off the heat, cover, and let it rest for 5 minutes.

title: Arròs de barraca
text: in a pot, sauté the kale with oil for about 15 minutes. add the chopped eel and sauté for another 5 minutes. add the rice, stir, and add boiling water. season with salt. let it cook for about 18 minutes. add the beans halfway through cooking.

title: Arròs amb carbassa
text: in a pot, fry the cubed salted pork belly with oil. as it browns, add the very finely chopped onion. when the onion is golden, add the diced pumpkin and let it cook together over low heat. stir occasionally and when the pumpkin begins to soften, add the rice. stir well and add very hot water or vegetable broth. season with salt, cook for about 18 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

title: Arròs amb galeres i bròquil
text: in a pot with oil, make a sofrito with onion and tomato. when the sofrito is nicely browned, add the croutons and minced garlic. stir well and sauté everything together. next, add the rice, chopped broccoli, and salt. stir and pour in water or fish broth. let it cook for about 18 minutes.

title: Arròs de cabra
text: cut the goat meat into pieces, being careful to retain the juices. in a pot with oil, brown the goat pieces. once they are golden, remove them. in the same oil, sauté the onion, garlic, and tomatoes. once the sofrito is ready, add the rice, sauté everything together, and add hot water. after five minutes, add the goat meat, the reserved juices, salt, and pepper, and let it cook for about 15 minutes.

title: Bacallà amb agredolç
text: fry the salted and floured cod in a paella with oil. set aside in a saucepan. in the same oil, add the honey, stirring to dissolve it, and then add the vinegar, being careful not to let it boil and ensuring it blends well with the honey. pour it over the cod and cover.

title: Bacallà amb mussolina d'all
text: sauté the spinach in a paella pan and season with salt. fry the salt cod or grill it. to make the mousseline, whisk the mayonnaise and stir in the roasted garlic, peeled and mashed. in oven-safe dishes, layer the spinach and then the salt cod. top with the garlic mayonnaise and bake until golden brown.

title: Calamarsons fregits
text: clean the baby squid thoroughly, season with salt, and lightly flour them. fry in plenty of hot oil until golden brown.

title: Cabra amb cargols
text: deceive the snails. make a sofrito with onion, tomatoes, cinnamon, and a bouquet garni. add the flour, stirring for a couple of minutes, then add the goat meat, snails, and a little water, and let it simmer. when there are 5 minutes left to finish cooking, add the finely chopped parsley, seasoned with stale wine and anise.

title: Carxofes al forn
text: grilled artichokes ingredients 4 large artichokes 100 ml extra virgin olive oil 1 lemon, halved salt to taste freshly ground black pepper to taste instructions 1. prepare the artichokes remove the tough outer leaves of the artichokes until you reach the paler, more tender ones. trim the top of each artichoke and cut off the base. rub the cut surfaces with lemon to prevent discoloration. 2. cook the artichokes grill the artichokes over medium heat for about 20-25 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are tender and slightly charred. 3. season drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste. serve hot.

title: Fideus amb flor de col i abadejo
text: in a pot with oil, sauté the onion, red bell pepper, garlic, and tomato. once softened, add the cubed potatoes and water. when it comes to a boil, add the noodles, chopped cabbage, salt, paprika, saffron, and finally, the salt cod. simmer until the noodles are cooked through. it should be slightly soupy.

title: Figues calentes
text: pit one almond into each fig and flatten with your hand. grill them and, when you remove them, place them on a dish with a splash of brandy. serve hot.

title: Vianda del Pallars
text: in a pot with water, add the chicken, pork shank, salt pork, and bones. let it boil together for about an hour and a half. when the meat is tender, add the chopped cabbage, peeled and roughly chopped pears, sausages, and peeled potatoes. season with salt. once everything is cooked, strain the broth and add the noodles and cooked beans. cook until the noodles are done. serve the soup with the meats, vegetables, and pears on the side, or all mixed together with the shredded meat.

title: Galtes de porc amb naps
text: in a pot with oil and rendered pork fat, brown the diced and salted pork cheeks. peel the turnips and cut them in half, flour them, and fry them in a paella pan with oil. set aside. in the same oil used to fry the turnips, make a sofrito with onions, garlic, and tomatoes. when the pork cheeks are golden brown, add the sofrito, the turnips, and a little water or meat broth. let it cook together until the pork cheeks are tender.

title: Mandonguilles amb samfaina
text: make the meatballs with the minced meats, crushed garlic and parsley, eggs, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. dust them in flour and fry them in a paella with hot oil. place the sautéed vegetables and meatballs in a saucepan and let it cook together for about 10 minutes.

title: Ous remenats amb espàrrecs de marge
text: in a paella with oil, sauté the asparagus cut into pieces. season with salt and pepper, and when they begin to turn golden, lower the heat and add the lightly beaten eggs. stir constantly until the eggs are almost set.

title: Ous remenats amb alls tendres
text: in a paella with oil, sauté the thinly sliced garlic. season with salt and pepper, and when they begin to turn golden, reduce the heat and add the lightly beaten eggs. stir constantly until the eggs are almost set.

title: Ous remenats amb espàrrecs verds
text: in a paella pan, sauté the asparagus cut into pieces. season with salt and pepper, and when they start to turn golden, reduce the heat and add the lightly beaten eggs. stir constantly until the eggs are almost set.

title: Panoli
text: in a bowl, combine the oil, sugar, and anise. once well combined, add the flour until the dough can be worked. form 100g balls, flatten them, and then stretch them with your fingers into twisted rolls approximately 12 cm in diameter and 1.5 cm thick. finally, pinch the center to create a small peak. place them on a baking sheet and bake at a low temperature of 120º.

title: Pollastre escabetxat
